en_title: 200,000 Sign a Petition to Bring Huang Back. The Board Says No
en_text:
Without Jensen Huang, everyone thinks NVIDIA should bring him back.

A petition with 200,000 signatures was backed by Musk and a group of CEOs. The interim CEO is Colette Kress, who spent many years at Microsoft.

But the board said on the earnings call that there were no plans to reinstate him. At the same call, it also tightened its purchase backstop for neocloud.

Everyone says they want to keep him, but their hands have already tied the purse strings tight.

title: 中南大学通报三篇论文学术不端，通报里没提AI
note: 全新：列表166条与内置清单均无中南大学湘雅医院AI论文通报事件；中南大学官方通报一手，澎湃、界面、新京报多信源。
text:
人类省。1厘米12格。

这是湘雅二医院一篇论文里的单位地址和尺子刻度，网友据此怀疑实验图片是AI生成。11月19日，中南大学给了通报。

通报认定三篇论文有问题，分别发在《Journal of Translational Medicine》《Cell Death & Disease》和《Scientific Reports》，时间跨2025和2026年。定性是伪造篡改实验研究数据和图表、不当署名，其中一篇还违反科研伦理规范。

处罚落到人头上。邓某某和赵某被降低专业技术岗位等级，5年内取消职称晋升、人才计划申报、研究生招生和评奖评优资格，10年内不得承担财政性资金支持的科技活动。蔡某、谭某某各领5年限制，其余作者被学术诫勉谈话。

争议是从那几个低级错误被扒出来的，收尾却和AI无关。整份通报里，AI两个字一次没出现，认定的全是人做的事。
en_title: Central South University Reports Academic Misconduct in Three Papers, Without Mentioning AI
en_text:
Human Province. 12 divisions per 1 cm.

Those were the institutional affiliation and ruler markings in a paper from the Second Xiangya Hospital, prompting netizens to suspect that the experimental images were AI-generated. On November 19, Central South University released a statement.

The statement found problems with three papers published in “Journal of Translational Medicine,” “Cell Death & Disease,” and “Scientific Reports,” with publication dates spanning 2025 and 2026. The findings were fabrication and tampering with experimental research data and figures, and inappropriate authorship; one paper also violated research ethics standards.

The punishments landed on the individuals. Deng and Zhao had their professional and technical position grades lowered; for 5 years, they were barred from title promotions, talent program applications, graduate admissions, and award and honor evaluations, and for 10 years they could not undertake scientific and technological activities supported by public funds. Cai and Tan each received 5-year restrictions, while the remaining authors received formal academic admonitions.

The controversy erupted after those low-level errors were dug up, but the final findings had nothing to do with AI. The word “AI” did not appear even once in the entire statement; everything it identified was done by people.

title: 联想营收创新高却报亏6.4亿，钱亏在认股权证上
note: 全新：列表与内置清单均无联想集团中期业绩条目；港交所公告一手，财联社、中新经纬、证券时报多信源。深度稿。
text:
联想这个季度一边创纪录，一边亏钱，两件事都是真的。

11月19日中午，联想集团在港交所公布2026/27财年中期业绩。第二财季收入302.38亿美元，同比增长48%，第一次单季突破300亿美元。上半年收入572亿美元，增长46%。

同一份公告里，第二财季公司权益持有人应占亏损6.40亿美元，上半年亏12.48亿美元。股价午后开盘一度跌超12%。

钱亏在哪，公告写得很明白。亏损主要由期内确认的认股权证相关衍生金融负债公允值亏损造成，上半年这一项是35.96亿美元，去年同期还是500万美元的收益。

第二财季这一项亏损19.06亿美元。这是会计账上的亏，钱没有从公司账户里划走。认股权证作为衍生工具按公允值计进负债，联想股价和估值一变，负债重估，账上就记一笔亏损。

生意做得越好、股价越往上，这笔负债的公允值可能反而越高，账面亏得越多。它跟投资盈亏无关。

把这一项剔掉，联想的经营是另一副样子。第二财季经营溢利19.36亿美元，经调整股东应占溢利13.61亿美元，同比增长166%。上半年经调整溢利24.36亿美元，增长170%。

撑起利润的是AI相关业务，第二财季AI收入108亿美元，增长79%，占总收入36%。AI服务器收入同比增长超过300%，订单储备800亿美元，比上一季度增加48%。

基础设施方案业务营收113.45亿美元，增长177.6%，经营溢利第一次过10亿美元。

代价落在股价上。财报发布后，联想港股午后跳水，市场先看到的是那个6.40亿美元的亏损数字。

真正该盯的，是认股权证下一期怎么重估。联想把中期股息定在每股9.0港仙，12月23日前后派付，这是账上现金还够的一个信号。
en_title: Lenovo Posts Record Revenue but a $640 Million Loss on Warrants
en_text:
Lenovo set a record and lost money this quarter. Both things are true.

At noon on November 19, Lenovo Group announced its FY2026/27 interim results on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. Second-quarter revenue reached US$30.238 billion, up 48% year over year and topping US$30 billion for the first time in a single quarter. First-half revenue was US$57.2 billion, up 46%.

In the same announcement, the second-quarter loss attributable to equity holders was US$640 million, while the first-half loss was US$1.248 billion. The shares fell more than 12% shortly after the afternoon open.

The announcement makes clear where the loss came from. The loss was mainly caused by fair-value losses on warrant-related derivative financial liabilities recognized during the period. For the first half, this item was a US$3.596 billion loss, compared with a US$5 million gain in the same period last year.

In the second quarter, the item generated a US$1.906 billion loss. This was a loss on the accounting books; no money was transferred out of the company's accounts. Because warrants are recognized as derivatives and carried as liabilities at fair value, any change in Lenovo's share price and valuation triggers a revaluation and a new loss on the books.

The better the business does and the higher the stock price climbs, the higher this liability's fair value may rise, and the larger the loss on the books. It has nothing to do with investment gains or losses.

Strip out that item, and Lenovo's operations look entirely different. Second-quarter operating profit was US$1.936 billion, while adjusted profit attributable to shareholders was US$1.361 billion, up 166%. First-half adjusted profit was US$2.436 billion, up 170%.

AI-related businesses drove the profits. Second-quarter AI revenue reached US$10.8 billion, up 79% and accounting for 36% of total revenue. AI server revenue grew more than 300% year over year, with an order backlog of US$80 billion, up 48% from the previous quarter.

The Infrastructure Solutions business generated US$11.345 billion in revenue, up 177.6%, with operating profit exceeding US$1 billion for the first time.

The cost landed on the share price. After the results were released, Lenovo's Hong Kong shares plunged in the afternoon, and the market's first focus was the US$640 million loss figure.

What really matters is how the warrants will be revalued next period. Lenovo set its interim dividend at 9.0 HK cents per share, payable around December 23—a sign that it still has enough cash on the books.

title: OpenAI做手机，找的是给苹果装iPhone的富智康
note: 全新：列表与内置清单均无OpenAI手机或富智康组装订单事件；证券时报独家、财联社多信源。
text:
富士康旗下富智康，拿到了OpenAI手机的整机组装订单。

11月19日，证券时报从供应链获悉这笔订单。富智康的代码是02038.HK，母公司富士康同时是苹果iPhone的主要组装商。

同一天，财联社从消费电子供应链人士处听到更细的安排。首款产品有望在2027年底或2028年面市，立讯精密、领益智造、瑞声科技这些老果链厂商也会进到零部件环节。

消息传到港股。

富智康午后一度直线拉升，涨幅超过8%。

一家靠模型起家的公司，要做终端时，第一步是找一家最会造手机的公司。OpenAI没有自建产线，挑的是给苹果干了多年iPhone的那条供应链。

模型能力要变成口袋里的一台设备，绕不开整机组装这一关。这一关拼的是良率和产能，算法在这里帮不上忙。

对果链厂商来说，订单从苹果一个篮子里挪出来了一部分。
en_title: OpenAI's Phone Finds FIH Mobile, the Company That Assembles iPhones for Apple
en_text:
FIH Mobile, a Foxconn subsidiary, has won the whole-device assembly order for OpenAI's phone.

On November 19, Securities Times learned about the order from the supply chain. FIH Mobile's ticker is 02038.HK, and its parent Foxconn is also a major assembler of Apple iPhones.

That same day, CLS learned of a more detailed arrangement from consumer electronics supply-chain sources. The first product is expected to launch in late 2027 or 2028, and veteran Apple supply-chain players such as Luxshare Precision, Lingyi iTech, and AAC Technologies will also enter the component stage.

The news reached Hong Kong stocks.

FIH Mobile surged in a straight line in the afternoon, briefly gaining more than 8%.

For a company that rose to prominence with models, the first step in making a consumer device is to find the company that knows best how to build phones. OpenAI did not build its own production line; it chose the Apple supply chain that had worked on iPhones for years.

Turning model capabilities into a device that fits in your pocket is impossible without whole-device assembly. That stage comes down to yield and capacity; algorithms are no help there.

For Apple supply-chain vendors, some orders are being moved out of Apple's basket.

title: AI论文，锅不该AI背
note: 热点解构，范式=暴论；榜单cross=3，回答为什么通报通篇不提AI。
text:
AI论文，锅不该AI背，

热搜都在传图片是AI生成的。湖南省写成人类省，尺子1厘米画出12格。

中南大学19日通报里，AI两个字一次没出现。定性是伪造篡改数据和不当署名，四个人挨罚。

AI没替谁写论文，它只把低级错误放大到所有人都看见。那最初盯着AI的我们，看错了什么？
en_title: AI Papers, But AI Shouldn't Take the Blame
en_text:
AI papers, but AI shouldn't take the blame,

Trending searches claim the images were AI-generated. Hunan Province was written as “Human Province,” with 12 divisions drawn on the ruler per 1 cm.

In Central South University's statement on the 19th, the word “AI” did not appear even once. The findings were fabrication and tampering with data and inappropriate authorship. Four people were punished.

AI didn't write anyone's paper; it only magnified the low-level errors until everyone could see them. So what exactly did we get wrong when we first fixated on AI?

title: 等了13年的游戏
note: 热点解构，范式=冷知识；榜单cross=3，回答为什么评分已不是发售日的重点。
text:
等了13年的游戏，

GTA6今天首发，Metacritic开分99，115家媒体打分，系列史上最高。三个热搜榜同时挂着它。

热搜上吵得最凶的，是那1分扣在哪。新西兰比全球先开服，玩家提前一天就进了游戏。

一款游戏把发售日过成了节日，评分早就不是重点。你抢的是游戏，还是那张首日截图？
en_title: A Game We Waited 13 Years For
en_text:
A game we waited 13 years for,

GTA6 launched today with a 99 on Metacritic based on reviews from 115 media outlets—the highest score in the series' history. It appeared on three trending lists at once.

The biggest fight on the trending lists was over where that one point was docked. New Zealand got access before the rest of the world, and players got into the game a full day early.

A game turned its release day into a holiday. The score stopped being the point long ago. Are you rushing to get the game, or to get that first-day screenshot?

title: 联想报亏6.4亿，生意其实没崩
note: 博眼球，骨架=S05 反常识断言；用联想财报账面亏损与经营溢利的反差。
text:
联想报亏6.4亿美元，直觉是生意崩了。

翻开账本，35.96亿美元的亏损来自认股权证公允值重估，钱一分没划走。

剔掉这笔账面数，经调整溢利13.61亿美元，同比涨了166%。

真正狠的是，股价越涨，这笔衍生负债的公允值越高，账面上亏得越难看。生意越好，报表越丑。
en_title: Lenovo Reports a $640 Million Loss, but the Business Hasn't Collapsed
en_text:
Lenovo's US$640 million loss gives the gut reaction that the business has collapsed.

Open the books and the US$3.596 billion loss came from the fair-value revaluation of warrants; not a cent actually left the company's accounts.

Strip out this accounting item and adjusted profit was US$1.361 billion, up 166% year over year.

Here's the brutal part: the higher the stock price, the higher the fair value of this derivative liability, and the worse the loss looks on the books. The better the business does, the uglier the financials look.

title: OpenAI造手机，先学挑代工厂
note: 博眼球，骨架=S07 借壳反转；用OpenAI手机整机组装订单换角度。
text:
大家都说OpenAI要自己做手机，跟苹果抢饭碗。

造手机拼的是良率和产线，跟模型分数关系不大。

可整机组装订单第一站是富智康02038.HK，给苹果装iPhone的也是它。

首款产品要等到2027年底。AI公司做硬件，先学会的是挑代工厂。
en_title: OpenAI Is Making a Phone: First, Learn to Choose a Contract Manufacturer
en_text:
Everyone says OpenAI is making its own phone and taking food out of Apple's bowl.

Making phones comes down to yield and production lines, not model benchmark scores.

But FIH Mobile 02038.HK is the first stop for the whole-device assembly order. It is also the company that assembles iPhones for Apple.

The first product won't come until late 2027. An AI company's first lesson in hardware is how to choose a contract manufacturer.

title: DeepSeek第二轮千亿融资落地，腾讯宁德并列第一大出资方
note: 全新；cross=2；列表第21条只是C端限额，非同一事件。深度稿，机制块写持股平台与控制权分离。
text:
梁文锋把 DeepSeek 第二轮的股东名单锁进了工商档案，腾讯和宁德时代并列第一大外部出资方。

11月19日的工商信息显示，杭州深度求索人工智能基础技术研究有限公司注册资本从1645万元增至1991.8707万元，增幅21.1%。新增股东是持股平台杭州程砚。

这个平台同期新增31家合伙人，登记出资额从0.6万元涨到343897.9万元，现在一共有32名合伙人。

钱先汇进杭州程砚这个合伙企业，再落到 DeepSeek。31家机构以有限合伙身份进来，出资但不参与管理。梁文锋退出了程砚的直接合伙人名单，却持有执行事务合伙人杭州程策99%的股权。出钱的和做主的，分在两个地方。

按出资比例，腾讯旗下上海珩岫占9.5653%，宁德时代三只基金加起来也是9.5653%。中国移动旗下中移投资和中信证券投资各占7.6522%，砺思7.1740%，国寿股权4.7826%。

第二档是网易、美团龙珠、中国电信、vivo、美的、小红书、立讯、兆易创新、吉利产投。再往下是中芯聚源、横店资本、弘卓资本、中金河钢这些半导体产业链和地方国资。

这轮募资1055亿元，投后估值6155亿元。6月底那轮是510亿元，估值近4000亿元，梁文锋自己掏了200亿元。不到四个月，两轮加起来超过1500亿元。

产业资本图的不只是股权。DeepSeek对资方有产业协同的要求，几家互联网平台进来后要跟它做业务合作。

有国资因为不进架构的规矩，最后没参与。份额供不应求，参与方拿到的公司资料很少，有人想谈条件，反馈是没有协商空间。

梁文锋用少量注册资本撬动了千亿资金，代价是把产业伙伴请进了股东名单。腾讯、宁德、中国移动的名字一旦进去，DeepSeek往后跟谁合作，就都有了关系权重。

下一个动作是IPO。DeepSeek已经请中信证券准备科创板上市，计划年内启动流程。看点是杭州程砚这32名合伙人，会不会出现在招股书里。

title: 黑芝麻智能落子深圳前海，机器人量产订单先砸向割草机
note: 全新；wscn单榜但多信源交叉，具身智能+芯片加权。常规稿，反常识点在订单结构。
text:
一家做了十年智驾芯片的公司，把机器人量产订单装进了深圳前海的新总部。

11月19日，黑芝麻智能在前海成立具身智能总部，同日落成一座具身智能展厅，十多家生态伙伴入驻。已经签下战略合作的有美的、遨博、中远海运和均胜电子。

反常识的是订单结构。轮式机器人、四足机器狗、割草机跑在最前面，人形机器人只是其中一类。先掏钱买算力平台的，不是展台上跳舞的那台。

黑芝麻2016年成立，靠华山和武当系列智驾芯片起家。2025年它推出SesameX机器人计算平台，分Kalos、Aura、Liora三条产品线，把单芯片算力做成0.5 TOPS到1000 TOPS以上的全梯度。

车规级芯片的感知、决策、控制经验被直接搬到了机器人身上，底层逻辑同源。

前海给的是跨境资金和数据的便利，香港那头接的是国际资本和人才。那台从未来之树上摘苹果的采摘机器人，用的还是同一套平台。
en_title: Black Sesame Intelligence makes its move in Shenzhen's Qianhai, with mass-production robotics orders landing first with lawn mowers
en_text:
A company that has spent 10 years developing intelligent-driving chips has brought mass-production robotics orders to its new headquarters in Shenzhen's Qianhai.

On Nov 19, Black Sesame Intelligence established an embodied-intelligence headquarters in Qianhai and completed an embodied-intelligence showroom on the same day. More than 10 ecosystem partners moved in. Strategic partnerships have already been signed with Midea, AUBO, COSCO Shipping and Joyson Electronics.

Counterintuitively, the order mix looks like this. Wheeled robots, quadruped robot dogs and lawn mowers are leading the pack, while humanoid robots are just one category. The ones paying first for a computing platform are not the robots dancing on the exhibition floor.

Founded in 2016, Black Sesame made its name with the Huashan and Wudang series of intelligent-driving chips. In 2025 it launched the SesameX robotics computing platform, with the Kalos, Aura and Liora product lines spanning the full range from 0.5 TOPS to over 1000 TOPS of single-chip computing power.

The perception, decision-making and control expertise built into its automotive-grade chips was carried straight over to robots, with the same underlying logic.

Qianhai brings the convenience of cross-border capital and data, while Hong Kong connects it to international capital and talent. The apple-picking robot that plucks fruit from the tree of the future still uses the same platform.

title: 比亚迪App崩了，多地车主手机开不了车门
note: 全新；知乎单榜107万热度，影响大量用户，多信源。快讯。
text:
11月17日下午，比亚迪App崩了上了热搜。多地车主发现手机连不上车，远程开不了门，App里的商城页面也刷不出来。

武汉一家门店的工作人员说，是后台故障，店里的App也打不开。崩的是云端那一层，车本身没坏。

断云之后还能开门的是NFC钥匙、蓝牙钥匙、UWB钥匙和实体钥匙，这几种都不走云服务。习惯用App开门的车主，可以微信关注比亚迪DiLink登录账号恢复解锁。当天16点09分，服务恢复。
en_title: BYD App crashes, and car owners in multiple locations can't open doors by phone
en_text:
On the afternoon of Nov 17, the BYD App crashed and trended online. Car owners in multiple locations found that their phones could not connect to their cars, could not open the doors remotely, and the mall pages in the app would not load.

A staff member at a store in Wuhan said it was a backend malfunction and that even the app on store devices would not open. The cloud layer had crashed; the cars themselves were fine.

Once the cloud was down, NFC keys, Bluetooth keys, UWB keys and physical keys still opened the doors because none of them relies on cloud services. Owners used to opening their cars with the app can follow BYD DiLink on WeChat and log in to their account to restore unlocking. Service was restored at 16:09 that day.

title: 31家股东挤进来，图什么
note: 全新；范式=扎心提问。cross=2，榜单只给千亿融资落地，判断落在产业资本为何扎堆、出钱与掌权分离。
text:
31家股东挤进来，图什么，

榜上写的是千亿融资落地。我翻了一遍出资名单，腾讯和宁德时代各占9.5653%，并列第一。

这些钱进来都不说话，以有限合伙身份待在杭州程砚里，管理权一股不碰。梁文锋退出直接合伙人名单，攥着执行事务合伙人99%的股权。

出钱的和做主的，从来没重合过。
en_title: What are these 31 shareholders crowding in for?
en_text:
31 shareholders are crowding in. So what are they after?

The list says a CNY 100 billion funding round has closed. I went through the list of contributors: Tencent and CATL each hold 9.5653%, tied for first.

The money comes in without a voice. The institutions sit in Hangzhou Chengyan as limited partners and do not take a single share of management power. Liang Wenfeng stepped down as a direct partner, while keeping his grip on 99% of the equity in the executive partner.

Those who put up the money and those who call the shots have never overlapped.

title: 催款邮件发了三封，冷知识
note: 部分重叠；事件v1第160条已写，本条为v2榜单解构换角度，新在把三封邮件解读为关系信号。范式=冷知识。
text:
催款邮件发了三封，冷知识：

榜单上是宁德向理想一天发了三封催款邮件。三封看着像催账，其实是在提醒。理想开始自己造电池，宁德手里的订单就要重新算。

大客户自己下场造货那天，供应商先把账期摆到桌面上，降价排在后面。

一天三封，催的早就不只是钱了。
en_title: Three Payment Reminder Emails Sent in One Day—Fun Fact
en_text:
Three payment reminder emails sent in one day—fun fact:

The rankings showed that CATL sent Li Auto three payment reminder emails in a single day. They look like debt collection, but they’re actually a warning. Now that Li Auto has started making its own batteries, CATL will have to reassess the orders it has on hand.

When a major customer starts making the products itself, the supplier puts payment terms on the table first. Price cuts come later.

Three emails a day—what they’re chasing stopped being just money a long time ago.

title: 梁文锋又拿到了1055亿，落袋了
note: 全新；骨架=S08 结果前置。与上一轮14时场S05/S07不同，用DeepSeek融资换角度：钱到手但控制权不松。
text:
梁文锋又拿到了1055亿，落袋了。

他是DeepSeek的创始人。

半年前DeepSeek缺算力，C端用户都被限额。

这次他让31家机构先出钱，自己攥着执行事务合伙人99%的股权。

钱进来了，控制权一点没松，这才是他敢请中信证券备科创板的原因。
en_title: Liang Wenfeng banked another CNY 105.5 billion
en_text:
Liang Wenfeng banked another CNY 105.5 billion.

He is the founder of DeepSeek.

Half a year ago, DeepSeek was short on computing power, and C-side users were all subject to usage limits.

This time, he got 31 institutions to put up the money first, while keeping 99% of the equity in the executive partner.

The money came in, but control loosened not at all. That is why he dared to ask CITIC Securities to prepare a STAR Market listing.

title: 只靠手机开门的车，断一次云就是废铁
note: 全新；骨架=S12 情绪加压。与上一轮S05/S07不同，用比亚迪App断云事件，落在本地钥匙不走云端。
text:
只靠手机开门的车，断一次云就是废铁。

11月17日下午，车主站在车边按了半天，门就是不开。

钥匙落在车里，NFC又没绑，大冬天只能等着。

但NFC、蓝牙、UWB和实体钥匙都不走云端，随手就能开。

云端是出租车，本地钥匙才是你自己家的门。
en_title: A car that can only be opened with a phone becomes scrap metal the moment the cloud goes down
en_text:
A car that can only be opened with a phone becomes scrap metal the moment the cloud goes down.

On the afternoon of Nov 17, an owner stood beside the car pressing for ages, but the door simply would not open.

The key was inside the car, and NFC had not been set up, so in the dead of winter there was nothing to do but wait.

But NFC keys, Bluetooth keys, UWB keys and physical keys do not rely on the cloud and can open the car on the spot.

The cloud is a taxi; a local key is the door to your own home.

title: 快手Q3营收降11.1%，经调整净利少了八成
note: 全新；热点榜wscn快手财讯条目。官方IR一手+腾讯新闻/新浪多信源。深度稿五块结构，机制块写利润双降成因。
text:
快手三季度赚的钱，比去年同期少了八成。

11月19日发的三季报。总营收315.92亿元，同比降11.1%。经调整净利润7.9亿元，去年同期是50亿，降了84.2%。经调整EBITDA 38.94亿元，同比降49.1%。

用户没跑。日活4.173亿，同比微增0.3%。月活8.185亿，涨了12%。

钱从哪少。直播收入77.52亿元，降19%，线上营销服务收入179亿元，降11.1%，只有其他服务在涨，59.69亿元，增1.5%。毛利率从去年同期的54.7%掉到48.2%。

钱又花哪。研发开支同比涨41.9%，单季研发费用51.78亿元。可灵刚发了Kling 4.0，支持最长30秒原生视频。公司自己说，可灵和整体AI战略的持续投入会继续带来成本压力。

机制不复杂。电商营销预算被竞争分走，直播在主动调生态，两个最大的现金牛同时减速。AI要抢，研发和算力不能停。收入在缩，成本在涨，利润表就成这样了。

代价在流水里。前三季度累计收入1008亿元，同比降2.3%，经调整净利80.77亿元，降46.8%。四季度公司自己给了话，收入和盈利能力可能继续承压。

我看这个季度，重点是快手在用户还在涨的时候，主动把钱挪去买了AI的门票。

下一个信号，是可灵的商业化收入什么时候能单列出来。
en_title: Kuaishou Q3 revenue down 11.1%, adjusted net profit down 80%
en_text:
The money Kuaishou made in Q3 was down 80% from a year earlier.

Third-quarter results released Nov 19. Total revenue came to CNY 31.592 billion, down 11.1% YoY. Adjusted net profit was CNY 790 million, versus CNY 5 billion in the same period last year, down 84.2%. Adjusted EBITDA was CNY 3.894 billion, down 49.1% YoY.

Users did not leave. Daily active users reached 417.3 million, up 0.3% YoY. Monthly active users reached 818.5 million, up 12%.

So, where did the revenue go? Livestreaming revenue was CNY 7.752 billion, down 19%, and online marketing services revenue was CNY 17.9 billion, down 11.1%. Only other services grew, rising 1.5% to CNY 5.969 billion. Gross margin fell from 54.7% a year earlier to 48.2%.

And where is the money going? R&D spending rose 41.9% YoY, with quarterly R&D expenses of CNY 5.178 billion. Kling had just released Kling 4.0, supporting native video of up to 30 seconds. The company itself says continued investment in Kling and its broader AI strategy will keep putting pressure on costs.

The mechanism is not complicated. E-commerce marketing budgets are being siphoned away by competitors, while livestreaming is proactively readjusting its ecosystem, so both of the biggest cash cows are slowing at once. AI has to be fought for, and R&D and computing power cannot stop. Revenue is shrinking, costs are rising, and that is how the income statement ended up looking.

The cost shows up in the numbers. Revenue for the first three quarters totaled CNY 100.8 billion, down 2.3% YoY, while adjusted net profit was CNY 8.077 billion, down 46.8%. The company itself said revenue and profitability could remain under pressure in Q4.

What I took away from the quarter is that while its user base was still growing, Kuaishou proactively shifted money to buy a ticket into AI.

The next signal is when Kling's commercial revenue will be disclosed separately.

title: 网易Q3营收降1.8%，有道连续九季度盈利
note: 全新；热点榜wscn网易Q3营收279亿条目。HKEX公告一手+网易/每经多信源。常规稿，反常识点是营收降而毛利涨。
text:
网易三季度营收279亿元，同比降1.8%，美股盘前跌了超5%。

11月19日发的财报。归母净利润84亿元，非公认会计准则下是92亿元。游戏及相关增值服务收入229亿元，降1.7%，仍是网易最大的一块收入。有道14亿元，降12.3%。云音乐19亿元，降0.9%。创新及其他业务15亿元，涨7.1%。

反常识的是毛利。营收在降，毛利190亿元，反而同比涨了4.8%。经营费用96亿元，降5.4%。研发47亿元，研发投入强度17%。

有道这边有个数字。连续九个季度经营利润为正，AI订阅销售额过了1亿。子鸣双模型登顶了Hugging Face。

盘前那5%的跌，跟预期有关。营收279亿，市场预估是303.8亿。游戏收入229.4亿，预估253.4亿。

燕云十六声全球玩家破了1亿。
en_title: NetEase Q3 revenue down 1.8%, Youdao profitable for 9 consecutive quarters
en_text:
NetEase's Q3 revenue was CNY 27.9 billion, down 1.8% YoY, and its U.S.-listed shares fell more than 5% in premarket trading.

The financial results were released Nov 19. Net profit attributable to shareholders was CNY 8.4 billion, or CNY 9.2 billion on a non-GAAP basis. Games and related value-added services revenue was CNY 22.9 billion, down 1.7%, and remained NetEase's largest revenue segment. Youdao revenue was CNY 1.4 billion, down 12.3%. Cloud Music revenue was CNY 1.9 billion, down 0.9%. Innovative businesses and other services revenue was CNY 1.5 billion, up 7.1%.

Counterintuitively, gross profit increased. Despite the revenue decline, gross profit was CNY 19 billion, up 4.8% YoY. Operating expenses were CNY 9.6 billion, down 5.4%. R&D was CNY 4.7 billion, and R&D intensity was 17%.

Youdao has another striking number. It has delivered positive operating profit for 9 consecutive quarters, and AI subscription sales have exceeded CNY 100 million. The Ziming dual model topped the Hugging Face leaderboard.

That 5% premarket drop was about expectations. Revenue came in at CNY 27.9 billion, versus a market estimate of CNY 30.38 billion. Games revenue was CNY 22.94 billion, versus an estimate of CNY 25.34 billion.

Where Winds Meet surpassed 100 million global players.

title: 马斯克首次到访深圳，称特斯拉将继续在华提高产量
note: 全新；热点榜cross=3（马斯克小儿子玩具中国制造）与cross=2（我是中国超级粉丝）为同一事件。新华社/央视财经一手+玉渊谭天多信源。按官方口径写商业表态，不涉政治解读。
text:
马斯克11月19日在深圳见了贸促会会长任鸿斌，这是他首次公开到访深圳。

会见里他说，自己是中国的超级粉丝。问他为什么这么喜欢中国，他提到小儿子的玩具，盒子上写的都是中国制造，中国像个玩具天堂。还点赞了中国的铁路系统。

真正跟生意有关的在后面。特斯拉会继续在中国提高产量。任鸿斌邀请特斯拉明年带着最新技术参加链博会，2027年正好是链博会五周年，马斯克回了句听起来非常好。

9月下旬他刚做过央视财经专访，展望过AI、能源、航天领域的合作。这次来华带着小儿子。

特斯拉上海超级工厂，一直是它全球产能的大头。
en_title: Musk makes his first visit to Shenzhen, says Tesla will continue to increase production in China
en_text:
On Nov 19, Musk met China Council for the Promotion of International Trade Chairman Ren Hongbin in Shenzhen, his first publicly disclosed visit to the city.

During the meeting, he said he was a superfan of China. When asked why he likes China so much, he brought up his younger son's toys, whose boxes all say "Made in China," and said China was like a toy paradise. He also gave China's railway system a thumbs-up.

The part that actually matters for business came later. Tesla will continue to increase production in China. Ren Hongbin invited Tesla to bring its latest technology to the Chain Expo next year; 2027 will be the Chain Expo's 5th anniversary. Musk replied that it sounded great.

In late September, he had just given a CCTV Finance interview, looking ahead to cooperation in AI, energy and aerospace. He brought his younger son on this trip to China.

Tesla's Shanghai Gigafactory has long accounted for a large share of its global capacity.

title: 杨元庆称ISG营收将超IDG，联想利润结构变了
note: overlap（C类部分重叠）；列表第168条14时场已写联想Q2财报营收与认股权证亏损。本次新在杨元庆ISG超IDG表态、CFO下财季反超、各业务线与AI订单储备数字。
text:
联想的业务结构，这个季度变了。

11月19日的业绩沟通会，杨元庆说，利润结构已经变了，ISG营收规模超过IDG是大概率事件。CFO郑孝明补得更具体，按现在的增速，最快下个财季就超。

ISG在追。第二财季收入761亿元，同比涨177.6%，运营利润73.2亿元，利润率9.6%。IDG收入1165亿元，涨14.9%。一个是AI服务器，一个是PC，增速不在一个量级。

ISG和SSG加起来，已经贡献三大业务集团运营利润的61%，去年同期是33%。

联想AI服务器订单储备800亿美元，环比涨48%。第二财季AI相关收入108亿美元，涨79%，占总收入36%。

6.4亿美元的亏损还在，那是认股权证的非现金公允价值变动。
en_title: Yang Yuanqing says ISG revenue will surpass IDG; Lenovo's profit mix has changed
en_text:
Lenovo's business mix changed this quarter.

At the earnings communication meeting on November 19, Yang Yuanqing said the profit mix had already changed, and it was highly likely ISG's revenue scale would surpass IDG's. CFO Zheng Xiaoming was more specific: at the current growth rate, it could surpass it as early as next fiscal quarter.

ISG is closing the gap. Second-quarter revenue was RMB 76.1 billion, up 177.6% year over year, with operating profit of RMB 7.32 billion and a margin of 9.6%. IDG revenue was RMB 116.5 billion, up 14.9%. One is AI servers, the other is PCs; their growth rates aren't even in the same league.

Combined, ISG and SSG now contribute 61% of the operating profit across the three business groups, up from 33% a year ago.

Lenovo's AI server order backlog is USD 80 billion, up 48% quarter over quarter. Second-quarter AI-related revenue was USD 10.8 billion, up 79%, accounting for 36% of total revenue.

The USD 640 million loss is still there; it came from the noncash fair-value change in warrants.

title: 啃苹果省金镯子，牙真能啃齐吗
note: 扎心提问范式；选题来自热点榜cross=2（多让孩子喝苹果能省下一个金镯子）。判断落在家长的正畸焦虑与7岁筛查窗口。
text:
孩子牙不齐，你算过这笔账吗，

多啃苹果多啃玉米，牙就能变齐，省下的正畸费够买个大金镯子。家长群都在传这个。

成都市第七人民医院的口腔科医生说，咀嚼对颌骨发育有辅助刺激，但啃不回已经长歪的牙。2026年那篇系统综述只纳入4项观察研究，因果还没确立。

7岁前后做一次正畸筛查，才是真能省钱的动作。
en_title: Chew apples to save on gold bracelets—can teeth really be straightened?
en_text:
If your child's teeth aren't straight, have you done the math on this?

The more apples and corn they chew, the straighter their teeth will become, and the orthodontics savings could cover a chunky gold bracelet. Parent groups are all passing this around.

A dentist from the dentistry department at Chengdu Seventh People's Hospital said chewing can help stimulate jawbone development, but it can't undo teeth that have already grown crooked. The 2026 systematic review included only four observational studies, so causality has not been established.

Getting an orthodontic screening around age 7 is the move that can actually save money.

title: 赚636亿，现金流负691亿
note: 冷知识范式；选题来自热点榜zhihu排名第一（腾讯Q3季报负自由现金流691亿）。v1第145条已写同事件机制，本条为v2换角度解构，判断落在算力预付款记在经营现金流。
text:
赚636亿，现金流负691亿，

腾讯11月18日盘后的三季报，收入2073亿，权益持有人应占盈利636亿。

难看的是现金流表。经营活动现金净额只有26亿，资本开支付款651亿，媒体内容付款46亿，租赁负债付款20亿。

算力采购的钱记在经营现金流里，把自由现金流拉成了负数。看这个数，得先把算力预付款剔掉。

title: 营收315.92亿，净利只剩7.9亿
note: 全新；骨架=S01数字对撞。上一轮16时场用S08/S12，本轮不重复。用快手Q3营收315.92亿与经调整净利7.9亿对撞，数字均来自官方财报。
text:
营收315.92亿，经调整净利只剩7.9亿。

快手11月19日发的三季报，营收同比降11.1%，日活还涨到了4.173亿。

用户没少，钱却少了八成。

可灵刚发Kling 4.0，研发开支同比涨了41.9%。

营收在掉，AI的钱一分没少花。
en_title: Revenue RMB 31.592 billion, adjusted net profit down to just RMB 790 million
en_text:
Revenue was RMB 31.592 billion, and adjusted net profit was only RMB 790 million.

In Kuaishou's third-quarter report released on November 19, revenue fell 11.1% year over year, while daily active users climbed to 417.3 million.

The user count didn't shrink, but revenue dropped 80%.

Kling had just released Kling 4.0, and R&D spending rose 41.9% year over year.

Revenue is falling, but AI spending hasn't gone down by a cent.

title: 收入在降，有道利润连正了九个季度
note: 全新；骨架=S04单点爆破。上一轮16时场用S08/S12，本轮不重复。用有道连续九季度经营利润为正这个反常数字，来自网易Q3财报。
text:
有道连续九个季度，经营利润都是正的。

网易11月19日的三季报里，有道收入14亿元，同比还在降12.3%。

收入在缩，利润却连正了九个季度。

同一份财报，有道把AI订阅销售额做到了1亿，子鸣双模型登顶了Hugging Face。
en_title: Revenue is falling, but Youdao's operating profit has stayed positive for nine quarters
en_text:
Youdao has recorded positive operating profit for nine consecutive quarters.

In NetEase's third-quarter report on November 19, Youdao's revenue was RMB 1.4 billion, still down 12.3% year over year.

Revenue is shrinking, yet operating profit has remained positive for nine straight quarters.

In the same earnings report, Youdao did RMB 100 million in AI subscription sales, and Ziming's dual models topped Hugging Face.

title: 阿里Q3财报：云单季收入站上600亿，自由现金流净流出344.72亿
note: 全新；阿里2026Q3财报此前列表未记录。AI/芯片/内容平台加权，按深度稿五块结构写透自由现金流与资本开支机制。
text:
阿里这份财报，最值钱的一栏是云。单个季度云收入站上600亿，外部客户增速创了六年新高。营收2715.2亿，同比增10%。数字看着平常，钱在往一处流。

11月19日，阿里发布2027财年第二季度财报。AI云与算力服务收入609.7亿元，同比增53%。阿里云外部商业化收入增64%，上一季度是45%。外部经常性收入增67%。AI相关产品季度收入179.18亿元，连续第十三个季度三位数增长。经调整EBITA增121%，利润率提到14.5%。调整后净利润199.1亿，同比增92%，市场预估是266.1亿。

增长不是靠卖算力设备堆出来的。外部经常性收入那67%才是关键，它来自按量付费和订阅，客户是真在用，不是一次性采购。按量付费意味着用得越多付得越多，收入跟着客户的真实需求走。云这边经调整EBITA能到14.5%的利润率，是因为高毛利的订阅收入占比上来了。

代价在现金流。这个季度资本开支504.77亿元，同比增60%，主要砸向AI基础设施。自由现金流净流出344.72亿元，上年同期净流出218.4亿。利润表上云在赚，现金流量表上云在烧。

下一步看外部商业化收入增速能不能守住60%以上。这个数字从45%跳到64%只用了一个季度，如果下一季回落，说明这轮增长里有一次性成分。真要看的信号是订阅收入占比，不是总收入。
en_title: Alibaba Q3 results: Cloud revenue tops RMB 60 billion in a quarter, free cash flow has a net outflow of RMB 34.472 billion
en_text:
The most valuable line in Alibaba's earnings report is cloud. Cloud revenue surpassed RMB 60 billion in a single quarter, and growth in revenue from external customers hit a six-year high. Revenue was RMB 271.52 billion, up 10% year over year. The numbers look ordinary, but the money is flowing in one direction.

On November 19, Alibaba released its fiscal 2027 second-quarter earnings report. Revenue from AI cloud and computing power services was RMB 60.97 billion, up 53% year over year. Commercial revenue from external customers grew 64%, up from 45% in the prior quarter. Recurring revenue from external customers grew 67%. Quarterly revenue from AI-related products reached RMB 17.918 billion, posting triple-digit growth for the thirteenth consecutive quarter. Adjusted EBITA increased 121%, with the margin reaching 14.5%. Adjusted net profit was RMB 19.91 billion, up 92% year over year, while the market forecast was RMB 26.61 billion.

Growth wasn't achieved by piling on sales of computing hardware. That 67% growth in recurring revenue from external customers is the key. It comes from pay-as-you-go usage and subscriptions; customers are genuinely using the services, not just making one-off purchases. Pay-as-you-go means the more they use, the more they pay, so revenue follows customers' actual demand. The cloud business's adjusted EBITA margin can reach 14.5% because high-margin subscription revenue now accounts for a larger share.

The cost shows up in cash flow. Capital expenditure was RMB 50.477 billion this quarter, up 60% year over year, with most of it going into AI infrastructure. Free cash flow had a net outflow of RMB 34.472 billion, versus a net outflow of RMB 21.84 billion a year earlier. Cloud is making money on the income statement, but burning cash on the cash flow statement.

Next, watch whether growth in commercial revenue from external customers can stay above 60%. This figure jumped from 45% to 64% in just one quarter; if it falls next quarter, it would mean this round of growth had a one-off component. The signal that really matters is the share of subscription revenue, not total revenue.

title: 拼多多Q3营收1083亿持平，净利润295亿
note: 全新；拼多多Q3财报列表未记录。常规稿，反常识点在营收持平靠砍营销费换利润。数字来自官方财报与多家财经媒体。
text:
11月19日，拼多多发布2026年第三季度财报。营收1083亿元，和去年同期的1083亿持平。一分没多。

营业利润312亿元，调整后营业利润326亿。净利润295亿，上年同期是293亿。最有意思的是费用那一项，运营费用319亿，去年是364亿，降了12%，其中销售和营销费用从303亿降到253亿。营收原地不动，利润还在涨，钱是从营销费里省出来的。调整后每ADS收益21.04元，高于市场预估的18.54元。

财报发布后，美股盘前一度拉升逾9%。陈磊说，下半年全球市场的监管、合规和关税政策还在变，带来新挑战。同期经营活动净现金430亿，去年同期457亿。到9月30日，账上现金加短期投资4554亿元。
en_title: PDD Q3 revenue flat at RMB 108.3 billion, net profit RMB 29.5 billion
en_text:
On November 19, PDD released its third-quarter 2026 earnings report. Revenue was RMB 108.3 billion, exactly flat with RMB 108.3 billion in the year-ago quarter. Not a yuan more.

Operating profit was RMB 31.2 billion, and adjusted operating profit was RMB 32.6 billion. Net profit was RMB 29.5 billion, compared with RMB 29.3 billion a year earlier. The most interesting line is expenses: operating expenses fell 12% to RMB 31.9 billion from RMB 36.4 billion a year earlier, with selling and marketing expenses dropping from RMB 30.3 billion to RMB 25.3 billion. Revenue stood still, but profit still rose—the savings came out of marketing spending. Adjusted revenue per ADS was RMB 21.04, above the market forecast of RMB 18.54.

After the earnings release, PDD's shares rose more than 9% in U.S. premarket trading. Chen Lei said regulatory, compliance, and tariff policies in global markets are still changing in the second half of the year, bringing new challenges. Net cash from operating activities was RMB 43 billion, compared with RMB 45.7 billion a year earlier. As of September 30, cash plus short-term investments totaled RMB 455.4 billion.

title: 证监会辟谣监管要求基金上报全部产品AI敞口
note: 全新；热点榜cross=2第一条。官方权威机构动作，证监会答记者问一手口径。快讯。
text:
11月18日，证监会新闻发言人答记者问，说网上那条监管要求基金公司上报全部产品AI敞口的信息不属实。

公募基金怎么投，按证券投资基金法和基金合同来。投什么、投多少，基金管理人按合同和内部决策程序自己定。证监会说，没向基金管理人提过数据报送要求。

11月19日，这条辟谣冲上热搜，两个平台同时在榜，最高热度685.2万。
en_title: CSRC debunks claim that regulators require funds to report AI exposure across all products
en_text:
On November 18, a CSRC spokesperson answered questions from reporters, saying the online report that regulators had required fund companies to report the AI exposure of all products was untrue.

How publicly offered funds are invested should be determined in accordance with the Securities Investment Fund Law and fund contracts. What to invest in and how much to invest are decided by fund managers themselves, based on the contracts and their internal decision-making procedures. The CSRC said it had not imposed any data-reporting requirements on fund managers.

On November 19, the clarification trended, appearing on the trending lists of two platforms simultaneously and peaking at 6.852 million.

title: 天华开物酶设计大模型发布，参数560亿
note: 全新；合成生物领域首个大模型，天津大学联合智谱华章。AI模型类加权，常规稿。数字来自新华社与中新社。
text:
11月19日，合成生物领域第一个大模型在天津大学发布，叫天华开物。参数560亿。

模型由天津大学和北京智谱华章联合攻关。天大2021年启动酶设计模型研发，2024年做出8亿参数基座，2025年到70亿，这次联合智谱扩容到560亿。它把要完成什么生产任务和酶该怎么构成连起来，用反应、序列、结构联合建模。配上天大的自动化实验平台，一周能给出酶设计方案，让三个月内完成菌种定制化构建成为可能。

传统做法是去自然界找酶，反复试验筛选，碰运气。天华开物反过来，先算出来再合成验证，实验数据回流模型继续训练，用得越多算得越准。模型适配国产算力，支持本地私有部署，企业数据不用出厂。

发布会上，中石油、招商局、药明康德、诺和诺德、凯莱英的企业代表到了现场。下一步面向科研和产业界开放试用。
en_title: Tianhua Kaiwu enzyme-design large model released with 56 billion parameters
en_text:
On November 19, the first large model in the field of synthetic biology was released at Tianjin University. It's called Tianhua Kaiwu. It has 56 billion parameters.

The model was developed jointly by Tianjin University and Beijing Zhipu Huazhang. TJU started developing an enzyme-design model in 2021, built an 800-million-parameter foundation model in 2024, scaled it to 7 billion in 2025, and expanded it to 56 billion this time with Zhipu. It links the production task at hand with the composition of the enzyme, jointly modeling reactions, sequences, and structures. Combined with TJU's automated experimental platform, it can produce enzyme designs in a week, making it possible to complete customized strain construction within three months.

The traditional approach is to hunt for enzymes in nature, repeatedly test and screen them, and rely on luck. Tianhua Kaiwu works the other way around: calculate first, then synthesize and validate, with experimental data flowing back into the model for continued training. The more it's used, the more accurately it computes. The model supports domestic computing power and private deployment on local infrastructure, so enterprise data doesn't have to leave the premises.

At the launch, company representatives from PetroChina, China Merchants Group, WuXi AppTec, Novo Nordisk, and Asymchem attended in person. It will next be opened for trial use by the research and industrial sectors.

title: 燧原科技20CM跌停，公告称在手订单充沛
note: 全新；芯片类加权。燧原11月19日异动公告与GPU四小龙下挫此前未记录。常规稿，机制块写清传闻与证伪。数字来自公告与上海证券报。
text:
11月19日，燧原科技20CM跌停，收在364.33元，一天跌掉两成。这是国产GPU四小龙集体挨打的第三天。

公司当晚发异动公告。11月17日到19日三个交易日，收盘价格跌幅偏离值累计超过30%，属于股票交易异常波动。公告说，在手订单充沛，正与多家国内半导体产业伙伴合作，打造基于国产供应链的云端AI芯片。公司自查后表示，不存在该披露没披露的重大事项。

这轮下挫的导火索是传闻。11月18日晚有消息说三星开始穿透严查代工，19日相关概念股受影响的小作文传开。上海证券报19日下午向晶圆代工和芯片设计公司多方求证，说这个传闻不准确。

同一天，摩尔线程跌8.34%，沐曦股份跌14.72%，壁仞科技跌4.02%。四个交易日，燧原累计跌36.16%，沐曦跌28.18%。订单还在，估值先塌了。

燧原最新价364.33元，成交额19.6亿，换手率28.35%。
en_title: Enflame Technology hits the 20% limit-down; announcement says it has ample orders on hand
en_text:
On November 19, Enflame Technology fell by the 20% daily limit and closed at RMB 364.33, shedding a fifth of its value in one day. This was the third day in a row the domestic GPU 'Four Little Dragons' were all being hammered.

The company released an announcement on abnormal stock trading movements that evening. Over the three trading days from November 17 to 19, the cumulative deviation in the closing-price decline exceeded 30%, constituting abnormal fluctuations in stock trading. The announcement said the company has ample orders on hand and is working with multiple domestic semiconductor industry partners to develop cloud AI chips based on a domestic supply chain. A self-check found that there were no undisclosed material matters.

The sell-off was triggered by a rumor. On the evening of November 18, reports emerged that Samsung had begun looking through the chain to conduct strict checks on its foundry business, and on the 19th, short market write-ups about the impact on related concept stocks began spreading. The Shanghai Securities News sought verification from multiple wafer foundries and chip design companies on the afternoon of the 19th and said the rumor was inaccurate.

On the same day, Moore Threads fell 8.34%, MetaX fell 14.72%, and Biren Technology fell 4.02%. Over four trading days, Enflame fell a cumulative 36.16%, while MetaX fell 28.18%. The orders are still there, but the valuations collapsed first.

Enflame's latest price was RMB 364.33, with trading turnover of RMB 1.96 billion and a turnover rate of 28.35%.

title: GTA6发售带火PS5，Pro港版溢价至14579元
note: 部分重叠；第113、146条已写GTA6发售与开分，本条新在PS5硬件端的溢价数字（港版14579元）与全球出货破1亿台。数字来自Sensor Tower与索尼互动娱乐官网。
text:
11月19日凌晨，GTA6发售，先登陆PS5和Xbox，PC版还没有。发售当天，PS5 Pro在第三方平台的价格先涨了。

Sensor Tower估算，预购销售额突破16.5亿美元，数量逾1700万份，约75%来自PlayStation。天猫自营国行PS5 Pro数字版报价9498元，港版14579元，抖音国行10199元，得物国行8099元。索尼官方店相关商品已经售罄。

今年4月索尼刚涨过价，PS5 Pro从5599元提到6299元。索尼官方旗舰店长期售罄，原价6299元基本买不到，三方平台一直在溢价卖。

索尼互动娱乐官网写着，截至11月10日，PS5世代主机全球累计出货突破1亿台。
en_title: GTA6 Release Sparks PS5 Demand; Hong Kong PS5 Pro Premium Hits HK$14,579
en_text:
In the early hours of November 19, GTA6 launched, arriving first on PS5 and Xbox, while the PC version was not out yet. On launch day, PS5 Pro prices on third-party platforms began to rise.

Sensor Tower estimates that preorder sales topped US$1.65 billion and preorder volume exceeded 17 million, about 75% of it coming from PlayStation. Tmall's self-operated store priced the mainland China digital PS5 Pro at RMB 9,498, the Hong Kong version at HK$14,579, the mainland China version on Douyin at RMB 10,199, and the mainland China version on Dewu at RMB 8,099. Sony's official store has sold out the relevant products.

Back in April this year, Sony had just raised prices, bumping the PS5 Pro from RMB 5,599 to RMB 6,299. Sony's official flagship store has long been sold out, so getting one at the original RMB 6,299 price is nearly impossible, while third-party platforms have kept selling at a premium.

According to Sony Interactive Entertainment's official website, as of November 10, global cumulative shipments of PS5-generation consoles had surpassed 100 million units.

title: 苹果糖自由，是新型人情税
note: 热点解构；选题来自热点榜cross=2第二条“冬天的第一个苹果糖”，范式=扎心提问。判断为造节社交压力，非单纯新闻。
text:
苹果糖自由，是新型人情税：

苹果糖上了两个热搜，最高热度358.9万。去年是秋天第一杯奶茶，前年是围炉煮茶。

流程没变。商家换个新名字，平台给一张截图模板，你发朋友圈，证明有人惦记你。

真正的成本不在糖。是你看到别人收到、自己没有的那一下。一份社交KPI，摊到每个人头上是几十块。
en_title: Apple Candy Freedom Is a New Form of Social Tax
en_text:
Apple candy freedom is a new form of social tax:

Apple candy hit two trending topics, peaking at 3.589 million. Last year it was Autumn's First Cup of Milk Tea, and the year before that, Stovetop Tea.

The routine is unchanged. Merchants come up with a new name, the platform provides a screenshot template, and you post it to WeChat Moments to prove that someone is thinking of you.

The real cost isn't the candy. It's that moment when you see that someone else got one and you didn't. It's a social KPI that adds up to tens of yuan per person.

title: 先被优化的，是管理层
note: 热点解构；选题来自热点榜单榜前五“腾讯称未来未必需要那么多管理岗位”（知乎111万），范式=暴论。v1第115条已写腾讯总办讲话，本条在v2换角度给判断。
text:
先被优化的，是管理层：

腾讯总办说，未来不一定要那么多管理岗位。这话从老板嘴里说出来，比裁员通知更值得琢磨。

逻辑不复杂。管理层过去的价值是汇总信息、上传下达。AI把汇总这步做了，传话的人就悬了。

马化腾把这次叫主动增效，上次叫被动降本。名字换了，方向没变。我翻了一遍那篇讲话，最扎心的一句是打破山头主义。
en_title: Management Gets Optimized First
en_text:
Management gets optimized first:

Tencent's executive office says it may not need as many management positions in the future. When that comes from the boss, it is more worth unpacking than a layoff notice.

The logic is not complicated. Management's former value lay in aggregating information and passing it up and down. AI now handles the aggregation, leaving the people who pass messages in limbo.

Pony Ma called this move proactive efficiency enhancement; last time, it was passive cost reduction. The name changed, but the direction did not. I went through that speech, and the most stinging line was “break down silo mentality.”

title: 营收零增长，股价盘前涨了9%
note: 全新；博眼球，骨架=S05反常识断言。上一轮18时场用S01/S04，本轮不重复。用拼多多营收持平但利润上涨换角度，数字来自官方财报。
text:
营收零增长，股价却盘前涨了9%。

直觉会说是有人炒。不对。

第三季度营收1083亿，跟去年一模一样。但销售和营销费用从303亿砍到253亿。

利润295亿，就是这么省出来的。不增长的公司，照样能拿出增长的样子。
en_title: Zero Revenue Growth, but the Stock Rose 9% Premarket
en_text:
Zero revenue growth, yet the stock rose 9% in premarket trading.

Our instinct says someone was pumping the stock. Not so.

Third-quarter revenue was RMB 108.3 billion, exactly the same as last year. But sales and marketing expenses were slashed from RMB 30.3 billion to RMB 25.3 billion.

That was enough to produce RMB 29.5 billion in profit. A company that isn't growing can still look like it is.

title: 跌停20%，大家都说公司出事了
note: 全新；博眼球，骨架=S07借壳反转。上一轮18时场用S01/S04，本轮不重复。用燧原跌停传闻与在手订单充沛对撞，数字来自公司公告与上海证券报。
text:
跌停20%，大家都说公司出事了。

三星穿透严查代工的传闻，18日晚传遍圈子，GPU四小龙一起挨打。

燧原当晚公告，在手订单充沛，正跟多家国内半导体伙伴合作。上海证券报求证后说，那传闻不准确。

订单没塌，先塌的是估值。四个交易日，累计跌了36.16%。
en_title: Down 20% at the Limit; Everyone Says the Company Is in Trouble
en_text:
The stock hit the 20% limit-down, and everyone said something had gone wrong at the company.

On the evening of the 18th, rumors that Samsung had launched a deep investigation into foundry outsourcing spread through the industry, hitting all four of the GPU “Four Dragons.”

Enflame announced that night that it had a healthy pipeline of orders and was working with several domestic semiconductor partners. After checking the claim, Shanghai Securities News said the rumor was inaccurate.

The orders didn't collapse. The valuations did first. Over four trading days, they fell a cumulative 36.16%.

title: 比亚迪发布折叠智舱，折叠方向盘10秒量产
note: 全新；比亚迪11月19日晚发布折叠智舱、折叠方向盘首搭方程豹钛9，多信源交叉，做深度稿。
text:
比亚迪把折叠方向盘量产了。11月19日晚，方程豹总经理熊甜波发布折叠智舱，首搭方程豹钛9。一个2016年就有人提出、卡了十年的概念，现在装进了32.99万元的车里。

折叠智舱包含线控转向、线控制动、主驾躺平座椅和折叠方向盘。官方说法是边泊车边折叠，10秒完成。为了这套动作，比亚迪第一次把具身智能机器人用的同款电机放进了汽车，整个系统历时36个月。

真正卡住折叠方向盘的是一根管柱。传统方向盘和车轮之间连着机械转向管柱，方向盘不能乱动，主驾空间就被这根柱子锁死。线控转向切断机械连接，转向变成电信号，方向盘才有了折叠和收纳的余地。电机负责折，线控负责让它敢折。熊甜波把这套东西定义为给L3、L4时代做的储备，人一旦不用盯着路况，驾驶位就不必永远保持坐姿。

代价落在量和价上。首搭车型钛9折叠智舱版卖32.99万元，比另外两个版本贵。这是比亚迪今年第三张技术牌，前两张是3月的二代刀片电池闪充和5月28日的智驾兜底。两张牌都在铺量，第三张先讲空间。

接下来看两件事。智驾法规什么时候允许人在行驶中躺平，线控转向的可靠性能不能过验证。比亚迪说它的辅助驾驶车型保有量到了419万辆，每天新增2.6亿公里道路数据。这些数据能不能撑起L3，决定这套座椅有没有机会真正躺下去。
en_title: BYD Unveils Foldable Smart Cockpit; Mass-Produced Folding Steering Wheel Folds in 10 Seconds
en_text:
BYD has put the folding steering wheel into mass production. On the evening of November 19, Fangchengbao general manager Xiong Tianbo unveiled the Foldable Smart Cockpit, which will debut first on the Fangchengbao Tai 9. A concept proposed in 2016 and stuck for ten years is now fitted in a car costing RMB 329,900.

The Foldable Smart Cockpit includes steer-by-wire, brake-by-wire, a driver's seat that reclines fully flat, and a folding steering wheel. Officially, it folds while the vehicle is parking and completes the motion in 10 seconds. To make this sequence possible, BYD put the same motor used in embodied-AI robots into a car for the first time; the entire system took 36 months to develop.

What had really been blocking the folding steering wheel was a steering column. Traditional steering wheels and wheels are connected by a mechanical steering column, so the steering wheel cannot move around, locking the driver's space. Steer-by-wire cuts the mechanical connection and turns steering into an electrical signal, creating room for the wheel to fold and stow. The motor handles the folding; the by-wire system gives it the freedom to fold. Xiong Tianbo framed the system as groundwork for the L3 and L4 era: once the driver no longer has to watch the road, the driving position no longer needs to remain a seated posture.

The trade-off comes down to volume and price. The first model, the Tai 9 Foldable Smart Cockpit Edition, sells for RMB 329,900, making it more expensive than the other two versions. This is BYD's third technology card of the year. The first two were second-generation Blade Battery flash charging in March and the intelligent-driving fallback on May 28. Both earlier cards are aimed at scaling up, while the third starts with space.

Two things to watch next. When will intelligent-driving regulations allow people to recline while the vehicle is moving, and can steer-by-wire reliability pass validation? BYD says its installed base of assisted-driving vehicles has reached 4.19 million, with 260 million kilometers of road data added daily. Whether that data can support L3 will determine whether the seat has any chance of truly lying flat.

title: 谷歌选定蓝色起源2029年发射太空AI数据中心
note: 全新；谷歌11月19日与蓝色起源签发射协议，太空AI数据中心首次记录，深度稿。
text:
谷歌要把数据中心发射到天上。11月19日，它和蓝色起源签了发射协议，用新格伦重型火箭，在2029年第一季度把Project Suncatcher的卫星送进太阳同步轨道。谷歌说每颗卫星的计算能力相当于一个数据中心机架。

Suncatcher靠太阳能供电，芯片是谷歌自己的TPU。这批卫星要在近地轨道组网，谷歌给出的能源理由是阳光。近地轨道几乎照到恒定光照，同样的太阳能板，在那里拿到的电最高是地面的8倍。这次是新格伦第一次为这个项目做专属重型发射，它对近地轨道的运力是45吨，整流罩7米，一级设计复用至少25次。

把算力搬上天，账要这么算。地面数据中心的成本大头是电和散热，轨道上电几乎白拿，问题全跑到散热和通信上。真空里没有空气对流，芯片的热只能靠热管和散热器慢慢辐射出去，谷歌在热真空舱里反复测过。卫星之间要用激光通信，集群要高速互联，就得精确知道每一颗相对邻居的位置。这套东西跑通的前提，是先把单颗卫星在轨能不能稳定干活验证完。

谷歌自己把这个项目叫moonshot，离客户能用的服务还远。它没说新格伦这次带几颗卫星，也没说发射花多少钱。没有这两个数，这次部署的总算力和单位成本都算不出来。火箭只是第一步，离一个能在轨运转的数据中心还差着散热、通信和辐射验证几道关。

真正的进度条写在2027年。谷歌的原型卫星2026年10月1日上天，10月30日完成TPU加电，机上的Gemma 4生成过一首俳句，这是数据中心级TPU在轨道上的第一次AI响应。下一步是两颗卫星互联。能不能连起来，决定Suncatcher是一个个孤立的机器，还是一张能干活的网。
en_title: Google Chooses Blue Origin to Launch Space-Based AI Data Centers in 2029
en_text:
Google wants to launch data centers into space. On November 19, it signed a launch agreement with Blue Origin to use the New Glenn heavy rocket to send Project Suncatcher satellites into a sun-synchronous orbit in the first quarter of 2029. Google says each satellite has computing power equivalent to a data center rack.

Suncatcher runs on solar power, and its chips are Google's own TPUs. This fleet of satellites is set to form a network in low Earth orbit, with sunlight as Google's stated reason for choosing that orbit. Low Earth orbit receives nearly constant sunlight, and the same solar panels can generate up to 8 times as much power there as they can on the ground. This will be New Glenn's first dedicated heavy launch for the project. It can lift 45 tons to low Earth orbit, has a 7-meter fairing, and its first stage is designed for at least 25 reuses.

Moving compute into space means the economics have to work like this. For a ground data center, the biggest costs are electricity and cooling. In orbit, electricity is nearly free, but the problems shift to cooling and communications. There is no air convection in a vacuum, so the chips' heat can only slowly radiate away through heat pipes and radiators. Google has repeatedly tested this in thermal-vacuum chambers. The satellites will need laser links with one another, and the cluster needs high-speed interconnection, which requires precisely tracking each satellite's position relative to its neighbors. Before any of this can work, Google has to verify that a single satellite can operate reliably in orbit.

Google itself calls the project a moonshot, and it is still far from a service customers can use. It did not say how many satellites New Glenn will carry on this launch or how much the launch will cost. Without those two numbers, neither the project's total computing capacity nor its unit cost can be calculated. The rocket is only the first step; an orbital data center still has to clear several hurdles in cooling, communications, and radiation validation.

The real milestone is 2027. Google's prototype satellite launched on October 1, 2026, powered up its TPU on October 30, and had onboard Gemma 4 generate a haiku—the first AI response from a data center-class TPU in orbit. The next step is connecting two satellites. Whether they can connect will determine whether Suncatcher is a collection of isolated machines or a working network.

title: 腾讯业绩会砍元宝投入，WorkBuddy登顶
note: 部分重叠；腾讯Q3财报已发（第145/186条），本条新在11月18日业绩会刘炽平明确砍元宝投入、WorkBuddy登顶与使用量数据。
text:
腾讯在业绩会上把元宝的描述改了口径。11月18日三季度说明会，总裁刘炽平说元宝没有达到最初预期，投入已经大幅削减，重点从扩用户转向提能力。

同一场会上，他花更多篇幅讲另外两个产品。按token消耗量算，WorkBuddy已经是腾讯使用量最高的AI产品。最近七天收入按年化折算超过5亿美元，是腾讯会议的两倍以上，三季度收入是二季度的五倍以上。中国前100大企业里，60%成了它的客户。

腾讯没在平均用力。跑不出数据的元宝被砍，钱压到跑得出数据的产品上。元宝初期靠拉新，WorkBuddy和小微走的是token消耗加订阅。小微日活到了3000万，微信里的触点超过30个。刘炽平说小微用小模型控成本，即便全量开放，一个季度的成本还是低于元宝年初的水平。

钱的问题也摆上了台面。腾讯三季度资本开支814.33亿元，同比增长527%。管理层说算力合同基本签完，单季开支已经大致处在峰值，2028年采购价格会明显下降。
en_title: Tencent Cuts Yuanbao Investment at Earnings Call as WorkBuddy Takes the Top Spot
en_text:
At its earnings call, Tencent changed how it described Yuanbao. On November 18, at its Q3 briefing, President Martin Lau said Yuanbao had not met its initial expectations, investment had been sharply cut, and the focus had shifted from acquiring users to improving capabilities.

At the same call, he spent more time discussing two other products. By token consumption, WorkBuddy is now Tencent's most-used AI product. Annualizing revenue from the past seven days puts it at more than $500 million—more than twice that of Tencent Meeting—and Q3 revenue is more than five times Q2 revenue. 60% of China's top 100 companies have become its customers.

Tencent isn't spreading its bets evenly. Yuanbao, which wasn't producing results, got cut, and the money was shifted to the products that were. Yuanbao initially relied on user acquisition, while WorkBuddy and Xiaowei follow a model of token consumption plus subscriptions. Xiaowei's daily active users have reached 30 million, with more than 30 touchpoints inside WeChat. Martin Lau said Xiaowei uses smaller models to control costs, and even with a full rollout, its quarterly cost will still be below Yuanbao's level at the beginning of the year.

The money question was also brought to the table. Tencent's Q3 capital expenditures were RMB 81.433 billion, up 527% year over year. Management said compute contracts have essentially all been signed, quarterly spending is roughly at its peak, and procurement prices will drop significantly in 2028.

title: 阿里净利涨213%，自由现金流净流出344.72亿
note: 热点解构；范式=暴论。榜单cross2（360.4万），角度放在净利213%与自由现金流净流出344.72亿的背离。
text:
利润翻倍，钱却往外流：

阿里三季度净利润644.2亿元，同比涨213%。

同一份财报，自由现金流净流出344.72亿元。

利润大头来自投资净收益，云基础设施还在往外掏钱。
en_title: Alibaba's Net Profit Jumps 213%, but Free Cash Flow Sees a Net Outflow of RMB 34.472 Billion
en_text:
Profit doubled, but cash flowed out:

Alibaba's Q3 net profit was RMB 64.42 billion, up 213% year over year.

In the same earnings report, free cash flow had a net outflow of RMB 34.472 billion.

Most of the profit came from net investment gains, while cloud infrastructure was still burning cash.

title: 折叠方向盘藏十年，卡在一根机械管柱
note: 热点解构；范式=冷知识。榜单cross2榜首（742.9万），角度放在折叠概念2016年就提出、为何卡十年才量产。
text:
方向盘藏了十年，卡在一根柱子：

折叠方向盘的概念2016年就有人提，一直没能量产。

挡路的是方向盘和车轮之间那根机械转向管柱。

线控把机械连接换成电信号，方向盘才敢折进内饰。
en_title: Folding Steering Wheel Shelved for Ten Years, Blocked by a Mechanical Column
en_text:
The folding steering wheel sat on the shelf for ten years, blocked by a single column:

The idea for a folding steering wheel was proposed in 2016, but it never reached mass production.

The obstacle was the mechanical steering column connecting the steering wheel to the wheels.

Steer-by-wire replaces the mechanical connection with electrical signals, giving the steering wheel the freedom to fold into the interior.

title: 腾讯砍元宝，另一AI产品七天进账5亿美元
note: 博眼球；骨架=S04单点爆破。上一轮20时场用S05/S07，本轮不重复；数字来自腾讯业绩会。
text:
腾讯砍了元宝，另一产品七天进账5亿美元。

这个数按年化折算，已经是腾讯会议的两倍以上。

同一个季度，钱从拉新的产品撤出，压到了卖token的产品上。
en_title: Tencent axes Yuanbao; another AI product rakes in $500 million in seven days
en_text:
Tencent has cut Yuanbao, while another AI product raked in $500 million in seven days.

On an annualized basis, that figure is already more than double Tencent Meeting's.

In the same quarter, money was pulled out of the product used to attract new users and pushed into the token-selling product.

title: 把数据中心发射上天，做成了航天生意
note: 博眼球；骨架=S11反差猎奇。上一轮20时场用S05/S07，本轮不重复；数字来自谷歌Suncatcher公告。
text:
把数据中心发射上天，用的是运火箭的生意。

谷歌找蓝色起源，用新格伦火箭把TPU卫星送往太阳同步轨道。

一是2029年第一季度发射，二是每颗卫星算力顶一个机架，三是靠太阳能供电。

可算力生意，做成了航天生意。
en_title: Launching data centers into space turned it into an aerospace business
en_text:
Launching data centers into space means getting into the launch-vehicle business.

Google turned to Blue Origin, using the New Glenn rocket to send TPU satellites into sun-synchronous orbit.

First, the launch is in Q1 2029. Second, the computing power of each satellite matches that of one rack. Third, it is powered by solar energy.

A computing-power business became an aerospace business.

title: 英伟达财报里几个让人后背发凉的数字
note: 照抄 X20 数据罗列体：定调句+六条编号+收尾私货，段落与原帖一一对应
text:
英伟达财报里几个让人后背发凉的数字：

1、翻倍：营收1158.44亿美元，同比增长103.21%，净利润652.87亿美元。

2、蒸发：市值一夜蒸发1085亿美元，总市值从3.75万亿掉到3.64万亿。

3、跌出坑：收盘150.96美元，跌2.89%，五连跌，创2025年6月以来最低。距52周高点243.37美元，回撤了38%。

4、机构跑：伯恩斯坦、Evercore、瑞银，同一天下调评级或目标价。瑞银三天里第二次砍，从240砍到220；市值一天蒸发1085亿美元，折合人民币超过7200亿，比一个创业板龙头的全年利润还多。

5、换帅：董事会主席哈维·琼斯明确不打算让黄仁勋回来，已经开始让猎头物色新CEO。临时CEO克雷斯把加薪和额外股权提前到12月发。股价跌到148.8美元的时候，管理层在开全员大会。

6、别人的盘：同一天AMD涨5.31%，亚马逊涨3.82%，博通涨超3%。纳指涨0.42%。

业绩是真的好，股价是真的不认，不过我觉得谷歌迟早会追上来。
en_title: Several numbers in NVIDIA's earnings report that make your spine go cold
en_text:
Several numbers in NVIDIA's earnings report that make your spine go cold:

1. Doubled: revenue reached $115.844 billion, up 103.21% year over year, while net profit came to $65.287 billion.

2. Vanished: it lost $108.5 billion in market value overnight, with total market cap falling from $3.75 trillion to $3.64 trillion.

3. Out of the hole: it closed at $150.96, down 2.89%, falling for a fifth straight session and hitting its lowest level since June 2025. That was 38% below the 52-week high of $243.37.

4. Institutions bailed: Bernstein, Evercore, and UBS all downgraded their ratings or price targets on the same day. UBS made its second cut in three days, lowering the target from $240 to $220. The company lost $108.5 billion in market value in one day, equivalent to more than RMB 720 billion, more than the full-year profit of a leading ChiNext stock.

5. Change at the top: Board chair Harvey Jones made it clear that he has no intention of bringing Jensen Huang back and has already begun having headhunters look for a new CEO. Interim CEO Kress moved salary increases and additional equity payments forward to December. When the stock fell to $148.8, management was holding an all-hands meeting.

6. Someone else's game: on the same day, AMD rose 5.31%, Amazon rose 3.82%, and Broadcom rose more than 3%. Nasdaq rose 0.42%.

The earnings are genuinely strong, but the stock price genuinely isn't buying it. Still, I think Google will eventually catch up.

title: 盯了三个月A股，才发现自己是冤种
note: 照抄 X09 冤种体：卧槽+反转+天天+结果+二选一提问，六段原样
text:
卧槽！

盯了三个月A股，最后发现自己才是最大的冤种！

天天研究怎么抄底超跌的板块，各种政策预期、ETF份额、北向资金看得个不停。

结果港股科技一个月都没落下，今天又给银行股贡献了护盘行情，账户还是绿的。

你们现在还舍得抄底A股吗？

还是已经转投银行了？
en_title: After watching A-shares for three months, I realized I was the biggest sucker
en_text:
Holy shit!

After watching A-shares for three months, I finally realized that I was the biggest sucker of them all!

Every day, I researched how to bottom-fish oversold sectors, endlessly poring over policy expectations, ETF shares, and northbound capital flows.

Instead, I chased Hong Kong tech every day for a month, and today I even joined the bank-stock support rally, yet my account is still in the red.

Are you still willing to bottom-fish A-shares now?

Or have you already switched to banks?

title: 这绝对是我见过最凶残的定价外挂
note: 照抄 X14 情绪加压体：绝对化断言+但+后果+杀出+思路极其XX，五段原样
text:
这绝对是我见过最凶残的资产定价外挂！

en_title: This Is Definitely the Most Brutal Pricing Exploit I've Ever Seen
en_text:
This is absolutely the most brutally exploitative asset-pricing setup I've ever seen!

Every day they keep saying inflation will come back down and the rate-hike cycle will end, but once the Fed minutes come out, who dares actually bet on rate cuts?

With just the slightest deviation, the 10-year Treasury gets dumped from 5.09% back to 5.06%, spot gold plunges more than 3%, and Bitcoin follows it down 2% to 62400.

The Fed just dropped a hawkish signal: an extraordinary rate hike.
Its playbook is extremely blunt—no slowly walking you through how inflation will evolve. First, it slaps this statement on the table: almost all participants thought that raising rates further might be appropriate.

The US Dollar Index surges to a 19-month high, while the 10-year Treasury oscillates in a five-year-high range of 5.06% to 5.09%. And the one saying this is not the Chair.

title: 数据中心用电，算出了650条人命
note: 全新事件，列表与内置清单均无；多家独立信源（MIT News及多家转载）；深度稿
text:
MIT把数据中心的电费，算成了650条人命。

11月19日，这份研究发在Environmental Research Letters上。麻省理工团队建模估算，2023年美国数据中心用电带来的额外空气污染，造成约650例过早死亡。513例来自PM2.5，137例来自雾霾，占全美电力相关死亡总数的5.3%。

每度电的账，不是记在机房门口的。研究团队盯的是电网怎么响应。机房多要一度电，调度就可能多启动一台天然气机组，有些时段是烧煤的。这些机组排出氮氧化物和二氧化硫，在空气里变成细颗粒和臭氧。

全美电网有一万多台发电机。团队把每台每小时发多少电、排多少污都建进模型，再套一个化学传输模型，看污染物往哪飘。

飘到哪，和机房在哪，基本是两回事。用电需求大半集中在弗吉尼亚北部和得州，过早死亡率最高的却是爱荷华、内华达、南达科他、堪萨斯。俄亥俄河谷的老机组被调起来供弗吉尼亚，风再把污染物送到下风向。农业州的化肥氨气，又帮着在空气里合成PM2.5。

农村人口的风险，明显高于城市。住在机房旁边，未必是最倒霉的那个。

研究也有没算的部分。机房自建电厂供电越来越常见，这次没纳进去。机房按负荷高低灵活调整用电会不会改变空气质量，同样没算。下一版把这两块补进模型，结论才算完整。
en_title: Data Centers’ Electricity Use Adds Up to 650 Lives Lost
en_text:
MIT translated the electricity bill for data centers into 650 lives lost.

On November 19, this study was published in Environmental Research Letters. A team from MIT used modeling to estimate that the additional air pollution caused by data center electricity use in the United States in 2023 resulted in approximately 650 premature deaths. Of those, 513 were attributable to PM2.5 and 137 to haze, accounting for 5.3% of all electricity-related deaths nationwide.

The bill for every kilowatt-hour does not stop at the door of the data center. The research team focused on how the power grid responds. Whenever a data center needs one more kilowatt-hour, grid dispatchers may start up another natural gas unit, and at certain times, a coal-fired unit. These plants emit nitrogen oxides and sulfur dioxide, which turn into fine particulate matter and ozone in the air.

The United States has more than 10,000 power generators. The team modeled how much electricity each one generates per hour and how much pollution it emits, then added a chemical transport model to see where the pollutants drifted.

Where the pollution drifts and where the data center is located are largely two different things. Much of the demand is concentrated in Northern Virginia and Texas, yet Iowa, Nevada, South Dakota, and Kansas had the highest premature mortality rates. Older generating units in the Ohio River Valley were ramped up to serve Virginia, and the wind carried the pollutants downwind. Ammonia from agricultural fertilizers helped form PM2.5 in the air.

The risk to rural populations was clearly higher than the risk to urban populations. Living next to a data center does not necessarily mean you are the unluckiest person.

The study also left some factors out. It did not include the increasingly common practice of data centers building their own power plants. Nor did it calculate whether flexing electricity demand according to data center load could change air quality. A future version will need to add both to the model before its conclusions can be considered complete.

title: AMD一天跌掉11%，做空的人点了名
note: 此前11-18记录为AMD涨5.31%，本次新在11-19跌超11%创11月9日以来新低、Hunterbrook公开宣布做空，方向反转
text:
前一天还在涨的AMD，11月19日跌了超过11%。

盘中跌幅一度扩到11%，股价创下11月9日以来的最低点。把它摁下去的是Hunterbrook，一家做空机构，当天公开宣布做空AMD，卖盘随即涌进来。

把时间往前拨一天，画面正好翻过来。那天AMD涨5.31%，收在530.14美元，同一天英伟达跌2.89%，一夜蒸发1085亿美元市值。钱从英伟达出来，有一部分转手买进了AMD。

隔了一天，避险的地方自己也挨了一刀。做空的完整报告还没见到，股价先跌了11%。先把价格砸下去，再慢慢讲理由，这套顺序在美股不罕见。

AMD接下来要回应的，是做空报告里到底写了什么。
en_title: AMD Fell 11% in a Day, and the Short Seller Named AMD
en_text:
AMD, which had been rising the day before, fell more than 11% on November 19.

Intraday losses briefly widened to 11%, and the stock touched its lowest level since November 9. The force pushing it down was Hunterbrook, a short-selling firm that publicly announced it was shorting AMD that day; selling pressure immediately flooded in.

Wind the clock back one day and the picture flips. That day, AMD rose 5.31% and closed at $530.14. On the same day, NVIDIA fell 2.89%, wiping out $108.5 billion in market cap overnight. Some of the money coming out of NVIDIA went into AMD.

Just a day later, the safe-haven itself took a hit. The full short report hadn't surfaced yet, but the stock had already fallen 11%. Smash the price first, then slowly explain your reasoning—this sequence is not uncommon in U.S. stocks.

What AMD needs to answer next is what the short report actually says.

title: 营收没涨，拼多多股价却涨了12%

en_title: PDD's Revenue Didn't Grow, but Its Stock Price Rose 12%
en_text:
PDD's revenue increased by not a single cent, yet its stock price rose 12%.

During trading on November 19, PDD was quoted at $86.91, up as much as 12.21%, with a total market cap of $123.6 billion. There was little to celebrate in the earnings report itself: third-quarter revenue was RMB108.3 billion, exactly unchanged from last year. The reason for the rally wasn't revenue.

Net profit of RMB29.5 billion was the first layer. Cuts to marketing expenses saved money, which was the second layer. On the same day, the Livermore China Leaders Index gained 2%, and PDD was the strongest riser among its constituents.

Revenue stayed put while the stock price moved higher. In between were the cut in marketing expenses and a ledger that still had RMB29.5 billion on the books.

title: MIT那份数据中心研究，几个数字挺吓人的
note: 照抄X20（骨架编号X20）；数字来自11-19公开的MIT研究；按栏目分组v3首次写此事件
text:
MIT那份数据中心研究里，几个数字挺吓人的：

1、总数：2023年美国数据中心用电带来的污染，造成约650例过早死亡。

2、来源：513例来自PM2.5，另外137例来自雾霾。

3、占比：这650例，占全美电力相关死亡总数的5.3%。

4、错位：用电大头在弗吉尼亚北部和得州，死亡率最高的却是爱荷华、内华达、南达科他、堪萨斯。

5、用电：劳伦斯伯克利算过，2023年数据中心吃掉全美约4%的电，排出约4.4%的污染。

6、模型：全美一万多台发电机，逐小时建模，才算出这笔账。

数字摆在这儿，机房建在哪这个老问题，怕是要重新掂量了。
en_title: Some of the Numbers in MIT's Data Center Study Are Pretty Alarming
en_text:
Some of the numbers in MIT's data center study are pretty alarming:

1. Total: Pollution caused by U.S. data center electricity use in 2023 resulted in roughly 650 premature deaths.

2. Source: 513 came from PM2.5 and another 137 from smog.

3. Share: These 650 deaths accounted for 5.3% of all electricity-related deaths nationwide.

4. Mismatch: Most electricity demand was in Northern Virginia and Texas, yet the highest premature-death rates were in Iowa, Nevada, South Dakota, and Kansas.

5. Electricity use: Lawrence Berkeley calculated that in 2023 data centers consumed about 4% of all U.S. electricity and produced about 4.4% of the pollution.

6. Model: More than 10,000 generators across the country were modeled hour by hour to arrive at this tally.

With these numbers laid out, the old question of where to build data centers may have to be reconsidered.

title: 吴泳铭：未来绝大部分模型训练将依托国产芯片
note: 与已记录阿里Q3财报数字不同，本条新增平头哥三代GPU路线图、2027Q1支持超大规模训练、千问已在平头哥训练下一代模型及绝大部分模型训练依托国产芯片表态。
text:
阿里要把模型训练的底座换成自己的芯片。

11月19日晚的2027财年二季度电话会上，CEO吴泳铭说，未来不管阿里自己还是合作伙伴、客户，绝大部分模型的预训练都完全依赖国产芯片。

这不是远景，千问已经在平头哥上开始训练下一代模型。

路线图给到了具体年份。吴泳铭披露平头哥三代GPU产品，今年真武M890全面上线，2027年V900、2028年J900的生产供应链全面推进并进入大规模量产。他判断2027年一季度，新一代平头哥芯片完全可以支持超大规模模型训练。

财报口径上，阿里云单季收入站上600亿，2031财年云外部收入1000亿美元、利润率超20%的目标不变；下一个财年增速指引落在30%到45%，2028年重新恢复50%以上增长，2028年下半年现金流转正。

钱是怎么流的，才是这句话的重点。阿里Q3自由现金流净流出344.72亿，算力采购预付款压在经营现金流里。自研芯片替代外采，省下的是英伟达那部分溢价，叠加规模放量后，云业务利润率能被拉正。

吴泳铭把账算到了2028年下半年现金流转正这一天，前提就是国产芯片供应链按计划扩量。百炼已经基于国产芯片跑推理，训练和推理两头都切到自家栈上，单位算力成本才会往下走。

代价写在指引里。下一个财年增速被压到30%到45%，吴泳铭给的理由是全球算力出口管制会影响明年产品、供应链不确定性太大。切换国产芯片的头几年，阿里的算力供给要先过产能爬坡这一关，千问的迭代节奏得跟着平头哥的产线走。

自研芯片和自研模型深度协同是真优势，可把模型命运绑在一条还没满产的产线上，代价也不小。

可验证的信号是2027年一季度。到那时平头哥新一代芯片若真能撑起超大规模训练，阿里对英伟达的采购依赖会先在下一年新增芯片里体现出来。

盯平头哥V900的量产进度和阿里云资本开支口径的变化，比听表态管用。
en_title: Wu Yongming: Most Model Training in the Future Will Rely on Domestically Produced Chips
en_text:
Alibaba plans to make its own chips the foundation of model training.

On the fiscal 2027 second-quarter earnings call on the evening of November 19, CEO Wu Yongming said that in the future, whether it was Alibaba itself or its partners and customers, the pretraining of the vast majority of models would rely entirely on domestically produced chips.

This isn't a distant prospect. Qwen has already begun training its next-generation model on T-Head.

The roadmap includes specific years. Wu Yongming disclosed that the third-generation T-Head GPU product, Zhenwu M890, will be fully rolled out this year, while the production supply chains for the V900 in 2027 and the J900 in 2028 will be fully ramped up and enter mass production. He expects that in the first quarter of 2027, the next-generation T-Head chips will be fully capable of supporting hyperscale model training.

In its financial reporting, Alibaba Cloud's quarterly revenue topped RMB60 billion. Its targets for fiscal 2031—$100 billion in external cloud revenue and a profit margin above 20%—remain unchanged. Growth guidance for the next fiscal year is 30% to 45%, growth is expected to return to above 50% in 2028, and cash flow is expected to turn positive in the second half of 2028.

Where the money flows is the real point of that statement. Alibaba's free cash flow showed a net outflow of RMB34.472 billion in Q3, with advance payments for computing-power purchases weighing on operating cash flow. Replacing purchased chips with in-house chips saves the NVIDIA markup, and once volumes scale up, that can pull the cloud business's profit margin back into positive territory.

Wu Yongming has run the numbers through to the day cash flow turns positive in the second half of 2028, provided the domestic-chip supply chain ramps up as planned. Bailian is already running inference on domestically produced chips, and with both training and inference moved onto its own stack, unit computing costs can come down.

The cost is written into the guidance. Growth guidance for the next fiscal year was squeezed down to 30% to 45%. Wu Yongming blamed global computing-power export controls, which will affect next year's products, saying supply-chain uncertainty is too large. In the first years of switching to domestically produced chips, Alibaba's computing supply will first have to get through the capacity-ramp-up stage, and Qwen's iteration pace will have to follow T-Head's production line.

Deep coordination between in-house chips and in-house models is a genuine advantage, but tying the models' fate to a production line that has not yet reached full capacity comes at a considerable cost.

The verifiable signal is the first quarter of 2027. By then, if T-Head's next-generation chips really can support hyperscale training, the change in Alibaba's reliance on NVIDIA purchases should first show up in the additional chips procured the following year.

Watching the mass-production progress of T-Head's V900 and changes in Alibaba Cloud's capex metrics is more useful than listening to statements.

title: OpenAI 把 ChatGPT 的性能排查交给了 agent
note: 全新事件，OpenAI 首次披露 Performance Factory 机制与1700/600/17等实测数据。
text:
ChatGPT 变慢这件事，OpenAI 已经交给 agent 去查了。

11月19日的工程博客里，这家公司第一次完整讲了内部系统 Performance Factory，一套由 Codex 驱动的工作流，自动找性能回归、写修复方案、再验证恢复。

第一个正式工作流叫 Regression Workflow，流程很短。性能告警触发任务，agent 查指标、翻 trace、比对最近的部署，把结论写进任务，提出修复方案供工程师审阅；修复部署后，另一个 agent 接手同一个任务，确认性能是否回到基线。

上线三个多月，它跟踪了1700多次调查，为其中600多起找到根因，平均每天17次。同一份数据还有后半段，600多起里约400起推进到修复方案，真正上线的约50个，其中约15个是 Codex 直接写出的 PR。

关键在于任务怎么在 agent 和人之间接力。OpenAI 把调查方法写成共享 skill，叫 perf-forensics，告诉 Codex 有哪些工具、什么时候用、按什么顺序排查。

这个 skill 拿历史回归案例做过 evals 校准，之后丢一个告警过去，一次运行就能拿到诊断。系统拆成四块，任务服务、调度循环、云端 Codex、订阅。

任务保存自己的状态和发现，所以工作能在不同 agent 和工程师之间交接，代码评审或部署之后还能接着往下走。调度循环定期检查哪些任务可以进入下一步，给它们分配 agent。

订阅负责唤醒，任务在等 GitHub 评论或等部署完成时先挂起，事件到了再叫醒。

agent 踩过的坑也写进博客了。它有时会停在第一个看起来合理的解释上，OpenAI 因此加了一道对抗性复核，让一个全新上下文的 Codex 会话去挑毛病、核证据，这道复核会把约25%的诊断打回重查。

边界很清楚，原因明确、修复局部的场景，Codex 表现最好；新功能引入的延迟需要动架构，agent 就容易给出过于复杂的方案，加了缓存反而读到旧数据。

真正的瓶颈现在卡在等人 review、等人合并。

OpenAI 说让 agent 自己完成合并还在探索。下一步是主动发现，不等告警，自己去比对不同版本的 CPU 和内存 profile，发现某类请求 CPU 小幅上涨就开任务、提 PR。

这套能力目前都还在计划里，看它什么时候变成已上线，比看调查数量更能说明问题。
en_title: OpenAI handed ChatGPT performance troubleshooting to agents
en_text:
OpenAI has handed the investigation into ChatGPT slowing down over to agents.

In its November 19 engineering blog post, the company gave its first full explanation of its internal Performance Factory system, a Codex-powered workflow that automatically finds performance regressions, writes remediation plans, and then verifies recovery.

The first production workflow is called Regression Workflow, and the process is short. A performance alert triggers the task; the agent checks metrics, digs through traces, compares recent deployments, writes its conclusions in the task, and proposes a fix for an engineer to review; once the fix is deployed, another agent picks up the same task and confirms whether performance is back at baseline.

Over the three-plus months since launch, it has tracked more than 1700 investigations, found root causes for more than 600, and averaged 17 a day. The same data has a second half: of the 600-plus cases, roughly 400 moved on to a remediation plan, only around 50 actually made it live, and around 15 of those PRs were written directly by Codex.

The key is how tasks get handed off between agents and humans. OpenAI wrote the investigation methodology into a shared skill called perf-forensics, which tells Codex what tools it has, when to use them, and what order to investigate in.

The skill was calibrated against historical regression cases using evals; now, toss in an alert and a single run yields a diagnosis. The system breaks into four parts: the task service, scheduler loop, cloud Codex, and subscriptions.

Each task stores its own state and findings, so work can be handed off between different agents and engineers and continue after code review or deployment. The scheduler loop periodically checks which tasks are ready for the next step and assigns agents.

The subscription service handles wake-ups: when a task is waiting for a GitHub comment or a deployment to finish, it stays suspended, then wakes when the event arrives.

The pitfalls agents encountered were also documented in the blog. They sometimes stop at the first plausible explanation, so OpenAI added an adversarial review that sends a brand-new-context Codex session to look for flaws and verify the evidence; this review sends roughly 25% of diagnoses back for another look.

The boundaries are clear: Codex performs best when the cause is obvious and the fix is local; when latency introduced by a new feature requires architectural changes, agents tend to propose overcomplicated solutions, and adding a cache can make them read stale data.

The real bottleneck now sits with waiting for people to review and merge.

OpenAI says letting agents complete the merge themselves is still being explored. Next up is proactive discovery: instead of waiting for an alert, it compares CPU and memory profiles across versions, opens a task, and proposes a PR when it detects a slight CPU increase for a certain class of requests.

This entire capability is still on the drawing board; when it actually ships will say more than the number of investigations.

title: 海外云通道关掉后，1.5亿美元的算力合同先黄了
note: 出口管制大事件此前已记录，本次新在交易层面瓦解：Moonshot取消印尼1.5亿美元合同、预付50%、台积电三星暂停交付及非AI芯片豁免取消。
text:
亚洲几笔大的AI数据中心交易开始散了。

美国商务部收紧AI芯片出口管制、关掉第三方国家的云算力通道之后，Moonshot AI 取消了和印尼云服务商一份1.5亿美元的合同。

原本这笔钱是租英伟达 Blackwell Ultra B300集群训练 Kimi K4的，预付比例给到了50%，行业常规是15%。

钱先付出去一半，算力却拿不到，这是这轮管制最直接的后果。台积电和三星也暂停向部分中国客户交付处理器，需要单独申请许可。

字节跳动、百度昆仑的采购排在受影响名单里。非AI芯片的豁免一并取消后，小米、Oppo、vivo 的手机处理器也被卷进来。

反常识的地方在于，被卡住的不只是先进算力。云通道一关，海外租算力这条路也被封，预付款高的那批客户最先扛不住。
en_title: After overseas cloud access was cut off, a $150 million compute contract fell through first
en_text:
Several major AI data center deals in Asia are starting to unravel.

After the U.S. Department of Commerce tightened export controls on AI chips and shut off cloud compute access through third countries, Moonshot AI canceled a $150 million contract with an Indonesian cloud provider.

The money was meant to pay for renting Nvidia Blackwell Ultra B300 clusters to train Kimi K4, with the prepayment ratio set at 50%, compared with the industry-standard 15%.

Half the money was paid upfront, but the compute couldn't be accessed—the most direct consequence of this round of controls. TSMC and Samsung also paused processor deliveries to some Chinese customers, which now require separate licenses.

ByteDance and Baidu Kunlun's purchases were on the affected list. After exemptions for non-AI chips were also canceled, handset processors from Xiaomi, Oppo, and vivo got caught up too.

The counterintuitive part is that advanced compute isn't the only thing caught. Once cloud access is shut, renting compute overseas is blocked too, and the customers who paid the largest prepayments are the first to feel the squeeze.

title: 榜单刷屏的国产芯片，阿里为什么现在才喊
note: 照抄 X22；v2 栏目首次覆盖该表态，从财报数字与出口管制给出为何此时押注国产芯片的判断。
text:
阿里云收入刚站上600亿，吴泳铭却说以后绝大部分模型训练都要靠国产芯片。

11月19日的电话会上，他给出平头哥三代GPU路线图，今年真武M890上线，2027年V900、2028年J900进入量产，2027年一季度支持超大规模模型训练。千问已经在平头哥上训下一代模型。榜单在喊国产替代的时候，真正被忽略的是另一笔账。

阿里Q3自由现金流净流出344.72亿，下一个财年增速指引压到30%到45%。另一头，美国出口管制把明年产品的供应链不确定性摆到了台面上，吴泳铭自己说影响还在评估。

算力越紧，话说得越满，中间隔着的是一条还在爬坡的国产产线。
en_title: With domestic chips dominating the leaderboards, why is Alibaba only speaking up now?
en_text:
Alibaba Cloud revenue has just crossed RMB 60 billion, yet Wu Yongming says most model training will rely on domestic chips going forward.

On the November 19 earnings call, he laid out the third-generation T-Head GPU roadmap: Zhenwu M890 goes live this year, V900 enters mass production in 2027, J900 in 2028, and support for ultra-large-scale model training arrives in Q1 2027. Qwen is already training its next-generation model on T-Head. While the leaderboards are shouting about domestic alternatives, the truly overlooked calculation is another one.

Alibaba's free cash flow posted a net outflow of RMB 34.472 billion in Q3, and next fiscal year's growth guidance was cut to 30%-45%. Meanwhile, U.S. export controls have put supply-chain uncertainty around next year's products in plain sight; Wu Yongming himself said the impact is still being assessed.

The tighter compute gets, the bolder the rhetoric gets, with a domestic production line still ramping up somewhere in between.

title: Anthropic首日高开34%，收在96.59
