title: Intel桌面CPU份额回到70.1%，AMD跌破三成
note: 全新，Mercury Research Q3 2026份额数据首次入库
text:
Mercury Research的Q3 2026数据里，Intel桌面x86出货份额回到70.1%，AMD掉到29.9%。

这是AMD第一次跌破三成。

Q2的时候Intel还是65.1%，AMD 34.9%。一年前的Q3 2025，AMD是33.6%。这一季度AMD环比掉了5个百分点，同比掉了3.7个百分点。

Mercury的口径是出货量，统计7月到9月卖出去的处理器，不是营收，也不是装机量。同一个季度，客户端CPU总共出货6080万颗，环比少3.4%，同比少6.5%，其中桌面同比跌13%。服务器那边反过来，出货813万颗，同比涨23.4%，AMD的服务器份额到了35.5%。

份额是出货量的比例，大盘缩水的时候，谁供货稳谁的比例就上去。桌面这个盘子同比缩了13%，Intel能稳定供货，AMD被显卡供应拖住，游戏PC没吃到往年的旺季。

Mercury自己把原因标成了推测，说Intel把一部分笔电晶圆调回桌面。这笔账跟性能没关系，第三方游戏测试里AMD的X3D还是更快。

真正变了的是供给和库存。内存涨价压着PC厂商下单，渠道在清库存，谁能按时交货谁就占比例。Intel的CFO说PC放缓至少延续到2027年上半年。

Intel在这个萎缩的盘子里拿到七成，代价是客户端业务自己也在缩，四季度还要环比再跌两成。份额上去了，钱没跟着上去。

AMD丢的是桌面，服务器份额反而涨了7.7个百分点，它把重心挪去了数据中心。

下一个信号是Mercury的Q4数据，看Intel这70.1%是稳住了，还是就一个季度的摆动。
en_title: Intel desktop CPU share climbs back to 70.1% as AMD falls below 30%
en_text:
In Mercury Research's Q3 2026 numbers, Intel's desktop x86 shipment share is back at 70.1%, and AMD is down to 29.9%.

It's the first time AMD has dropped below 30%.

In Q2 Intel was at 65.1% and AMD at 34.9%. A year earlier, in Q3 2025, AMD was at 33.6%. This quarter AMD gave up 5 points quarter over quarter and 3.7 points year over year.

Mercury counts shipments, processors sold between July and September, not revenue and not installed machines. In the same quarter, client CPU shipments came in at 60.8 million units, down 3.4% quarter over quarter and 6.5% year over year, with desktop down 13%. Servers went the other way, shipping 8.13 million units, up 23.4% year over year, and AMD's server share reached 35.5%.

Share is a ratio of shipments. When the pool shrinks, whoever can keep shipping holds their percentage up. Desktop shrank 13% year over year. Intel kept supply steady while AMD got held back by graphics card supply and missed the usual seasonal lift.

Mercury itself flagged the cause as a guess, saying Intel shifted some laptop wafers back to desktop. This has nothing to do with performance. In third party game tests, AMD's X3D chips are still faster.

What actually changed is supply and inventory. Higher memory prices pushed PC makers to trim orders, channels are clearing stock, and whoever can deliver on time takes share. Intel's CFO said the PC slowdown will last at least through the first half of 2027.

Intel taking seven tenths of a shrinking pool comes at a cost. Its own client business is contracting, with another quarter over quarter drop of more than 20% guided for Q4. Share went up, the money didn't follow.

AMD lost desktop but gained 7.7 points in servers, moving its weight toward data centers.

The next signal is Mercury's Q4 numbers, whether that 70.1% holds or turns out to be a single quarter swing.

title: 华为智能汽车部件发货破1亿件，第二个百万只用了12个月
note: 全新，11月26日官宣发货破亿
text:
11月26日，华为乾崑官宣智能汽车解决方案部件累计发货量突破1亿件，截至11月25日，覆盖26个品牌、62款车型。

最扎眼的是搭载速度的对比。乾崑智驾第一个100万搭载用了44个月，第二个100万只用了12个月。鸿蒙座舱更快，第一个100万42个月，第二个100万15个月。

反常识的在后面。华为一直在说不造车，引望CEO靳玉志11月26日又重申了一遍。可这1亿件里，既有卖给阿维塔、岚图、深蓝这些车企的部件，也有供给问界、智界、享界这些鸿蒙智行车型的。两条线共用一套部件。

中汽协的数据里，2026年1到9月城市NOA乘用车渗透率21%，乾崑智驾ADS以18.5%的份额排第一。35万元以上豪华车市场，它的占有率是31.5%。引望今年在智驾上的投入预计近200亿元，云端算力60 EFLOPS。
en_title: Huawei smart car parts pass 100 million shipped, second million took just 12 months
en_text:
On November 26, Huawei Qiankun announced that cumulative shipments of its smart vehicle solution parts passed 100 million units, as of November 25, covering 26 brands and 62 models.

The sharpest detail is the pace. Qiankun ADS took 44 months to reach its first one million deployments and just 12 months for the second. HarmonyOS Cockpit was quicker, 42 months for the first million and 15 for the second.

The counterintuitive part comes later. Huawei keeps saying it doesn't build cars, and Yinwang CEO Jin Yuzhi said it again on November 26. But that 100 million includes parts sold to automakers like Avatr, Voyah and Deepal, and parts supplied to Harmony Intelligence models like AITO, Luxeed and Stelato. Both lines share the same parts.

According to CAAM, city NOA penetration in passenger cars hit 21% from January to September 2026, with Qiankun ADS first at 18.5%. In the premium market above 350,000 yuan, its share is 31.5%. Yinwang expects to spend nearly 20 billion yuan on driver assistance this year, with 60 EFLOPS of cloud computing power.

title: 你挑CPU盯跑分，份额那70%却不是性能
note: 讲解角度：份额不等于性能，讲出货量口径与大盘缩水的因果
text:
你上次换电脑挑CPU的时候，是不是也盯着跑分看的？

Mercury刚出的Q3数据，Intel桌面份额70.1%，AMD 29.9%。可这个70.1%数的是出货量，不是性能，也不是你钱包里花了多少钱。

我第一次看到这组数字也愣了一下。份额是比例，大盘在缩，桌面出货同比跌了13%，谁供货稳谁比例就高。AMD被显卡供应拖住，没吃到旺季。Mercury说Intel把笔电晶圆调回桌面，还特意标了这是推测。我翻了一遍游戏测试，AMD的X3D还是更快。所以这七成跟好不好用是两码事，是这一季谁能按时交货。

我押不出来Q4会不会变回来，但下次再看到份额新闻，我会先数它是出货量还是营收。我买CPU不会盯着这个比例，盘子小了数字自然好看。
link: Intel桌面CPU份额回到70.1%，AMD跌破三成
en_title: You pick CPUs by benchmarks, but that 70% share isn't performance
en_text:
When you last picked a CPU for a new build, did you also go by benchmark scores?

Mercury just put out its Q3 numbers. Intel is at 70.1% desktop share, AMD at 29.9%. But that 70.1% counts shipments, not performance, and not what you actually spent.

I froze for a second the first time I saw these numbers. Share is a ratio. The pool is shrinking, desktop shipments are down 13% year over year, and whoever keeps shipping holds their percentage up. AMD got held back by graphics card supply and missed the seasonal lift. Mercury says Intel shifted some laptop wafers back to desktop, and flagged it as a guess. I went back through the game tests, and AMD's X3D chips are still faster. So those seven tenths have nothing to do with how good the chip feels. It's about who could deliver on time this quarter.

I can't call whether Q4 flips back. But next time a share headline comes up, I'll check whether it's shipments or revenue first. I wouldn't pick a CPU by that ratio. When the pool shrinks, the numbers look better on their own.

title: Intel份额回到七成，买电脑的人却没多起来
note: 照抄 X22
text:
Intel份额回到七成，买电脑的人却没多起来。

Q3 2026桌面出货份额70.1%，AMD掉到29.9%。数字本身没问题，出货量口径摆在那。份额往上走，原因不在性能。

桌面出货同比跌13%，笔电同比跌4%，这是缩的那头。服务器出货同比涨23.4%，AMD在那里拿到35.5%，这是涨的那头。

份额涨了，盘子小了。看着是Intel赢了，其实是桌面这块蛋糕缩水了。
en_title: Intel back at seven tenths, but nobody's buying more PCs
en_text:
Intel is back at seven tenths of the desktop market, but not many more people are buying PCs.

Q3 2026 desktop shipment share was 70.1%, with AMD down to 29.9%. The numbers hold up, shipment basis and all. The share climb has nothing to do with performance.

Desktop shipments fell 13% year over year, laptops 4%, that's the shrinking side. Servers were up 23.4% year over year, where AMD took 35.5%, that's the growing side.

Share went up, the pool went down. It looks like Intel won, but the desktop pie just got smaller.

title: 卧槽，华为不造车却卖了1亿件部件
note: 照抄 X09
text:
卧槽！

盯了半年华为不造车，最后发现部件已经卖了1亿件！

天天研究乾崑智驾、鸿蒙座舱、智能车控，各种搭载量、NOA份额、车型数量看得个不停。

结果问界智界算在里头，阿维塔岚图也算在里头，一条不造车的线把车卖出去了六十多款。

你们现在还信华为不造车吗？

还是已经把它当成隐形车企了？
en_title: WTF, Huawei doesn't build cars but shipped 100 million parts
en_text:
WTF!

I spent half a year watching Huawei insist it doesn't build cars, then found out it had already shipped 100 million parts!

Day after day I tracked Qiankun ADS, HarmonyOS Cockpit, smart vehicle control, deployment numbers, NOA share, model counts, you name it.

Turns out AITO and Luxeed are in there, and Avatr and Voyah are in there too. The line that doesn't build cars ended up powering more than sixty models.

Do you still believe Huawei doesn't build cars?

Or have you already started calling it a stealth automaker?

title: 英伟达要求代工厂停发东南亚四国服务器，标普同日列入负面观察
note: 部分重叠：美国芯片新规v1多次写过，本次新在英伟达亲自要求戴尔超微停发东南亚四国服务器，叠加标普25日列入负面观察与1040亿美元营收数据。多信源FT、证券时报、金融界、界面。
text:
英伟达自己按了暂停键。11月26日午后，英国金融时报报道，它要求戴尔、超微电脑这些把芯片装成服务器的伙伴，停止向马来西亚、新加坡、泰国和印尼发货。买家收到的通知很直接，订单不许发。

英伟达和伙伴正在研究怎么满足华盛顿的新规矩，恢复发货时间没有排期。

这事根在11月16日。美国商务部工业与安全局那天公布新规，19日生效，向上面四国加巴西出口特定先进芯片，得先拿美国政府的许可。11月21日日经亚洲已经报过，至少两家服务器厂商停了东南亚客户的货，一家从20日起连新订单都不接。

英伟达这次自己下场，是因为租算力这条路也被算进去了。中国AI实验室过去通过当地云厂商租英伟达算力，绕开直接出口禁令。新规之后，云厂商有90天时间证明手上没有受限用户，可谁来申请、怎么申请，指引迟迟没给。

代工厂和云商行拿不准，最安全的做法就是不发。

钱卡在这里。供应商高管说，得让客户交更多材料才能去申请许可证，一堆价格昂贵的GPU板卡可能就此压在供应商手上。

新加坡是英伟达账面上最亮的一块。2025年它通过新加坡子公司录得1040亿美元营收，12个月增长72%。增长最快的地方，现在被自己关上。

同一天还有一件事。标普25日把英伟达的发行人信用评级和高级无抵押债务评级放进负面观察名单，两项目前都是AA。按标普的说法，治理缺陷要是继续，90天内可能降到AA-。

往下看两件事就够。90天许可窗口走完，看供应商手里的板卡有没有变成库存。再看标普那90天，评级是不是真从AA掉下来。至于东南亚的服务器什么时候重新发货，目前没有时间。
en_title: Nvidia halts server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries
en_text:
Nvidia hit the pause button itself. On the afternoon of November 26, the Financial Times reported that it told manufacturing partners like Dell and Super Micro, which package its chips into servers, to stop shipping to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia. The message to buyers was blunt: orders would not ship.

Nvidia and its partners are working out how to meet Washington's new rules, with no date set for shipments to resume.

It started on November 16. The US Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security published new rules that day, effective November 19, requiring a US government license to export certain advanced chips to those four countries plus Brazil. Nikkei Asia reported on November 21 that at least two server vendors had already stopped shipping to Southeast Asian customers, one of them refusing new orders from November 20.

Nvidia stepped in directly because renting compute is now in scope too. Chinese AI labs used to rent Nvidia compute through local cloud providers in the region, sidestepping the direct export ban.

Under the new rules, cloud providers have 90 days to show they have no restricted users on their books, but who applies and how has never been spelled out. Foundries and cloud vendors, unsure of the rules, chose the safest option: don't ship.

Money is stuck right there. A supplier executive said customers now have to hand over more documents before a license can be requested, and a pile of expensive GPU boards could end up sitting in the supplier's own warehouse.

Singapore is the brightest line in Nvidia's books. In 2025 it booked $104 billion in revenue through its Singapore unit, up 72% in 12 months. The fastest-growing market is now shut by its own hand.

The same day brought another item. On November 25, S&P placed Nvidia's issuer credit rating and senior unsecured debt rating, both AA, on negative watch. If governance shortcomings persist, S&P says the rating could fall to AA- within 90 days.

Two things are worth watching. When the 90-day license window closes, see whether those GPU boards have turned into inventory. Then watch S&P's 90 days to see if AA actually slips. As for when servers ship to Southeast Asia again, there is no timetable.

title: 新华网发文评AI短剧脸同质化，95%产能只换4%播放
note: 全新：v1写过AI短剧丑狐、盗脸、伪人广告，但未写过AI短剧主角脸同质化叠加新华网11月26日评论这个事件。官方一手新华网加中国网络视听协会数据，多信源。
text:
新华网11月26日发了篇评论，题目叫别丢了AI短剧的脸。它说的是一件很多人刷剧时都碰到过的事，AI短剧千千万万，主角的脸翻来覆去就那么几张。

数据比观感更直白。中国网络视听协会的《微短剧创作指引》里，2026年一季度全行业上线微短剧约12.8万部，其中AI微短剧约12.2万部，占比超过95%。二季度AI微短剧又上了15.3万部。

反常识的地方在后面。这些占掉95%产能的AI短剧，只拿走4%的播放量。不到5%的真人剧，吃掉了96%。今年春节档，真人剧上线量大约是AI剧的五十分之一，总播放量却是AI剧的25倍。

模型只会捏出同一张脸，原因在视频这一层。视频比图片更怕出错，几十帧上百帧要前后一致，模型于是偏向五官对称、表情好控制的标准脸。你在平台输入女生骑自行车，后台自动补成年轻漂亮亚洲女孩、白皮肤、甜美微笑，柔光加清新背景。

提示词越被润色，流水线美人越跑不掉。新华网那篇评论把账算到了创作这一头，不打磨剧情和人物，只想着快速上新变现，脸就成了流水线上可以随便复制的元素。

换脸融脸的侵权更麻烦，鉴定手段跑不赢侵权迭代，平台只能打地鼠。12.8万部里能被记住的脸，没几张。
en_title: Xinhua weighs in on AI short dramas: 95% of output, 4% of views
en_text:
Xinhua published a commentary on November 26 titled Don't Lose the Face of AI Short Dramas. It's about something anyone who scrolls short dramas has noticed: thousands of AI dramas, and the same few faces over and over.

The numbers are blunter than the eye. In the China Netcasting Services Association's Micro-Drama Creation Guidelines, about 128,000 short dramas went live in the first quarter of 2026, of which about 122,000 were AI-made, over 95%. Another 153,000 AI dramas went live in the second quarter.

The counterintuitive part comes next. Those AI dramas, 95% of the output, pulled just 4% of the views. The under-5% made by real people took 96%. During this year's Spring Festival, real dramas were about one-fiftieth of the AI output by volume, yet drew 25 times the plays.

The reason the model keeps making the same face sits in the video layer. Video is less forgiving than still images: dozens or hundreds of frames have to stay consistent, so the model leans toward symmetric features and expressions that are easy to control. Type "girl riding a bike" and the backend fills in young pretty Asian girl, fair skin, sweet smile, soft light, fresh background.

The more the prompt gets polished, the less escape there is from the assembly-line beauty. The Xinhua commentary puts the bill on the creative side: no time spent on plot or character, only on fast releases and quick cash, and the face becomes an element to copy freely on the line.

Face-swap infringement is harder. Detection keeps losing to the infringement tools, and platforms can only play whack-a-mole. Of 128,000 dramas, the faces anyone remembers are few.

title: 你租的AI算力，说停就停了
note: 讲解角度：用户视角看租算力被停的因果，第二人称真实反应，挂英伟达停发东南亚那条，不同于v1的机制叙述。数字来自今日公开报道。
text:
1040亿美元这个数，我盯着看了两遍。

这是英伟达2025年通过新加坡子公司记进去的营收，一年涨了72%。它现在让戴尔和超微电脑停掉往马来西亚、新加坡、泰国、印尼发货，四国里就有新加坡。

你要是做AI应用的，租的算力不少是从这些地方绕出来的。11月16日美国出了新规，19日生效，往这几国运先进芯片要先申请许可。云厂商有90天证明手上没有受限用户，可怎么申请没人讲清楚。

卡住的是许可证。芯片还在，能不能发出去是另一回事。代工厂怕板卡压在手里不敢发，云厂商怕客户身份说不清不敢接，一层层往下，落到你身上就是服务涨价或者延期。

同一天标普把英伟达放进负面观察，评级现在还是AA，90天内可能掉到AA-。它会不会真掉，我押不出来。你用的算力价格，短期怕是稳不住。

这轮收紧，刀口落在租算力这条链上。
link: 英伟达要求代工厂停发东南亚四国服务器，标普同日列入负面观察
en_title: The compute you rent can be cut off overnight
en_text:
I stared at the $104 billion figure twice.

That's what Nvidia booked through its Singapore unit in 2025, up 72% in a year. Now it's telling Dell and Super Micro to stop shipping to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia. Singapore is one of those four.

If you build AI apps, chances are the compute you rent came through those places. On November 16 the US rolled out new rules, effective November 19, requiring a license to ship advanced chips there. Cloud providers have 90 days to prove no restricted users are on their books, but nobody says how to apply.

What's stuck is the license. The chips are still there; whether they can ship is another matter. Foundries won't ship for fear of sitting on board inventory, cloud vendors won't take customers whose identity they can't verify, and layer by layer it lands on you as higher prices or delays.

The same day S&P put Nvidia on negative watch, still AA for now, possibly down to AA- within 90 days. Whether it actually drops, I can't call. The price of the compute you use probably won't stay steady for a while.

This round of tightening aims at rented compute, not chip sales.

title: 你刷短剧看到的那张脸，到底是谁的
note: 讲解角度：观众视角看AI短剧同一张脸的成因，第二人称划走手势与投票，挂AI短剧脸那条，v4与v1角度不同。数字来自协会报告。
text:
12.8万部短剧里翻来覆去一张脸，我翻完报告愣了一下。

中国网络视听协会的数，2026年一季度上线微短剧约12.8万部，AI微短剧约12.2万部，占比超过95%。二季度又上了15.3万部。

你刷到分不清谁是谁，不是眼神问题。视频模型要保证几十帧前后一致，五官对称、表情好控的标准脸最保险。

平台还会把你输入的女生骑自行车，自动补成年轻漂亮的模板提示词。

反差在流量那头。占掉95%产能的AI剧只拿4%播放，真人剧上线量是它的五十分之一，播放量却是25倍。你是不是也觉得，刷了一晚上记住的还是真人脸。

我看了一遍新华网26日那篇评论，它把账算在创作上，光想着上新变现，脸就成了流水线上随便复制的东西。换脸侵权的更难办，鉴定追不上侵权，平台只能打地鼠。

你那点划走的手速，其实已经在替真人剧投票了。
link: 新华网发文评AI短剧脸同质化，95%产能只换4%播放
en_title: Whose face is that in the short drama you just watched
en_text:
I finished the report and froze for a second: one face, repeated across 128,000 dramas.

The China Netcasting Services Association says about 128,000 short dramas went live in the first quarter of 2026, about 122,000 AI-made, over 95%. Another 153,000 in the second quarter.

You can't tell the characters apart, and it's not your eyes. Video models need dozens of consistent frames, so symmetric, easy-to-control standard faces are safest.

Platforms also turn your "girl riding a bike" into a polished template prompt.

The reversal is on the traffic side: AI dramas are 95% of output but 4% of plays, while real dramas are one-fiftieth of the volume with 25 times the plays. You've probably scrolled a whole night and still remember a real face.

I read the Xinhua commentary from the 26th. It puts the bill on the creative side: chase fast releases and quick cash, and the face becomes something copied on a line. Face-swap infringement is worse, detection can't keep up, so platforms play whack-a-mole.

Your thumb, scrolling past, is already voting for real dramas.

title: 逗AI黑化上了两个榜，504.1万热度里藏着什么
note: 照抄X05。题材来自第1.5步cross=2真热点，双榜热度504.1万，判断落在情绪消费上，数字来自今日榜单。
text:
汇报一下逗AI黑化那个热搜：微博和抖音两个榜同时挂着，热度504.1万，点进去全是装傻逗模型的截图。

有人说AI真会骂人，有人说那是Anthropic调情绪向量的老实验，两种说法都在传。

这种属于情绪消费，轻则刷到停不下来，重则真去诱导模型突破护栏。

切不可拿工作号去试。
en_title: Tricking AI into snapping hit two charts, 5.041 million heat
en_text:
A quick report on the trick-AI-into-snapping trend: it's on both Weibo and Douyin, 5.041 million heat, and every post is a screenshot of someone acting dumb to provoke a model.

Some say the AI really cursed; others say it's the old Anthropic emotion-vector experiment. Both versions are going around.

This is emotional consumption. At best you can't stop scrolling; at worst you go and actually induce a model past its guardrails.

Don't try it from your work account.

title: 1040亿美元，一年涨72%，然后踩了刹车
note: 照抄X02，对应骨架S04。数字来自今日公开报道英伟达停发东南亚，与上一轮X09/S06不同。
text:
英伟达让戴尔和超微电脑停发东南亚四国服务器，2025年新加坡子公司入账1040亿美元，一年涨72%，同一天标普把它列进负面观察名单。

这局面已经不需要我来描述了。

我只想说一句：跑得最快的那台机器自己踩了刹车。
en_title: $104 billion, up 72%, then it hit the brakes
en_text:
Nvidia told Dell and Super Micro to stop shipping servers to four Southeast Asian countries; its Singapore unit booked $104 billion in 2025, up 72% in a year; the same day S&P put it on negative watch.

This situation needs no description from me.

One thing to say: the fastest machine out there just hit its own brakes.

title: 马云现身平头哥，真武V900明年一季度量产
note: 全新事件；11月26日热榜cross=2，阿里自研芯片赴港IPO与量产节点首次入列
text:
11月26日下午，马云出现在平头哥办公区。灰色毛衣，跟工程师合影，竖大拇指。照片是平头哥员工发出来的。

这个人平时很少在公众面前提芯片。这次露面赶在一个节点上。11月10日阿里公告，要把平头哥分拆出去，到香港联交所独立上市。港交所9月11日就已收了保密递表。

分拆之后，平头哥还是阿里的子公司，但要去外面融钱了。阿里给它的定位是全栈数据中心芯片供应商。

真正让这次露面有分量的，是芯片本身。上周阿里财报电话会上说，新一代真武V900预计2027年一季度量产。千问已经基于平头哥的芯片在训练下一代模型。

成立8年，平头哥此前主要撑推理。搭载它芯片的阿里云算力服务，已支持数百家企业做大模型推理。这次千问拿它训练下一代模型，是头一回把自家芯片放到训练位上。
en_title: Ma visits Pingtouge as Zhenwu V900 targets Q1 2027 production
en_text:
On the afternoon of November 26, Ma Yun showed up at Pingtouge's office. Gray sweater, photos with engineers, thumbs up. The pictures came from Pingtouge staff.

He rarely talks about chips in public. This visit landed on a specific node. On November 10 Alibaba announced it would spin off Pingtouge for an independent listing on the Hong Kong exchange. The exchange had already accepted a confidential filing on September 11.

After the split, Pingtouge stays an Alibaba subsidiary, but it will raise money on the outside. Alibaba calls it a full-stack data-center chip supplier.

What gives this visit weight is the chip itself. On last week's earnings call Alibaba said its next-generation Zhenwu V900 is set for mass production in the first quarter of 2027. Qwen is already training its next model on Pingtouge chips.

Eight years in, Pingtouge mostly powered inference. Alibaba Cloud's compute service built on those chips has supported hundreds of companies running large-model inference. This time Qwen put them in the training seat for the first time.

title: 通义千问以后跑谁的芯片，我从马云这趟平头哥之行看明白了
note: 讲解角度：从普通人用的通义千问会跑在自家芯片上讲因果，与第一栏发生什么不同
text:
你用的通义千问，以后可能跑在阿里自家做的芯片上，这事我第一次看到也没太当回事。

11月26日马云去了平头哥，照片里他跟工程师合影。11月10日阿里公告，要把这家芯片公司分拆到香港上市。

这事的关键不在马云去了哪，在于芯片的位置变了。平头哥成立8年，之前主要做推理，搭载它芯片的阿里云算力服务支持过数百家企业。现在千问已经拿它训练下一代模型，真武V900预计2027年一季度量产。训练和推理不是一回事，训练对集群和软件栈的要求高得多。阿里把芯片从成本项挪到能自己融资的资产，是因为向外买芯片这条路越来越看脸色。分拆出去，这块业务可以单独融钱，也可以单独谈客户。你如果留意过这两年的算力供应消息，就知道这一步不只是财务安排。

我押不了它一定能成。真武V900还要等到明年一季度，千问拿它训练到什么规模，眼下也没摊开讲。但阿里这一步图的不是省钱。供应卡脖子的时候，它要给自己留一条能走的路。
link: 马云现身平头哥，真武V900明年一季度量产
en_title: Where the Qwen you use will actually run
en_text:
You might not have thought much about it, but the Qwen model you use could end up running on a chip Alibaba built itself. I didn't either when I first saw it.

On November 26 Ma Yun visited Pingtouge, posing for photos with engineers. On November 10 Alibaba announced plans to spin the chip unit off and list it in Hong Kong.

The point isn't where Ma went. It's where the chip sits in the chain. Pingtouge is eight years old and mostly did inference until now; its chips already support large-model inference for hundreds of companies through Alibaba Cloud. Qwen is now training its next model on them, and the Zhenwu V900 is slated for mass production in the first quarter of 2027. Training is a different beast from inference. Alibaba is turning the chip from a cost item into an asset that can raise money on its own, because buying chips from outside keeps getting harder. If you've followed the supply headlines these two years, you know this is more than a financial move.

I can't say it will work. The V900 is still a quarter away, and how big Qwen's training run actually is hasn't been laid out. Alibaba isn't doing this to save money. When supply gets squeezed, it wants a path it can walk on its own.

title: 数千颗B300急寻下家，管制的刀从芯片挪到了访问权
note: 部分重叠；与11-17远程访问新规、11-26东南亚停发同链条，新在二手市场出现数千颗B300寻售
text:
11月25日CNBC报道，市场上冒出数千颗英伟达B300在找买家。这批卡原本是给中国企业租用的海外数据中心准备的。现在它们急着脱手，不是因为卖不掉，是因为能合法接盘的人突然少了。

时间线压得很紧。11月16日，美国商务部工业与安全局宣布临时最终规则，11月19日生效，限制中国关联客户通过海外数据中心远程调用先进英伟达芯片。11月25日，美国贸易代表格里尔接受CNBC采访，说新规是要堵住漏洞，包括经东南亚转运和从第三国数据中心远程访问。GPU Mart总裁杰克·杜哈梅尔和两名知情人士说，新规出来后挂售的GPU数量异常高，有一家公司直接把抛售跟新规挂钩。

要理解这波抛售，得先看钱怎么流。过去的路子是芯片物理上留在第三国的数据中心，中国团队通过远程租约调用算力。海关查的是芯片出境，这条链上芯片没出境，算力却交付了。新规把远程访问也算进出口管制，等于把这条缝焊死。芯片还放在原来的机柜里，租约下面那批中国租户不能用了。资产收益模型瞬间从面向中国租户，变成要找非中国买家。持有者面对的不是需求消失，是合规买家名单被砍掉一大截。于是GPU从稀缺资产变成带合规风险的资产，买家要查最终用途、租户结构、访问日志，交易折价和尽调成本跟着上来。远程访问安全法案已在众议院通过、待参议院审议，英伟达提醒过客户，法案若落地，政府对云服务的管控权限会更大。

反常识的地方在于，英伟达自己一遍遍说需求远大于供给。11月17日财报会上，临时CEO克雷斯刚讲完这句话。八天后二手市场就冒出数千颗B300找下家。两边不矛盾，缺的从来不是买家，是能被允许买的买家。卖家赶在红线生效前清库存，终端买家还在排队拿不到货。

下一个信号看两件事。一是远程访问安全法案在参议院的进度，二是B300转售价跟官方报价的差值。差值如果持续走阔，说明这批算力资产的合规折价被市场坐实了。
en_title: Thousands of B300s hunt for buyers as controls shift from chips to access
en_text:
On November 25 CNBC reported that thousands of Nvidia B300s are looking for buyers. The cards were meant for overseas data centers rented by Chinese customers. Now their owners want out, not because demand vanished, but because the list of people allowed to buy just got a lot shorter.

The timeline is tight. On November 16 the US Commerce Department's BIS announced an interim final rule, effective November 19, limiting Chinese-linked customers from remotely accessing advanced Nvidia chips through overseas data centers. On November 25 US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer told CNBC the rule closes loopholes, including transshipment through Southeast Asia and remote access from third-country data centers. GPU Mart president Jack Duhamel and two people familiar said listings spiked after the rule, with one company tying its sale directly to it.

To see the sell-off you have to follow the money. The old route kept chips physically in a third country while Chinese teams rented compute remotely. Customs watched chips crossing borders; the chips never crossed, but compute still got delivered. The new rule counts remote access as export, sealing that gap. The chips stay in their racks, but the tenants underneath them can no longer use them. The asset model flips from serving Chinese tenants to hunting non-Chinese buyers. Holders aren't facing a demand collapse; they're facing a shrunk list of legal buyers. So GPUs turn from scarce assets into assets carrying compliance risk. Buyers now check end use, tenant structure and access logs. Discounts and due-diligence costs follow. The Remote Access Security Act has passed the House and awaits the Senate; Nvidia warned clients that if it lands, the government's grip on cloud access gets wider.

The counterintuitive part: Nvidia keeps saying demand far outstrips supply. On November 17 interim CEO Colette Kress said exactly that. Eight days later thousands of B300s hit the resale market. Both can be true. What's missing was never buyers, it was buyers who are allowed. Sellers are clearing inventory before the red line, while end users still queue for cards.

Watch two signals. One, how the Remote Access Security Act moves in the Senate. Two, the gap between B300 resale prices and official quotes. If that gap keeps widening, the market has priced in the compliance discount.

title: OpenAI承认计费错了，GPT-6.2额度消耗要变快
note: 全新事件；Codex负责人首次承认计费错误，给出40%与25%两个原口径数字
text:
11月26日，OpenAI负责Codex和ChatGPT的Tibo发了一条消息：GPT-6.2上线时计费出错，大多数用户的额度被算少了。

错误已经修好。跟上周比，用GPT-6.2 Astra触及额度上限的速度快40%，Sol快25%。订阅价格不变，之前少扣的不追缴。作为补偿，Go、Plus、Pro和Business用户各拿到一次额外的额度重置。

这里有个反常识的点。不少人之前觉得额度突然耐用，是模型优化做得好，同样的工作消耗更少token。真实原因是账单算错了。

OpenAI在API定价上确实降过价。Astra的输入、输出token价格比GPT-6 Astra低20%，缓存输入低60%。Sol沿用GPT-6.1 Sol的定价。省token和少计费是两回事，这次被混到了一起。

消息发在员工的社交账号上，没有走帮助中心或更新日志。用户在Reddit上算了一轮，发现同样的20美元会员，现在能干多少活，还得自己重新试。
en_title: OpenAI admits a billing bug as GPT-6.2 quotas run out faster
en_text:
On November 26 Tibo, who works on Codex and ChatGPT at OpenAI, posted that GPT-6.2 launched with a billing error. Most users' quotas were undercounted.

The bug is fixed. Compared with last week, users hit the limit about 40% faster on GPT-6.2 Astra and 25% faster on Sol. Subscription prices are unchanged, and OpenAI won't claw back past usage. As an apology, Go, Plus, Pro and Business accounts each get one extra banked reset.

Here's the twist. A lot of people thought their quota suddenly stretched further because the model got more efficient, doing more work with fewer tokens. The real reason is that the bill was wrong.

OpenAI did cut API prices. Astra's input and output token prices are 20% below GPT-6 Astra, with cached input down 60%, while Sol keeps GPT-6.1 Sol's pricing. Saving tokens and undercounting them are two different things, and this time they got mixed up.

The news went out on an employee's social account, not through a help-center article or changelog. After doing the math on Reddit, users found that what a 20-dollar plan actually buys now is something they have to test again themselves.

link: OpenAI承认计费错了，GPT-6.2额度消耗要变快
en_title: My quota ran out faster, so I reread OpenAI's billing fix
en_text:
Ever had that feeling where your subscription price stays the same but the quota seems tighter? OpenAI just admitted it was their math, not yours.

On November 26 OpenAI's Tibo said GPT-6.2 shipped with a billing error that undercounted most users' usage. After the fix, hitting the limit is about 40% faster on Astra and 25% faster on Sol.

What happened is simple: the bargain you were getting is being taken back. OpenAI sold these two models on doing more with fewer tokens. Part of that saving came from a bug, not from the model. Now the bug is closed, the same work drains more quota, so it feels like a cut. OpenAI says it won't chase old usage and is giving Go, Plus, Pro and Business one extra reset each, but the price didn't move an inch. You have to redo your own math, because the notice only went out on an employee's social feed, not the help center.

I froze for a second when I saw that 40%. I won't call it deliberate; I have no evidence for that kind of call. I just replanned this month's work around the new quota.

title: 当事人越信AI，律师反而先倒下了

律师林黎明碰过一单离婚案，当事人问了AI，认定法官不处理那处房产是错的，调解从一两周拖到一两个月，得把AI答复跟自己判断一致的截图发过去才肯签字。另一位律师谢和把文书交给当事人，被拿去让AI改写，她回了一大段话：真判错了，担责的是律师，不是模型。

AI查得越快，责任压得越重，中间隔着的是一个不肯信人的当事人，还有一部改不动的法律援助法。
en_title: The more clients trusted AI, the faster the lawyer fell
en_text:
The more a client trusted AI, the faster the lawyer fell.

On November 13 the Hubei firm posted its notice. Huang Qin, 48, had collapsed on November 12 while talking to a client. The case had dragged three or four months, the client still texting and calling at 9 at night. The problem was never how fast AI can find a statute. It was that AI can state the wrong one with total confidence.

Lawyer Lin Diming had a divorce case where the client asked AI and decided the judge was wrong not to handle a property pledge. Mediation that should have taken one to two weeks stretched to one or two months. Lin had to send a screenshot showing AI's answer matched his own before the client signed. Another lawyer, Xie He, handed over a draft and watched the client run it through AI to rewrite. She wrote back a long message: if the judgment goes wrong, the person who pays is the lawyer, not the model.

AI gets faster at looking things up, the responsibility gets heavier, and in between sits a client who won't trust a lawyer, plus a legal-aid law that can't be rewritten overnight.

title: 18家平台完成算法协商，美团淘宝闪购取消超时扣款
note: 全新事件，全总发布会官方口径，多个独立信源，查重列表超时扣款命中0
text:
11月26日全国总工会第四季度发布会甩出一组数，网络货运、网约车、网约配送、快递四个行业18家重点平台，全部完成劳动规则和算法协商并签了协议，覆盖超过2500万人。美团和淘宝闪购在这份名单里，两家全面取消超时扣款处罚。

截至11月10日，18家平台签完协议。全总前后开了68场征求意见会，把工会驿站和快递站点里听到的痛点列成协商议题。今年3月，全总会同人社部、中国企联、全国工商联印发平台劳动规则和算法协商指引试行版，订单分配、收入抽成、工作时长、考核奖惩都写进了核心内容。

各平台摊开的承诺很具体。顺丰涉及收入的重大规则调整提前30日公示。货拉拉把整体抽成降到约9%，还设了司机关怀基金。滴滴和T3出行把当地小时最低工资标准写进协议。中通建了恶意投诉甄别复核机制，T3要求72小时内反馈司机申诉。

规则变了。超时扣款这笔钱，过去是算法替平台收的。系统按预估时间派单，路上堵一下、楼上多等两分钟，扣款自动落下来，骑手申诉要跟机器讲道理。现在这条款被拿掉，等于平台把迟到的成本从骑手那头挪回自己这边。全总的思路是先征求意见，接着平台协商，一路推到用工末端。

判责那一条变化更大。规则从自动化主导转向人工把关，中通专门甄别恶意投诉，T3把处理时限压到72小时。过去骑手被判责任，面对的是一个不给解释的系统，现在至少有一个人能接电话。这个变化比取消扣款更难，因为它动的是算法说了算这件事本身。

平台也不是白让步。抽成、派费、公示、申诉，每一项都对应一张成本表。货拉拉一边把抽成降到约9%，一边拿出钱设司机关怀基金。美团一边取消超时扣款，一边继续推平台养老保险补贴。

下一步全总要组建平台劳动规则和算法协商专家委员会，指导各地挑订单量大、劳动者集中的城市做二次协商，再往分支机构和重点用工合作企业延伸。履约监督和跟踪评估机制一旦建起来，名单会不会从18家往外扩，下几批城市协商结果能看到。
en_title: 18 Platforms Finish Algorithm Talks as Meituan and Taobao Scrap Late Fees
en_text:
At its fourth-quarter press conference on Nov 26, the All-China Federation of Trade Unions put out a set of numbers. All 18 major platforms across four sectors, online freight, ride-hailing, delivery and express, have finished labor-rule and algorithm negotiations and signed agreements, covering more than 25 million workers. Meituan and Taobao Shangou are on that list, and both have fully scrapped late-delivery fines.

By Nov 10, all 18 platforms had signed. The federation held 68 feedback sessions, turning complaints heard at union stations and express sites into negotiation topics. In March, it jointly issued a trial guideline on platform labor rules and algorithm negotiations with the labor ministry and employer associations. Order allocation, commission rates, working hours and performance penalties all went into the core content.

The platforms laid out concrete promises. SF Express will publish any major rule change affecting income 30 days in advance. Huolala cut its overall commission to about 9% and set up a driver care fund. Didi and T3 wrote the local hourly minimum wage into their agreements. ZTO built a review mechanism for malicious complaints, and T3 must respond to driver appeals within 72 hours.

The rule changed. Late-delivery fines used to be collected by the algorithm on the platform's behalf. The system assigned orders by estimated time, and a traffic jam or two minutes waiting upstairs triggered an automatic deduction. Riders had to argue with a machine to appeal. Dropping the clause means the platform moves the cost of delays from the rider back to itself. The federation's approach was to gather feedback first, then hold platform talks, and push all the way down to the end users.

The liability rule changed even more. Judgments shifted from automated decisions to human review. ZTO screens malicious complaints, and T3 capped response time at 72 hours. Riders used to face a system that offered no explanation, but now at least a person picks up the phone. This is harder than scrapping fines, because it touches the idea that the algorithm has the final say.

The platforms did not give in for free. Commissions, delivery fees, disclosures and appeals each come with a cost sheet. Huolala cut commission to about 9% while funding a driver care fund. Meituan scrapped late fines while continuing its platform pension subsidies.

Next, the federation will set up an expert committee on platform labor rules and algorithm negotiations, guide local areas to pick cities with high order volume and dense worker populations for a second round of talks, and extend the results to branches and key labor partners. Once compliance monitoring and follow-up evaluations are in place, the next rounds of city negotiations will show whether the list grows beyond 18 platforms.

title: 英雄联盟电竞经理明年1月关服，运营四年半
note: 全新事件，腾讯官方停运公告加多家媒体，查重列表电竞经理命中0
text:
11月26日11时，《英雄联盟电竞经理》发停运公告，即日起停止充值和新用户注册，2027年1月26日11时关服，账号数据和角色资料按个人信息保护法删除。这款拳头开发、腾讯发行的手游，2022年7月20日公测，运营四年半。

上线那天它登上 iOS 畅销榜前三，机构估上线10天 iOS 流水超过7400万元，还拿了 App Store 2022年度中国大陆游戏。热度没续上，此后长期在畅销榜中下游。公告发出来的时候，距离BLG拿下S16全球总决赛冠军不到两周。

补偿方案只认付费点券，免费点券不算数。余额100以内换10元礼包，100到1000换100元，1000到5000换500元，超过5000的每满5000换一个500元礼包，余数进位取整。游戏内消耗点券时先扣付费部分，这一条把免费玩家彻底挡在补偿门外。

礼包能在《英雄联盟》《英雄联盟手游》《无畏契约》《无畏契约源能行动》《金铲铲之战》五款产品里领，参与期到2027年1月26日，逾期未参与视为自动放弃。
en_title: League of Legends Esports Manager Shuts Down After Four and a Half Years
en_text:
At 11:00 on Nov 26, League of Legends Esports Manager posted a shutdown notice. Top-ups and new registrations stopped that day, servers will close at 11:00 on Jan 26, 2027, and account and character data will be deleted under the personal information protection law. Developed by Riot and published by Tencent in China, the mobile game launched its public beta on July 20, 2022, and ran for four and a half years.

On launch day it reached the top three of the iOS grossing chart, analysts estimated iOS revenue above 74 million yuan in the first 10 days, and it won App Store's 2022 China game award. The buzz faded, and it hovered in the lower half of the charts after that. The notice came less than two weeks after BLG won the S16 world championship.

The compensation only counts paid points, not free ones. Balances up to 100 swap for a 10-yuan gift pack, 100 to 1000 for a 100-yuan pack, 1000 to 5000 for a 500-yuan pack, and above 5000, one 500-yuan pack per full 5000, rounding up the remainder. When points are spent in game, the paid portion is deducted first, which shuts free players out of compensation entirely.

The packs can be claimed in five titles: League of Legends, League of Legends Mobile, Valorant, Valorant Source Energy Operation and Teamfight Tactics. The claim window runs to Jan 26, 2027, and missing it counts as giving up.

title: 超时不扣钱了，朋友以为我在做梦

超时扣款过去是系统自动执行的，派单时间算得死，晚一分钟钱就少一块，骑手根本没地方说理。现在这一条被拿掉，等于平台认下了路上堵车、电梯等待这些不可控的时间成本。判定责任也从机器说了算改成人工把关，中通专门甄别恶意投诉，T3要求72小时内给结果。你如果点过外卖催过单，以前催单压力大头落在骑手身上，现在这层压力往平台那边挪了一点。

我看下来，判责终于有人接电话，这比免几笔扣款实在。配送费会不会涨我押不出来，但你申诉时对面坐的是个活人，这个变化我确实感觉到了。
link: 18家平台完成算法协商，美团淘宝闪购取消超时扣款
en_title: A rider told me late fines were gone, and I thought he was dreaming
en_text:
A friend who delivers food messaged me that late fines were gone, and my first reaction was that he must be dreaming.

At the Nov 26 federation meeting, 18 platforms signed algorithm negotiation agreements covering more than 25 million workers. Meituan and Taobao Shangou scrapped the late-fine clause altogether.

Late fines used to be enforced automatically. Delivery windows were calculated down to the minute, and being one minute late cost a chunk of pay, with nowhere for riders to argue. Dropping the clause means the platform now owns the unpredictable time costs, like traffic jams and waiting for elevators. Liability also moved from machine verdicts to human review. ZTO screens malicious complaints and T3 must respond within 72 hours. If you have ever rushed a food order, the pressure used to land mostly on the rider, and now a bit of it has shifted back to the platform.

What I saw is that a person finally picks up the phone on liability calls, and that beats waiving a few fines. I can't call whether delivery fees will rise, but there is a human on the other end when you appeal, and I can feel that change.

title: 氪了四年的游戏说没就没了

补偿只认付费点券，免费点券一分不算。你攒的那些点券，超过5000的每满5000才换一个500元礼包，余数进位取整。我翻了一遍那份规则，越算越觉得它在劝人别充钱。
link: 英雄联盟电竞经理明年1月关服，运营四年半
en_title: A game I paid into for four years just got shut down
en_text:
A game I have spent four years on just got switched off, and I would not take that well either.

The official notice came at 11:00 on Nov 26, with servers closing at 11:00 on Jan 26, 2027. The game opened public beta on July 20, 2022, and hit the top three of the iOS grossing chart on its second day.

Its hook was putting real LPL players into the game as cards. You traded them, trained them and built lineups, all riding on the league's popularity. The players and teams belong to someone else's IP, and the game just rents them. When Worlds is hot, players come back; when it cools, nobody opens the client. This notice landed less than two weeks after BLG took the S16 title, but a champion can carry a tournament, not a simulation server.

Compensation counts only paid points, and free ones are worth nothing. For the points you saved, above 5000 you get one 500-yuan pack per full 5000, rounding the remainder up. I went through that rule once, and the more I added up, the more it read like a warning to stop spending.

title: 超时扣款取消了，骑手为什么反而紧张

text:

en_title: Late fines are gone, so why are riders nervous
en_text:
When 18 platforms scrapped late fines together, the ones who got nervous were the riders.

At the Nov 26 federation press conference, Meituan and Taobao Shangou announced a full end to late fines, covering more than 25 million people. The rule itself is fine, and riders should breathe easier. What is hard to pin down is the other side of it.

Huolala cut its overall commission to about 9%, Didi and T3 wrote the local hourly minimum wage into their agreements, and SF promised 30 days' notice before any major income change. At the same meeting, liability shifted from automated decisions to human review, and T3 must answer appeals within 72 hours.

One fine disappears, but the cost stays on the books, and between the two sit a capacity bill nobody has published and a second round of talks about to start.

title: 英雄联盟电竞经理停运公告里几个扎眼的数字
note: 照抄X20：定调句加六条编号加私货收尾，骨架编号X20
text:
《英雄联盟电竞经理》停运公告里几个扎眼的数字：

1、时长：2022年7月20日公测，2027年1月26日关服，运营四年半。

2、巅峰：上线次日登上 iOS 畅销榜前三，机构估上线10天 iOS 流水超过7400万元。

3、分档：付费点券补偿分四档，100以内换10元礼包，100到1000换100元，1000到5000换500元。

4、进位：超过5000的每满5000换一个500元礼包，余数进位取整。

5、清空：服务器关闭后，账号数据和角色资料按个人信息保护法删除。

6、时机：公告距离BLG拿下S16全球总决赛冠军不到两周。

生意是真做不下去了，不过下一款电竞手游我觉得还是会有人买账。
en_title: A few jarring numbers in the Esports Manager shutdown notice
en_text:
A few jarring numbers in the shutdown notice for League of Legends Esports Manager:

1、Runtime: public beta on July 20, 2022, servers closing Jan 26, 2027, four and a half years in all.

2、Peak: top three on the iOS grossing chart the day after launch, with analysts estimating iOS revenue above 74 million yuan in the first 10 days.

3、Tiers: paid points get four compensation tiers, up to 100 for a 10-yuan pack, 100 to 1000 for 100 yuan, 1000 to 5000 for 500 yuan.

4、Rounding: above 5000, one 500-yuan pack per full 5000, with the remainder rounded up.

5、Wipe: after shutdown, account and character data get deleted under the personal information protection law.

6、Timing: the notice came less than two weeks after BLG won the S16 world championship.

The business really did run out of road, but I think people will still pay for the next esports mobile game.

title: 用 AI 仿冒吴越带货的品牌方道歉了，全额退款
note: 全新事件。10月18日吴越发文，11月26日欣芝妍声明致歉并全额退款；数字取自央视新闻周刊与品牌声明双信源。
text:
11月26日，广州欣芝妍化妆品发声明，向演员吴越道歉。公司承认旗下一个视频账号未经授权，用 AI 合成她的姓名、肖像和声音卖护肤品，已经下单的消费者全额退款。

事情从10月18日说起。那天凌晨吴越发文，说有人用 AI 换脸冒她的形象带货，她一位朋友的母亲已经买了一套产品。央视新闻周刊根据吴越留的截图算过，涉事直播间近30天销量6732件，这款商品累计销量16492件，销售金额超过130万元。

视频账号叫花姐美肤日记，画面打着明星同款和吴越推荐的字样，结尾还出现一个疑似邓亚萍的带货片段。吴越发文第二天，账号被平台永久封禁，内容清空。欣芝妍的声明落款是2026年11月26日，中间隔了一个多月。

这条链上每一环都便宜。账号方拿公开活动视频和几秒声音样本合成带货内容，成本几乎为零。消费者看到的是熟脸，信任的是吴越本人，下单的钱进了品牌和账号的口袋。

品牌方做推广投放，审核只看素材能不能发，没去核肖像和声音的授权。监管环节存在疏漏这句话，是欣芝妍自己写进声明的。被冒用人反过来要证明自己没说过那些话。吴越说团队已对接律师，维权流程慢，她选择先在社交平台发声。造假、传播、变现几分钟走完，澄清用了一个多月。

道歉和退款看着是品牌担责，钱早就流走了。账号发文第二天就被永久封禁，真正该追的责任主体在声明里只写成依据实际情况作出对应处理。吴越的原话是，消费者买产品是出于对她的信任，不少老年人更容易被虚假内容误导。全红婵、孙颖莎、王楚钦的声音此前也被克隆去卖土鸡蛋，演员王劲松的形象被冒用成理财广告代言人。

视频角落那行小字写着含 AI 生成内容，没人会因为那行字去怀疑一张熟脸。接下来能验证的只有两件事，欣芝妍会不会公开这次投放的授权合同，平台会不会把那行提示挪到播放前。
en_title: The brand that faked Wu Yue with AI apologized and refunded every buyer
en_text:
On November 26, Guangzhou Xinzhiyan Cosmetics published a statement apologizing to actress Wu Yue. The company admitted one of its video accounts had used AI to synthesize her name, face and voice to sell skincare without permission, and that everyone who ordered through the link would get a full refund.

It started on October 18. Early that morning Wu Yue posted that someone had used AI to swap her face into an ad, and that a friend's mother had already bought a set. CCTV's Newsweek program went through the screenshots Wu Yue kept: the account had sold 6732 units in the previous 30 days, the product had moved 16492 units in total, and sales were over 1.3 million yuan by a rough count.

The account was called Huajie Meifu Riji, and the clip was labelled celebrity pick and Wu Yue recommends, with a figure that looked like Deng Yaping at the end. The day after Wu Yue posted, the account was permanently banned and its content wiped. Xinzhiyan's statement is dated November 26, 2026, more than a month later.

Every link in this chain is cheap. The account side takes public event footage and a few seconds of voice, stitches together an ad, and the cost is close to zero. What buyers see is a familiar face. They trust Wu Yue, and the money goes to the brand and the account.

The brand ran the promotion and checked only whether the material could be posted, not whether the face and voice were licensed. Xinzhiyan wrote in its own statement that there were gaps in its oversight. The person being impersonated now has to prove she never said those lines. Wu Yue says her team has hired lawyers, but the process is slow, so she spoke out first. The fake, the spread and the cash all happen in minutes. The clearing up took over a month.

The apology and the refunds look like the brand taking responsibility, but the money had already moved. The account was banned the day after Wu Yue posted, and the people who actually ran it are described in the statement only as having been dealt with as appropriate. Wu Yue's own words were that people bought because they trusted her, and that older buyers are easier to mislead. The voices of Quan Hongchan, Sun Yingsha and Wang Chuqin had been cloned to sell eggs before, and Wang Jinsong's face was used in a fake investment ad.

A small line in the corner of the video says AI generated content, and nobody clicks away from a familiar face because of it. There are two things that can actually be checked next: whether Xinzhiyan will show the licensing contract behind this campaign, and whether the platform moves that line in front of the video.

title: 湖南网警通报李某峰造谣华为，已被行政处罚
note: 全新事件。湖南网警11月25日通报，红星新闻、每经等多信源核实；数字为4起典型案例、数百条不实评论。
text:
11月25日，湖南网警公布4起网络恶意敲诈勒索典型案例。其中一起是网民李某峰针对华为手机、鸿蒙系统、问界汽车造谣。2026年以来，他在多个短视频平台评论区发布数百条不实评论，捏造千亿营销费用和研发费用造假。公安机关已依法对他处以行政处罚。

这条通报真正说破的是涉企黑产的链条。网警的定性里写得很清楚，过去是人工PS伪造证据、恶意索赔，现在换成 AI 批量造假、账号规避风控、套现分成一条链。造谣的人几分钟铺满评论区，企业要一条条删、一次次解释。

反常识的地方在于，最吃亏的往往不是造谣的人。通报提到，部分企业怕舆情发酵、店铺扣分，结果越赔越被敲诈。造谣零成本，删帖和赔钱却有账单。

湖南网警给企业的建议是拒绝私了，留存货品发货实拍、物流签收记录和质检报告，遇到疑似敲诈直接报警。
en_title: Hunan police penalized Li Mofeng for faking claims about Huawei
en_text:
On November 25, Hunan cyber police published four typical cases of online extortion. One of them involves Li Mofeng, who spread false claims about Huawei phones, HarmonyOS and Aito cars. Since 2026 he had posted hundreds of false comments across short-video platforms, inventing claims about 100 billion yuan in marketing spend and falsified R&D figures. Police have now given him an administrative penalty.

What the notice really spells out is the chain behind attacks on companies. Police describe how the old routine of hand-edited fake evidence and malicious refund claims has turned into AI mass production, account evasion and a whole cash-out chain. A lie can fill the comment section in minutes, while the company has to delete and explain one post at a time.

The counterintuitive part is that the liar is not the one who pays the most. The notice says some companies, afraid of bad press and shop penalties, quietly paid up and were then extorted again and again. Lying costs almost nothing. Deleting and paying come with bills.

Hunan police told companies to refuse private settlements, keep photos of goods being packed, delivery records and quality reports, and call police as soon as extortion is suspected.

title: 你妈发来的那条熟脸带货，你敢说一定是本人
note: 讲解角度为普通人视角，你刷到的熟脸带货未必是本人；数字取自v1双信源，与事实稿角度不同。
text:
你妈发来的那条带货链接，上面那张熟脸，你敢说一定是本人？

这事拖了一个多月才了结。吴越10月18日就发过文，她一位朋友的母亲当时已经买了一套产品。

我翻了一遍那几段报道，账号叫花姐美肤日记，视频里打着明星同款和吴越推荐，底下挂着含 AI 生成内容的小字。央视新闻周刊根据吴越留的截图算，直播间近30天卖了6732件，这款货累计卖了16492件。钱从相信这张脸的人手里进品牌和账号，合成视频的成本几乎为零。品牌方声明里承认审核有疏漏，可授权这种事，本来该在投放前就核掉。

我也押不出来这算不算好转。退款是对的，但账号发文第二天就被封了，真正操作的那拨人最后只写成依据实际情况作出对应处理。你下次看到熟脸卖货，先想想那张脸是不是也能被别人拿去用。这事我看最后得靠平台把标识挪到播放前才算完。
link: 用 AI 仿冒吴越带货的品牌方道歉了，全额退款
en_title: That familiar face your mom sent you may not be the real person
en_text:
The shopping link your mom forwarded, with that familiar face on it, are you sure it's really her?

This dragged on for over a month. Wu Yue posted about it on October 18, and the brand apologized on November 26. A friend's mother had already bought a set back then.

I went through the reports. The account was called Huajie Meifu Riji, the clip said celebrity pick and Wu Yue recommends, and a small line at the bottom said AI generated content. CCTV Newsweek counted from her screenshots: 6732 units sold in 30 days, 16492 units in total. The money went from people who trusted that face into the brand and the account, while making the clip cost almost nothing. The brand admitted in its statement that its review had gaps. Licensing should have been checked before the ad went live.

I can't say for sure whether this counts as getting better. The refunds are right, but the account was banned the day she posted, and the people behind it are only described as having been dealt with as appropriate. Next time you see a familiar face selling something, think about whether that face could be taken by someone else. I think this only ends when the platform puts that label in front of the video.

title: 华为长鑫和三星SK海力士同台，别急着当成同一水平
note: 照抄X22（反差结论+排除+转折+两维证据+对仗收口），4段结构与原帖一致；数字来自11月26日IEEE议程与Counterpoint公开数据。
text:
华为和长鑫要在ISSCC 2027跟三星、SK海力士同台讲存储，榜上写的是硬刚，同台是真，硬刚得打个折。

议程草案里华为那篇是64通道4096个DQ的定制HBM，带内存控制器，五层晶圆混合键合。三星拿的是48GB的HBM4E，单引脚17Gb/s，还配了4nm全数字3D-DRAM PHY，两边都进了Session22。可一边有量产产线，一边自己没有存储晶圆厂，同台不等于同一起跑线。

Counterpoint 的数据摆在那，2026年第二季度 HBM 市场SK海力士50%，三星33%，美光18%，长鑫同期DRAM 同比增长716%但基数还在后面。榜单608万热度，是硬刚这两个字带来的情绪，跟份额表无关。

论文能上桌，货还得慢慢供，赛道进了，产能还没进门。
en_title: Huawei and ChangXin sharing a stage with Samsung and SK hynix doesn't make them equals
en_text:
Huawei and ChangXin will share the ISSCC 2027 stage with Samsung and SK hynix on memory, and the hot list calls it a head-on clash. The sharing is real. The clash needs a discount.

In the draft agenda, Huawei's paper is a 64-channel, 4096-DQ custom HBM with memory controllers and five-layer wafer-on-wafer hybrid bonding. Samsung brings a 48GB HBM4E at 17Gb/s per pin plus a 4nm all-digital 3D-DRAM PHY, and both are in Session22. One side has production lines. The other has no memory fab of its own. A shared stage is not a shared starting line.

Counterpoint's numbers are out there: in the second quarter of 2026, SK hynix held 50% of HBM revenue, Samsung 33%, Micron 18%, and ChangXin's DRAM grew 716% year on year from a much smaller base. The 6.08 million heat is about the word clash, not the share table.

Papers can sit on the table, supply still has to catch up, the track is entered, the capacity is not at the door yet.

en_title: A few chilling numbers from the chain that faked Wu Yue's endorsements
en_text:
A few chilling numbers from the chain that used AI to fake Wu Yue's endorsements:

1、Sales: the account moved 6732 units in 30 days, and the product sold 16492 units in total.

2、Money: CCTV's Newsweek put sales at over 1.3 million yuan from a rough count of the screenshots.

3、Delay: Wu Yue posted on October 18, the brand's apology came on November 26, more than a month later.

4、Ban: the day after Wu Yue posted, the account was permanently banned and all content wiped.

Rights protection still looks slow, but I believe the platform will move that line to the front sooner or later.

title: 蚂蚁Ming-Image两个月从开源第八冲到第一，170亿参数一个字节没动
note: A全新：历史库无Ming-Image记录，11月25日发布，双信源为蚂蚁官方发布与Artificial Analysis榜单及第三方报道。
text:
蚂蚁把设计生图模型冲到开源第一，动的地方比想象中少得多。

11月25日，inclusionAI在Hugging Face放出Ming-Image-0.2-Design，MIT协议开源，权重和推理代码都能下载。

Artificial Analysis的AA-Image-T2I v2.1榜上，它跑了4936轮盲测，Elo 1095，比9月的0.1版高出94分。116个模型里排第24，开源权重里排第一。榜首是OpenAI的GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst，1264分。

有意思的地方在权重里。有人把0.1和0.2逐文件比对哈希，负责理解提示词的那170亿参数，7个分片加最后的VAE，跟9月版完全一致，一个字节都没动。

这套理解底座是Qwen2.5-VL做视觉编码，接蚂蚁自家BailingMoeV2，256个专家每次激活8个，把用户描述压成256组查询向量往后递。

真正重训的只有后半段，15亿参数的连接层加30层DiT扩散模型。模型卡上写的6B，只算了DiT这一块。整包权重约53GB，理解底座占了大头，却没换。

拆开看，这事的逻辑很直白。花钱重训170亿参数的多模态底座，收益不确定；只改生成端，靶子小，改动可控。94分就是这么换回来的。

对做图像生成的团队来说，这等于验证了一条路线，底座可以不碰，钱花在画的手上照样能把出图质量拉上去。

代价也在。官方验证过的最低配置是单张80GB显存的CUDA显卡，BF16跑12步，默认出2048×2048。三张24GB游戏卡加起来都不够。

托管的API还没上，Artificial Analysis上价格栏还写着即将推出。0.1版透明背景前缀经常失灵，0.2的模型卡没交代这个问题改没改好。

往下看两个数就够了。价格栏什么时候从即将推出变成具体数字，以及下一版会不会把透明背景写进更新说明。
en_title: Ant's Ming-Image went from eighth to first among open-weight models in two months, without changing a byte of its 17-billion-parameter block
en_text:
Ant pushed its design-focused image model to the top of the open-weight leaderboard, and it changed far less of the system than you would expect.

On November 25, inclusionAI released Ming-Image-0.2-Design on Hugging Face under the MIT license, with both weights and inference code available to download.

On Artificial Analysis's AA-Image-T2I v2.1 leaderboard, it went through 4,936 blind comparisons and scored 1095 Elo, 94 points above the 0.1 version from September. It ranks 24th out of 116 models overall, and first among open-weight models. The leader is OpenAI's GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst at 1264.

The interesting part is inside the weights. Someone compared the 0.1 and 0.2 files hash by hash. The 17-billion-parameter block that reads your prompt, seven shards plus the final VAE, is byte-for-byte identical to the September version.

That understanding stack uses Qwen2.5-VL for vision and Ant's own BailingMoeV2, with 256 experts and 8 activated per pass, compressing your description into 256 query vectors.

Only the back end was retrained: a 1.5-billion-parameter connector and a 30-layer DiT diffusion model. The 6B on the model card counts only the DiT. The full download is about 53GB, and the unchanged understanding stack takes up most of it.

The logic is simple. Retraining the 17-billion-parameter multimodal base is expensive with an uncertain payoff. Changing only the generation side keeps the target small and the risk contained. That is where the 94 points came from.

For teams building image tools, this validates a route: leave the base alone, spend the budget on the hand that draws, and output quality still jumps.

The cost is the hardware. The validated minimum is a single CUDA GPU with 80GB of VRAM, BF16 at 12 steps, producing 2048 by 2048 by default. Three 24GB gaming cards together would not be enough.

There is no hosted API yet, and the price column on Artificial Analysis still says coming soon. The 0.1 version often failed its transparent-background prompt, and the 0.2 model card does not say whether that was fixed.

Watch two things. When the price column turns from coming soon into a real number, and whether the next release notes mention transparent backgrounds.

title: 你让AI画网页总糊成乱码，蚂蚁这次动了哪只手
note: 讲解角度：用AI画图文字乱码的日常痛点切入，拆权重哈希反差，口语聊天视角。挂在蚂蚁Ming-Image那条下。
text:
你让AI画张网页，十次有九次栽在按钮上那几个字。

蚂蚁11月25日开源了Ming-Image-0.2-Design，专攻设计稿和电商主图，说白了就是冲着这个毛病去的。

我翻了一遍它的权重对比，越看越奇怪。0.2比0.1两个月涨了94分，可负责理解提示词的那170亿参数，一个字节没动，连最后的解码层都是旧的。真正重训的是后面画画那一小段，一个15亿参数的连接层加30层扩散模型。模型卡上写的6B，只是画画那一段。你写的字它早就读懂了，只是以前画不出来，现在能画了。分数从1001到1095，就是这么换回来的。

我押不出来下一版还会不会这么抠，但这条路我看着是通的。
link: 蚂蚁Ming-Image两个月从开源第八冲到第一，170亿参数一个字节没动
en_title: You ask AI to draw a web page and it always botches the words on the buttons. What did Ant actually change?
en_text:
You ask an AI to draw a web page, and nine times out of ten it messes up the words on the buttons.

On November 25, Ant open-sourced Ming-Image-0.2-Design, built for design mockups and e-commerce hero images. That complaint is exactly what it targets.

I went through its weight comparison and found something odd. The 0.2 version gained 94 points over 0.1 in two months, yet the 17-billion-parameter block that reads the prompt did not change by a single byte, and even the final decoder is the old one. What got retrained is the small drawing end: a 1.5-billion-parameter connector and a 30-layer diffusion model. The 6B on the model card counts only that drawing part. It has always understood the words you type; it just could not draw them before, and now it can. The score moved from 1001 to 1095 on that alone.

I cannot say whether the next version will stay this thrifty, but the route makes sense to me.

title: 戴尔AI服务器收入涨198%，PC那头只涨3%
note: A全新：历史库无戴尔财报记录，双信源为戴尔Q3财报与科创板日报及读懂AI日报。

en_title: Dell's AI server revenue jumped 198%, while its PC business grew just 3%
en_text:
Dell's infrastructure revenue hit $42.0 billion in its third fiscal quarter, up 198%, while its PC business brought in $12.9 billion, up just 3%.

Two lines in the same report are moving in opposite directions. Dell vice chairman and COO Jeff Clarke said it plainly: customers are delaying PC purchases to fund AI infrastructure first. The IT budget is one pool, and what the server racks take is what the laptops give up.

The counterintuitive part is this. The better AI servers sell, the fewer traditional PCs get ordered. One company's two business lines can form a scissors chart like that. Intel's PC chip shipments fell 14% last quarter, and its CFO expects PC weakness to last at least into the first half of 2027.

en_title: A few numbers in the story of Liang Wenfeng's $55 billion fortune stand out
