title: 玄铁IP芯片出货超60亿颗，安卓17正式支持 RISC-V
note: A全新：查重库无玄铁、RISC-V、60亿颗相关记录；11月26日ICCAD Expo披露，新浪财经/IT之家、21IC、网易芯榜多源。
text:
60亿颗。11月26日，阿里达摩院首席科学家孟建熠在ICCAD Expo 2026上给出这个数，玄铁IP芯片累计出货超过60亿颗。同一场演讲里他还说，安卓17已经正式支持 RISC-V 架构。

玄铁现在有17款IP产品，累计授权客户超过1000家，国内客户超过400家。今年推出的玄铁925、930、950三款产品，往AI计算、汽车电子和具身智能方向压。RISC-V 从2010年伯克利起步时只有47条基础指令，现在是125个扩展、超过1000条指令。

钱从IP授权里来。玄铁把处理器IP核授权给合作伙伴，对方拿去做芯片，玄铁从销售额里分成，出货量越大，授权和分成越厚。真正改变需求的是智能体。Agentic AI 把任务编排、数据调度这些活从 GPU 手里挪回 CPU，CPU 从后勤管家变成执行搭档。开放指令集可以按场景改，RISC-V 正好卡在这个窗口。

代价是服务器这条路刚铺完。H扩展、AIA、Nexus Trace、IOMMU 这些服务器规范才定稿，高性能主线核还得对标 X 架构和 A 架构。出货量换不来主线核性能。行业预测到2030年 RISC-V 市场复合增长率50%、份额20%，这是预测，不是订单。

下一个能验证的信号是玄铁 E908A。它支持 ASIL-D 等级，面向车载，今年刚发布。
en_title: Xuantie ships 6 billion RISC-V IP chips, Android 17 adds support
en_text:
6 billion. On November 26, Alibaba DAMO Academy chief scientist Meng Jianyi gave the number at ICCAD Expo 2026: Xuantie's RISC-V IP chips have shipped more than 6 billion units. In the same talk he said Android 17 now officially supports RISC-V.

Xuantie has 17 IP products, over 1,000 licensed customers, and more than 400 customers in China. Three products launched this year, the Xuantie 925, 930 and 950, push into AI computing, automotive electronics and embodied intelligence. RISC-V started with 47 base instructions at Berkeley in 2010. Today it has 125 extensions and over 1,000 instructions.

The money comes from IP licensing. Xuantie licenses processor cores to partners, who build chips on top, and Xuantie takes a cut of sales. More shipments mean thicker licensing fees. What really changed demand is agents. Agentic AI moves task orchestration and data scheduling from the GPU back to the CPU, turning the CPU from a back-office helper into an execution partner. An open instruction set can be adapted to specific scenarios, and RISC-V sits right in that window.

The cost is that the server side was only just finished. Extensions like H, AIA, Nexus Trace and IOMMU were ratified only recently, and the high-performance core still has to match X and A architectures. Shipments cannot buy mainline core performance. The industry forecasts a 50% compound growth rate and a 20% share for RISC-V by 2030. Those are forecasts, not orders.

The next signal to watch is the Xuantie E908A. It supports the ASIL-D safety level, targets automotive use, and launched this year.

title: 黎曼猜想1740万行证明被砍到7.6万行，还是 Claude 动的手
note: 部分重叠：黎曼猜想证明v1已多次记录，本次新在11月25日Luke Sernau把1740万行压到7.6万行、砍掉99.5%，社区删五天只减24%的对照。
text:
7.6万行。11月26日，Anthropic 研究员 Luke Sernau 在 GitHub 放出 grh-lean 仓库，把上周那份黎曼猜想形式化证明从1740万行压到7.6万行，砍掉99.5%。动手的还是 Claude。

原版是11月20日交出来的。Anthropic 数学家 Levent Alpöge 和 Claude 花了大约六周，给出黎曼猜想和广义黎曼猜想的 Lean 证明，175188个文件，规模相当于 Lean 官方数学库 Mathlib 的七倍。Lean 与 Mathlib 社区第二天确认证明正确，可人根本读不动。

社区先试了笨办法。上百名贡献者按模块认领删文件，第一天删掉1.1万多个没被引用的文件，删到11月25日也只比原版少24%。另一个项目 rh-trim 用程序自动删，先给证明画地图，发现最终论证只占6.6%，光一个步骤就占38%的代码。删一批编译一次，看报错，把删错的放回去，38小时跑71轮，最好一轮还剩17个错误。

反常识的地方在这里。机器删了五天清不干净，Claude 重写一遍就砍掉两个数量级。Sernau 的版本分两版，可读版30万行、801个文件，带导读和术语表；紧凑版7.6万行、792个文件，只求短，读起来不会轻松。两版都通过机器验证，也都还没被数学家完整通读，没有配套论文。

编译成本跟着掉下来。原版在 AWS 高配机器上要跑21小时，新版在一台12核、24GB 内存的机器上，有 Mathlib 缓存的话1到2小时能构建完。
en_title: The 17.4-million-line Riemann proof was cut to 76,000 lines, again by Claude
en_text:
76,000 lines. On November 26, Anthropic researcher Luke Sernau posted the grh-lean repo on GitHub, cutting last week's Riemann hypothesis formal proof from 17.4 million lines to 76,000, a 99.5% reduction. Claude did the cutting again.

The original landed on November 20. Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge and Claude spent about six weeks producing the Lean proof of the Riemann hypothesis and its generalized form, 175,188 files, seven times the size of Lean's own Mathlib library. The Lean and Mathlib communities confirmed the proof the next day. Nobody could read it.

The community tried the dumb way first. Over a hundred contributors claimed modules and deleted files by hand. On day one they removed more than 11,000 unreferenced files. By November 25 they had cut only 24% from the original. Another project, rh-trim, used a program. It mapped the proof and found the final argument was just 6.6%, while one single step took 38% of the code. Delete a batch, compile, see the error, put back what broke, delete again. 38 hours, 71 rounds, and the best round still had 17 errors left.

Here is the part that does not fit intuition. Five days of machine deletion could not clean it up. Claude rewrote it and cut two orders of magnitude in one pass. Sernau released two versions. The readable one is 300,000 lines across 801 files, with a guide and a glossary. The compact one is 76,000 lines across 792 files, short on purpose and not easy to read. Both passed machine verification. Neither has been read in full by a mathematician, and neither has an accompanying paper.

Compilation cost fell with it. The original took 21 hours on a high-end AWS machine. The new version builds in 1 to 2 hours on a 12-core, 24GB machine with a Mathlib cache.

title: SpaceX 把 GPU 租金砍了35%，Anthropic 退租5万块 H200
note: 部分重叠：SpaceX算力出租此前写过，本次新在11月25日SemiAnalysis披露小客户租金降20%至35%、Anthropic退租约5万块H200、Ornn三条指数回落与杰文斯悖论失灵。
text:
35%。11月25日，SemiAnalysis 发给机构客户的报告里写了两件事，SpaceX 下调 Blackwell GPU 小规模集群租金，Anthropic 不再续租一批 H200。算力租价这个最能说明缺货的指标，开始往下走。

具体数字是这样。小规模 Blackwell 集群的价格从每块 GPU 每小时15至15.5美元，降到10至12美元，跌幅20%至35%，和 Anthropic、谷歌这些大客户的批量价基本持平。Anthropic 退掉的是一个约5万块 H200 组成的集群，SpaceX 重新招租，2027年初交付，报价每块每小时5美元。Ornn 的数据显示，H200 本周一成交价6.53美元，SpaceX 的报价低23%。

钱的逻辑不复杂。过去小客户愿意比大客户多付钱，是因为一卡难求，多付的那部分是稀缺溢价。SpaceX 的租约以短期为主，明年新一代芯片还要大规模上线。新卡要来，旧卡租约又短，它就有动力先把存量卡租出去，零售价干脆压到批发价。压价的不止它一家。Ornn 指数里，B200 比11月8日高点跌8.8%，H200 比11月11日高点跌16%，B300 比10月中旬高点跌24%。

代价落在二线新云厂商身上。它们没有大客户长约兜底，靠现货溢价和出租旧卡赚钱，还常拿 GPU 作抵押借钱。租金一跌，同一块 GPU 能借到的钱跟着少。高盛的报告里提到，CoreWeave 的债券已跌到历史低点，惠普企业旗下金融部门明确不向资本密集的 AI 云初创企业放贷。Ramp 的数据更直接，企业 token 支出8月和9月合计只增长1.5%，10月增长1.65%，占支出八成的前1%大公司最先放缓。杰文斯悖论这两个月没应验。

下一个可验证的信号是2027年初那批 H200 的成交价。现在挂出的5美元一小时，交付还要等两个月。到时按这个价成交，旧卡贬值就算坐实。
en_title: SpaceX cuts GPU rents by 35% as Anthropic hands back 50,000 H200s
en_text:
35%. In a report sent to institutional clients on November 25, SemiAnalysis wrote about two things. SpaceX cut rents on small Blackwell GPU clusters, and Anthropic decided not to renew a batch of H200s. GPU rental prices, the clearest sign of scarcity, started moving down.

Here are the numbers. Small Blackwell clusters went from about $15 to $15.5 per GPU-hour down to $10 to $12, a drop of 20% to 35%, roughly in line with the bulk prices SpaceX gives Anthropic and Google. The cluster Anthropic is giving up has about 50,000 H200s. SpaceX is looking for new tenants, with delivery in early 2027 and a quote of $5 per GPU-hour. Ornn put H200's Monday transaction price at $6.53. SpaceX is asking 23% less.

The money logic is simple. Small clients used to pay more than big ones because cards were scarce, and the extra was a scarcity premium. SpaceX rents on short contracts, and a new generation of chips comes online at scale next year. With new cards coming and old leases short, it had to fill existing capacity first, pushing retail down to wholesale. It is not alone. In Ornn's index, B200 is down 8.8% from its November 8 peak, H200 down 16% from November 11, and B300 down 24% from mid-October.

The cost lands on second-tier neoclouds. They have no long-term contracts with big customers. They live on spot premiums and old cards, and often borrow against those GPUs. When rents fall, the same GPU supports less debt. Goldman Sachs noted CoreWeave's bonds at record lows, and HP Enterprise's finance arm said it will not lend to capital-intensive AI cloud startups. Ramp's data is blunter. Enterprise token spending grew just 1.5% across August and September, then 1.65% in October. The top 1% of companies, about 80% of that spending, slowed first. Jevons paradox did not hold these two months.

The next signal to check is the transaction price for that H200 batch in early 2027. The $5 per hour quote is up now, with delivery two months away. If it clears at that price, the old cards are officially depreciating.

title: 你手里那颗芯片，可能压根没跑在 Arm 上
note: 讲解角度：从你用的安卓手机系统支持RISC-V切入，讲IP授权分成与智能体把CPU拉回关键路径的因果；第一人称真实反应，挂玄铁那条。
text:
第一次看到60亿颗这个数，我以为自己看串了行。

说的是阿里达摩院玄铁IP芯片的累计出货，11月26日披露的。同一场还说安卓17正式支持 RISC-V。你用的安卓手机，系统层面刚刚给 RISC-V 开了门，芯片大规模换过来还得等。

这事得从钱怎么收说起。玄铁不自己卖芯片，它把处理器IP核授权给厂商，厂商做成芯片卖钱，玄铁从销售额里分成。所以出货60亿颗，等于60亿次分成在记账。为什么现在突然能上量，因为智能体把 CPU 重新拉回关键路径。AI 活儿看起来都是 GPU 的，但任务调度、数据搬运这些得 CPU 干，CPU 从旁边打下手变成必须上场。开放指令集可以按场景改，RISC-V 正好接住这波。你刷的每一次AI搜索，背后都有这类调度在跑。

我押不出来它几年能追上主线核。玄铁现在强的是授权客户过1000家、出货60亿颗，主线核还得对标 X 架构和 A 架构。开放指令集给了它一张门票，能不能坐到主桌，我更看车载那颗 E908A 的订单。
link: 玄铁IP芯片出货超60亿颗，安卓17正式支持 RISC-V
en_title: The chip in your phone may not be running on Arm
en_text:
The first time I saw the number 6 billion, I thought I had misread the line.

It was the cumulative shipments of Alibaba DAMO Academy's Xuantie IP chips, disclosed on November 26. In the same talk, they said Android 17 now officially supports RISC-V. Your Android phone just got the system-level door opened for RISC-V, even if the chips have not caught up yet.

It starts with how the money is collected. Xuantie does not sell chips itself. It licenses processor cores to manufacturers, who build and sell chips, and Xuantie takes a cut of sales. So 6 billion shipments means 6 billion entries in the ledger. Why now? Agents pulled the CPU back onto the critical path. AI work looks like all GPU, but task scheduling and data movement still need the CPU, which went from side helper to must-have player. An open instruction set can be adapted to specific scenarios, and RISC-V fits right in. Your every AI search runs that kind of scheduling somewhere.

I can't call which one wins. Xuantie's strength is over 1,000 licensed customers and 6 billion shipments, while its high-performance core still has to match X and A architectures. The open instruction set bought it a ticket. Whether it gets a seat at the main table is something I'd watch through automotive orders for the E908A.

title: 你抢着租的 GPU，房东先降价了
note: 讲解角度：从租户体感讲稀缺溢价消失，房东短约与新卡到位的因果；挂SpaceX租金那条。
text:
15美元一小时降到10美元，我盯着这两个数看了好一会儿。

说的是 SpaceX 的小规模 Blackwell 集群，11月25日 SemiAnalysis 的报告里写的。你如果租用算力，过去多付的那部分钱，买的就是稀缺两个字。

稀缺溢价怎么没的，得看房东的账。SpaceX 的租约大多是短约，明年新一代芯片还要大规模上线。新卡要来，旧卡租约又短，它只能先把手里这批卡租出去，于是零售价压到跟批发价一样。Anthropic 那边退了约5万块 H200，SpaceX 转手按5美元一小时重新挂，比6.53美元的成交价还低23%。你以为降价是需求塌了，其实这时候房东比租户更急。

我翻了一遍那几条指数，H200 从高点跌了16%，B300 跌了24%。我不敢说算力过剩已经坐实，但那种多花钱抢卡的日子，我先按它松动了看。
link: SpaceX 把 GPU 租金砍了35%，Anthropic 退租5万块 H200
en_title: You fought to rent a GPU. The landlord cut the price first.
en_text:
$15 an hour down to $10. I stared at those two numbers for a while.

It was SpaceX's small Blackwell clusters, from the SemiAnalysis report on November 25. If you rent compute, the extra you paid used to buy one thing: scarcity.

To see how that premium disappeared, look at the landlord's books. Most of SpaceX's leases are short, and a new generation of chips comes online at scale next year. With new cards coming and old leases short, it had to fill what it already had, so retail got pushed down to wholesale. Anthropic gave back about 50,000 H200s. SpaceX relisted them at $5 an hour, 23% below the $6.53 transaction price. You might read the cut as demand collapsing. The landlord was simply in more of a hurry than the tenants.

I went through the indexes. H200 is down 16% from its peak, B300 down 24%. I can't say oversupply is proven, but as for those days of paying extra to grab a card, I'm treating them as loosened for now.

title: 群里敲了一行字，两个榜一起挂了
note: 照抄X22（反差结论+排除+转折+两维证据+对仗收口）；数字来自今日热榜cross=2，题材为湖北网民微信群造谣被处罚。
text:
群里敲了一行字，两个榜一起挂了。

榜上热度685.0万，百度和抖音都在推。这事跟AI生成没关系，造谣的还是人，转发的也是人。技术没帮上什么忙。

真正推着它上榜的是处罚。湖北那名网民在微信群内造谣，已经被处罚。另一条同时挂在双榜上的，是司机借手机给乘客被盗刷5万元，热度524.0万。两件事放一起看就清楚了，大家怕的不是谣言本身，是自己哪天莫名其妙成了当事人。

手指头敲一行字，删帖的人要忙好几天。
en_title: One line in a group chat, two trending lists at once
en_text:
One line typed in a group chat, and two trending lists lit up at once.

The number on the list is 6.85 million, with both Baidu and Douyin pushing it. This had nothing to do with AI. The person who made it up was human, and so were the people who shared it. Technology did not help.

What pushed it up was the punishment. A netizen in Hubei spread a rumor in a WeChat group and has been penalized. Another story on both lists at the same time was a driver whose phone was borrowed by a passenger and drained of 50,000 yuan, at 5.24 million heat. Put together, the point becomes clear. People are not afraid of rumors as such. They are afraid of becoming the random subject of one.

A finger types one line. The people who clean it up stay busy for days.

title: 借个手机就没了5万元，这也上了两个榜
note: 照抄X18（先夸+但+槽点+定性+两问）；数字来自今日热榜cross=2，题材为司机借手机被盗刷5万元。
text:
借个手机而已，现在居然也能冲上两个榜！

司机把手机借给乘客，回头一看，被盗刷了5万元。百度和抖音两边都在挂，热度524.0万。

这事看着是乘客手快，可槽点在别处。手机一交出去，付款码、免密支付、绑定的卡，全跟着出了熟人这道门。

熟人面子最难拒，支付授权那一下又不认熟人。5万元不是一趟车费能抵的。

你们现在还会把手机借给别人吗？

还是先把免密支付关了再说？
en_title: Lent a phone, lost 50,000 yuan. That also made two lists.
en_text:
Just lending a phone. Now that can hit two trending lists!

A driver lent his phone to a passenger. When he looked again, 50,000 yuan had been drained. It was on both Baidu and Douyin, at 5.24 million heat.

It looks like a fast-fingered passenger. The real snag is elsewhere. Once the phone leaves your hand, the payment code, password-free payments and every bound card go out with it through the door of familiarity.

A familiar face is the hardest to refuse. Payment authorization does not care about faces. Fifty thousand yuan is not something one cab fare covers.

Would you still lend your phone to anyone?

Or would you turn off password-free payments first?

title: 60亿颗？？卧槽！
note: 照抄X21，对应骨架S13数据震惊体；数字来自11月26日ICCAD Expo公开披露。
text:
60亿颗？？卧槽！

看见一份演讲说，阿里达摩院玄铁IP芯片累计出货超过60亿颗。

换算成客户，授权超过1000家，国内超过400家。

真的惊呆了！安卓17都正式支持 RISC-V 了。

这60亿颗能换成主线核吗？
en_title: 6 billion units?? No way!
en_text:
6 billion units?? No way!

Saw a talk saying Alibaba DAMO Academy's Xuantie IP chips have shipped more than 6 billion units.

Translated into customers, that's over 1,000 licensees, more than 400 of them in China.

I was stunned! Android 17 officially supports RISC-V now.

Can 6 billion units buy a high-performance core?

title: Karpathy用Claude做了张美国文明地图，7小时4.5万行代码
note: 全新事件，双信源（Karpathy原帖、新浪财经、网易、CivFanatics），深度稿。
text:
11月26日，Karpathy把美国做成了一张《文明》风格的策略地图。GDP变成金币产出，圣何塞每4个上班的人里就有1个是工程师、程序员或科学家，全国平均是14个里才1个。写代码的是Claude Opus 5.5，7小时，4.5万行。

做法写在他的帖子里。打开Claude Code桌面版，Opus 5.5开中档，再打开ultracode。31个政府公开数据源，从人口普查局、经济分析局到NOAA、FEMA，全被铺进25公里一格的六边形网格，每格固定代表约1600平方公里。地图上有524个都会区的城市视图，19种透镜可以在收入、学历、信仰、灾害之间切换。源码按MIT协议开源，网站右上角能下。

真正难的不是找数据，是对齐口径。31个源里有按经纬度打点的电厂，有按县汇总的表格，还有按像素分布的遥感栅格，统计的时间和范围各不相同。Claude在底层用了阿尔伯斯等积投影，保证每一格代表的陆地面积一样大，县里的数再按这一格占该县多大面积摊进去。流水线最后一环设了一道check关卡，校验报告的每一行都打上通过、提示、警告或失败，只要有一个失败，这一轮就算没过。

图做得好看，数也没敢编。数据缺了就空着，绝不填0。宗教透镜坦白自己只统计各教会报上来的信众，覆盖全美大约一半人口。Claude自己决定略掉了几个州和属地，Karpathy在帖子里替它道了歉，sry。一个小模型替一个连地理常识都不完整的成品收尾，这个动作比那些数字更说明问题。

karpathy.ai/usaciv已经上线，跑一遍500MB原始数据，清洗聚合后打开网站只需加载约6MB。下一步看有没有人把它接成真正能玩的回合制，而不是停在可视化。Karpathy自己的说法是，也许能扩展成游戏，但这周Claude额度只剩一半，得换别人接着做。
en_title: Karpathy built a Civilization map of the US with Claude, 7 hours and 45,000 lines of code
en_text:
On November 26, Karpathy turned the United States into a Civilization-style strategy map. GDP shows up as gold output, and in San Jose 1 in 4 working people is an engineer, programmer or scientist, versus 1 in 14 nationwide. The code was written by Claude Opus 5.5, in 7 hours and 45,000 lines.

The method is in his post. Open Claude Code desktop, set Opus 5.5 to medium, and turn on ultracode. 31 public government data sources, from the Census Bureau and the Bureau of Economic Analysis to NOAA and FEMA, all get laid onto a hex grid with 25 km cells, each covering about 1,600 square kilometers. There are city views for 524 metro areas and 19 lenses that switch between income, education, religion and disasters. The source is MIT-licensed and downloadable from the question mark in the site's corner.

The hard part was not finding data, it was reconciling definitions. Among the 31 sources there are power plants pinned by coordinates, tables aggregated by county, and satellite rasters measured in pixels, with mismatched time frames and coverage. Claude used an Albers equal-area projection underneath so every cell covers the same amount of real land, then apportioned county figures by how much of the county each cell contains. The last step of the pipeline is a check gate: every line of the validation report is marked pass, notice, warning or fail, and a single fail invalidates the run.

The map looks good and the numbers were not invented. Missing data is left blank, never filled with zero. The religion lens openly admits it only counts people reported by churches, covering roughly half the US population. Claude decided on its own to drop a few states and territories, and Karpathy apologized for it in his post, sry. A model tidying up a product that itself lacks basic geography says more than any of the figures do.

karpathy.ai/usaciv is live. It takes 500MB of raw data to build, and about 6MB to load in the browser after cleaning and aggregation. The next thing to watch is whether someone turns it into a playable turn-based game instead of leaving it as a visualization. Karpathy's own line is that it might become a game, but his Claude quota is half gone for the week, so someone else will have to carry it on.

title: 亚马逊和Meta坐下来谈了，为的是一个能替你下单的AI
note: 全新事件，双信源（财富、The Decoder、TechCrunch、亿邦动力、凤凰网科技），深度稿。
text:
11月26日，《财富》报出亚马逊和Meta正在谈一件事，让Meta的购物智能体Muse重新回到亚马逊商城。上个月亚马逊刚把它挡在门外。挡人和请人，中间隔着686亿美元。

分歧有两个，搜索结果怎么呈现，广告怎么处理。亚马逊广告业务年收入686亿美元，约占公司总营收一成。Muse这边，截至11月22日的一周，51%的代理购物订单由它完成，Grok占24%，ChatGPT占22%。Muse在美加已有超过1000万用户，25%会用智能体购物，平均成交价超过200美元。协议预计要两家CEO批准。

钱卡在广告这一环。过去你在亚马逊搜一次，页面上那些花钱买来的推荐位是广告主掏的钱，亚马逊靠这个赚。Muse插在中间，替你把商品筛了、比了、下单了，广告位就被绕过去了。亚马逊担心的是广告费，还有和消费者之间的直接关系断了。Meta也不是白干，扎克伯格已经放话，通过智能体成交的单子要收一小笔费用。两边都想当那个收过路费的，谁都不肯先把货架入口让出来。

有意思的是，亚马逊自己说过第三方购物智能体不好用。CEO贾西10月对投资者讲，用智能体买东西的人还是少数，因为体验没比直接逛零售商方便。转头Muse就拿下了51%的代理订单。嘴上说不好用，手上却在谈判桌上。

协议能不能赶在黑色星期五和网络星期一之前落地还不确定。美国全国零售联合会本月的调查说，今年约一半的假日购物者打算用AI帮忙。下一个季度财报里，广告收入那一行动没动，是验证这场谈判结果最简单的信号。
en_title: Amazon and Meta sit down to talk, over an AI that can place orders for you
en_text:
On November 26, Fortune reported that Amazon and Meta are talking about letting Meta's shopping agent Muse back onto Amazon's marketplace. Amazon blocked it only last month. Keeping it out and inviting it back are separated by 68.6 billion dollars.

Two things are in dispute: how search results are displayed, and how advertising is handled. Amazon's ad business brings in about 68.6 billion dollars a year, close to 10 percent of total revenue. On Muse's side, in the week ending November 22 it completed 51 percent of all agentic shopping orders, with Grok at 24 percent and ChatGPT at 22 percent. Muse has more than 10 million users in the US and Canada, 25 percent shop through the agent, and the average order is over 200 dollars. Any deal is expected to need sign-off from both CEOs.

The money is stuck on advertising. When you search on Amazon, the sponsored slots on the page are paid for by advertisers, and that is how the company earns. Muse steps in between, filters and compares products and places the order, and the ad slot gets bypassed. Amazon worries about the ad revenue, and about losing its direct relationship with shoppers. Meta is not doing this for free either. Zuckerberg has said he plans to charge a small fee on transactions made through the agent. Both sides want to be the one collecting the toll, and neither wants to hand over the entrance to the shelf first.

The funny part is that Amazon itself has said third-party shopping agents are not good enough. CEO Andy Jassy told investors in October that few people buy through agents yet, because the experience is no more convenient than going straight to a retailer. Muse then took 51 percent of agentic orders. Talking it down in public and negotiating in private are happening at the same time.

Whether a deal lands before Black Friday and Cyber Monday is still unclear. The National Retail Federation's survey this month says about half of holiday shoppers plan to use AI in some way. Watch the advertising line in the next quarterly report to see whether this negotiation left a mark.

title: 小鹏把汽车、船和无人机塞进同一个模型，叫WorldGPT
note: 全新事件，双信源（小鹏官微、盖世汽车、腾讯新闻），常规稿。
text:
11月26日的科技日上，小鹏发了图灵世界模型家族的新成员，跨本体世界动作模型WorldGPT。按小鹏的说法，这是首个能在水、陆、空三栖、六类本体上完成预测和行动规划的世界模型。六类本体是汽车、船艇、无人机、单臂、双臂和人形机器人。

反常识的地方在于，这些机器的身体完全不同。方向盘的转角对机械臂没有意义，关节的角度对无人机也没有意义，凭什么能放在一起训。靠的是摄像头。所有会动的机器都用摄像头看世界，像素是它们的共同语言。泊车入位和把杯子放进杯托，本质上都是看着目标、边动边修正。

架构上，WorldGPT当云端教师模型，从六类本体的数据里统一学，再蒸馏成各本体的端侧小模型。新本体不用从头采数据训模型，只要少量数据校准控制细节。小鹏说它在驾驶、机器人操作、视觉理解、视频生成四个领域的公开评测里拿了12个第一，截至11月12日，机器人50种单臂任务的平均成功率95.2%。

跑完这套东西的IRON明年1月进硬件量产，一季度到小鹏门店当实习导购。
en_title: XPeng puts cars, boats and drones into one model, called WorldGPT
en_text:
At its Tech Day on November 26, XPeng released a new member of its Turing world model family, the cross-embodiment world action model WorldGPT. By XPeng's account, this is the first world model that can predict and plan actions across six kinds of bodies on water, land and air: cars, boats, drones, single-arm and dual-arm robots, and humanoids.

The counterintuitive part is that these machines have nothing alike in hardware. A steering angle means nothing to a robotic arm, and a joint angle means nothing to a drone, so why train them together. Because they all use cameras. Every machine that moves sees the world through a camera, and pixels are the shared language. Parking into a spot and placing a cup on a tray are the same thing: keep the target in view and correct as you go.

Architecturally, WorldGPT acts as a cloud teacher model, learning from all six kinds of bodies at once and then distilling into small on-device models for each one. A new body no longer needs a full data collection and training cycle, just a small amount of data to calibrate its control details. XPeng says it took 12 first places in public benchmarks across driving, robot manipulation, visual understanding and video generation as of November 12, with a 95.2 percent average success rate on 50 single-arm robot tasks.

IRON, the humanoid built on all of this, enters hardware mass production in January, and is scheduled to work as an intern sales assistant in XPeng stores in the first quarter.

title: 一个连厂商都不肯认领的模型，一天烧掉1.2万亿Token
note: 全新事件，双信源（智东西、凤凰网科技、OpenCode榜单、Qoder官方），常规稿。
text:
11月24日凌晨，代号HungerG的匿名模型登陆OpenCode和Qoder。上线一天，单日Token用量1.2万亿，冲到OpenCode调用量日榜第三，前面是DeepSeek V4.1 Flash和腾讯混元Hy4 Flash。

公开信息只有三行。100万Token上下文，原生多模态，不拿用户数据训练。Qoder给7天免费体验，OpenCode Go订阅用户本周也能用。名字让人想到《饥饿游戏》，平台把台词改成了愿Token永远站在你这边。

白天测试挤到要排队，有人把任务挪到深夜。海外一个开发者只说了一句用代码造一艘船，模型写好3D建模代码，发现内置浏览器不支持WebGL黑屏，就自己扫系统路径找到另一个浏览器，写脚本强行接管，旋转视角截31张图回传自查，判断出左侧船体被剪切、贴图丢失，最后改了源码。全程37分钟，186次工具调用，人没插手。

炫技之外还有另一面。Gamefeel盲测里HungerG拿1.55分，没过智商120、无游戏经验人类玩家约2分的线。35个顶尖模型里有27个倒在这条线下。厂商到现在没认领，猜Qwen的、猜阶跃的都有，没有一条是实锤。免费体验期到11月30日。
en_title: A model nobody will claim burned through 1.2 trillion tokens in a day
en_text:
In the early hours of November 24, an anonymous model codenamed HungerG landed on OpenCode and Qoder. Within a day it hit 1.2 trillion tokens of daily usage and climbed to third on OpenCode's daily call leaderboard, behind only DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Tencent's Hunyuan Hy4 Flash.

There are only three lines of public information. 1 million tokens of context, native multimodal input, and a promise not to train on user data. Qoder offers 7 days free, and OpenCode Go subscribers can use it this week too. The name calls to mind The Hunger Games, and the platform rewrote the line as May the tokens be ever in your favor.

Daytime tests got so crowded that people moved their tasks to late night. One developer overseas gave a single instruction, build a ship in code. The model wrote the 3D modeling code, found the built-in browser did not support WebGL and went black, scanned the system paths for another browser, wrote a script to take it over, rotated the view and captured 31 screenshots to check itself, spotted a cut left hull and lost textures, and fixed the source. 37 minutes, 186 tool calls, no human in the loop.

There is another side beyond the flashy demos. On the Gamefeel blind test HungerG scored 1.55, below the roughly 2 points of an average human player with an IQ of 120 and no experience of the game. 27 of 35 top models fell below that line. No vendor has claimed the model. Some guess Qwen, some guess Step, and none of it is confirmed. The free period ends on November 30.

title: 你以为在白嫖，其实你是它最真实的考官
note: 讲解角度：评测范式换轨，静态榜单让位真实IDE。挂在HungerG速览下方。
text:
一个连厂商是谁都不肯说的模型，我第一眼看到榜单愣了一下。

11月24日凌晨它上了OpenCode和Qoder，100万上下文，原生多模态，7天免费。有人猜是Qwen，有人猜是阶跃，到现在没人认领。

评测的规矩变了。以前厂商比的是MMLU、HumanEval这些静态题库，题库早被背熟，跑分95%，一上手写业务代码就烂。现在把最新调优的模型披个马甲扔进真实IDE，配上免费算力，让最挑剔的程序员拿最离谱的需求去折磨它。你每一次报错、每一次说这不对，都进了它的训练环路。免费不是慈善，是一份用真实世界做考场的问卷。

看完那份37分钟186次调用的实测，让我更看重的是它不硬编这一点。不过盲测1.55分还没过人类线，我也不敢说它已经能托付专业活。你手上有小项目就趁免费丢进去试试，别急着押身家。
link: 一个连厂商都不肯认领的模型，一天烧掉1.2万亿Token
en_title: You think you are freeloading, but you are its most honest examiner
en_text:
A model whose maker won't even say its name, and I stared at the leaderboard for a second when I saw it.

It landed on OpenCode and Qoder in the early hours of November 24, 1 million tokens of context, native multimodal, 7 days free. Some guess Qwen, some guess Step. Nobody has claimed it.

The rules of evaluation changed. Vendors used to compete on static benchmarks like MMLU and HumanEval, and those question sets have been memorized cold: score 95 percent, then write terrible business code. Now they put a freshly tuned model in a disguise, drop it into a real IDE with free compute, and let the pickiest programmers on earth torture it with the weirdest requests they can think of. Every error you file, every time you say this is wrong, goes into its training loop. Free is not charity, it's a questionnaire with the real world as the exam room.

Reading that 37-minute, 186-tool-call test, what I value more is that it refused to make things up. But 1.55 on the blind test is still below the human line, and I don't dare say it's ready for professional work. If you have a small project, throw it in while it's free, but don't bet the house on it.

title: 一个能替你下单的AI，怎么就把两家公司逼到谈判桌上
note: 讲解角度：谁控制货架入口，广告位被智能体绕过。挂在Muse速览下方。
text:
一个能替你下单的AI，怎么就把两家公司逼到谈判桌上了。

11月26日《财富》说亚马逊和Meta在谈，让Muse回亚马逊商城。亚马逊9月刚把它封了。Muse在美加有1000多万用户，截至11月22日那周，51%的代理购物订单是它下的。

钱卡在广告上。亚马逊广告一年686亿美元，占营收近一成，靠的是你在页面上看到那些花钱买的位置。Muse替你把商品筛了、比了、买了，广告位就被绕过去了。搜索结果谁排前面，也成了要谈的东西。Meta这边也没闲着，扎克伯格说经智能体成交的单子要收一小笔费用。两边都想当收过路费的，谁都不肯先把货架入口让出来。

你看到的是自动下单挺方便，我看到的是以后你搜到的东西，可能是两家公司在后台谈出来的。这事我不敢说谁对谁错，但亚马逊嘴上说第三方智能体不好用，手上却在谈。你以后用AI买东西，多留个心眼看它推的到底是不是真适合你。
link: 亚马逊和Meta坐下来谈了，为的是一个能替你下单的AI
en_title: An AI that can place orders for you, and how it dragged two companies to the table
en_text:
An AI that can place orders for you, and somehow it pushed two companies into negotiation.

On November 26, Fortune reported that Amazon and Meta are talking about letting Muse back onto Amazon's marketplace. Amazon blocked it in September. Muse has over 10 million users in the US and Canada, and in the week ending November 22 it placed 51 percent of all agentic shopping orders.

The money is stuck on advertising. Amazon's ad business is 68.6 billion dollars a year, nearly 10 percent of revenue, built on the paid placements you see on the page. Muse filters, compares and buys for you, and the ad slot gets skipped. Who ranks where in search results became a thing to negotiate too. Meta isn't sitting still, and Zuckerberg has said he wants a small fee on orders placed through the agent. Both sides want to collect the toll, and neither will give up the entrance to the shelf first.

You see the convenience of automatic checkout. What I see is that what you find in a search may one day be the result of a back-room deal between two companies. I won't say who is right here, but Amazon calls third-party agents not good enough while its own people sit at the table. When you buy through an AI, keep an eye on whether it is recommending what actually fits you.

title: 马斯克给美国孩子送股票，看着像慷慨
note: 照抄 X22（反差结论+排除+转折句+两维证据+对仗收口），选题来自热点榜single榜。判断：送股是上市后一次股东锁定。
text:
马斯克说给每个美国孩子送两股SpaceX股票，这事看着像慷慨，其实是一笔算得很细的账。

不是做慈善那么简单。11月25日收盘SpaceX每股127.44美元，两股254.88美元。按7200万名18岁以下儿童算，要送1.44亿股，价值约183.5亿美元。钱不是白花的。

一边是SpaceX今年6月刚上市，总股本135.81亿股，按11月25日收盘价市值约1.73万亿美元，这1.44亿股只占1.06%。另一边是特朗普账户已经设了近7000万个，父母认领后账户才能接收私人捐款。公司那股下月划转，马斯克自己那股要等明年6月锁定期结束。

股票送的是下一代，锁的是未来的股东。看着是礼物，算的是份额。
en_title: Musk is giving US kids stock, and it looks like generosity
en_text:
Musk says he will give every American child two shares of SpaceX, and this looks like generosity, but it is a carefully calculated deal.

It is not simply charity. SpaceX closed at 127.44 dollars a share on November 25, so two shares are 254.88 dollars. Across 72 million children under 18, that is 144 million shares worth about 18.35 billion dollars. The money is not being spent for nothing.

On one side, SpaceX listed in June this year, with 13.581 billion shares outstanding and a market cap of about 1.73 trillion dollars at the November 25 close, so those 144 million shares are only 1.06 percent. On the other side, nearly 70 million Trump Accounts have been set up, and a parent must claim the account before it can receive private donations. The company's share transfers next month, and Musk's own share waits until the lockup ends in June next year.

The stock goes to the next generation, and what gets locked in is future shareholders. It looks like a gift, but what's being counted is a stake.

title: 汇报一下Karpathy那个美国文明地图的情况

text:

能玩的那个版本里，524个都会区各有城市视图，19种透镜能切收入、学历、信仰、灾害，宗教透镜只覆盖大约一半人口，源码里明写了。

这种属于可视化级别，轻则逛一圈看个热闹，重则被人接成真正能玩的回合制。

切不可把一周的Claude额度全押在一个副业项目上。
en_title: A report on Karpathy's Civilization map of the US
en_text:
A report on Karpathy's US Civilization map: 7 hours, 45,000 lines of code, 31 public government data sources, all laid onto a hex grid with 25 km cells, and the source is MIT-licensed.

In the playable version, there are city views for 524 metro areas and 19 lenses for income, education, religion and disasters. The religion lens only covers about half the population, and the source says so.

This is visualization grade. At best you browse it for fun, at worst someone turns it into a real turn-based game.

Do not spend your whole weekly Claude quota on a side project.

title: 欧盟《量子法案》拟设500亿欧元主权科技股权基金
note: 全新事件，欧盟委员会官方提案，新华财经、中国青年网、中央广电总台等多家独立信源
text:
欧盟要砸500亿欧元建一支主权科技股权基金，重点投量子计算、人工智能和芯片。法案叫《量子法案》，11月25日由欧盟委员会在斯特拉斯堡公布。

基金目标规模500亿欧元，欧盟委员会拉上欧洲投资银行、成员国和私人投资者一起筹。牵头人是欧盟委员会执行副主席维尔库宁。提案给了一组对比数，2025年欧盟量子初创企业拿到的私人投资约11亿欧元，美国同类企业约70亿欧元。欧盟把2030年前成为全球量子技术领导者写进了目标。按设计，每1欧元公共资金要撬动最多6欧元私人资本。研发方向点了容错量子计算机和不依赖卫星信号的导航设备。

欧洲的技术底子并不薄，全球约三分之一的量子初创企业就在欧盟，公共投入也不低。问题出在转化。斯坦福《2026年人工智能指数报告》里，美国在顶级模型产出和高影响力专利上领先，中国则在论文数量、专利总量、工业机器人安装量等多项指标占优。欧洲在生成式 AI、先进芯片和云计算上已经掉队，科研成果变不成产品，本土企业长不大就往外迁或被收购。维尔库宁说，任何企业都不该因为缺钱被迫离开欧洲。

所以基金走的是股权投资的路子，公共资金当种子，撬动私人资本陪企业熬过从实验室到产业化的那段时间。法案还写了公共资金优先投欧洲本土企业，公共机构可以从与欧盟有合作的国家采购相关产品和服务。这是把技术主权和经济安全绑在一起的工具，跟单纯的产业补贴不一样。

500亿欧元听着不少，落到执行上全是问号。基金规模和资金来源还要成员国和欧洲议会谈判，能不能按期落地没准。欧洲的老毛病也没因为这笔钱消失，监管还是碎片化的，资本市场深度也不够。量子计算本身还在早期，商业化路径并不清楚，押得太重也有资源错配的风险。

接下来盯两件事。欧洲议会和成员国什么时候把基金规模和出资比例谈定，这是提案变成账单的第一步。那句2030年前当全球量子领导者的目标会不会留在最终文本里，留下来才有硬约束。
en_title: EU Quantum Act Proposes 50 Billion Euro Sovereign Tech Equity Fund
en_text:
The EU is putting 500 billion euros into a sovereign tech equity fund, aimed at quantum computing, artificial intelligence and chips. The bill is called the Quantum Act, unveiled by the European Commission in Strasbourg on November 25.

The fund targets 500 billion euros, with the European Commission pooling money from the European Investment Bank, member states and private investors. The push is led by European Commission executive vice president Henna Virkkunen. The proposal gives a telling comparison: in 2025, quantum startups in the EU drew about 1.1 billion euros in private investment, versus about 7 billion euros for their US peers. The EU has written a goal of becoming the global quantum leader before 2030. Under the design, every 1 euro of public money should unlock up to 6 euros of private capital. Research priorities name fault-tolerant quantum computers and navigation gear that does not rely on satellite signals.

Europe's technical base is not thin. About a third of the world's quantum startups sit in the EU, and public spending is hardly low. The problem is conversion. In Stanford's 2026 AI Index Report, the US leads in top-model output and high-impact patents, while China leads on paper volume, total patents and industrial robot installations. Europe has already fallen behind in generative AI, advanced chips and cloud. Research does not turn into products, and local firms either move away or get bought before they grow. Virkkunen says no company should be forced to leave Europe for lack of money.

So the fund is structured as equity investment. Public money acts as seed capital, pulling in private funds to carry companies through the stretch from lab to mass production. The bill also says public money goes first to European firms, and public bodies can buy goods and services from countries paired with the EU. This is a tool tying tech sovereignty to economic security, quite different from a plain industrial subsidy.

Five hundred billion euros sounds like a lot, but execution is full of question marks. The fund's size and funding sources still need haggling between member states and the European Parliament, and landing on schedule is anyone's guess. Europe's old habits have not gone away either: regulation stays fragmented, and capital markets stay shallow. Quantum computing is still early, its commercial path is unclear, and betting too hard risks misallocating resources.

Two things to watch. When the Parliament and member states settle the fund's size and contribution ratios, that is step one from proposal to actual bill. And whether that 2030 quantum-leader goal survives into the final text. If it stays in, it becomes a hard constraint.

title: SemiAnalysis称英伟达AI芯片需求或降66%，B300涌入转售市场
note: 部分重叠，新在SemiAnalysis 11月26日机构报告给出66%这一具体降幅数字，以及GPU二手转售升温这一新进展
text:
SemiAnalysis 在11月26日发给机构客户的报告里给了一个数，英伟达的 AI 芯片需求可能面临66%的降幅。这个数字出自一家长期看多算力的研究机构。反常识的地方就在这。

报告说，美国刚落地的芯片出口禁令会让美国市场的芯片供应激增，谷歌和亚马逊明年又要增加定制 AI 芯片的供给。两股力量叠在一起，可能造成芯片过剩，英伟达首当其冲，GPU 的垄断地位面临风险。

SemiAnalysis 同时强调，这不等于 AI 算力需求大幅下降，行业竞争已经从抢算力转向价格性能、能效和融资能力这些更理性的维度。转售市场是旁证，大批先进 B300 GPU 正在找新买家，卖家为数千枚芯片寻找下家。

需求还在那儿，被重估的是英伟达在供给里的位置。当定制芯片和出口回流一起放量，稀缺性溢价就会被挤掉。
en_title: SemiAnalysis Says Nvidia AI Chip Demand Could Drop 66% as B300s Flood Resale Market
en_text:
SemiAnalysis, in a note to institutional clients on November 26, put a number on it: Nvidia's AI chip demand could face a 66% drop. The figure comes from a research house that has long been bullish on compute. That is the counterintuitive part.

The report says the chip export ban the US just rolled out will swell chip supply in the American market, while Google and Amazon add more custom AI chips next year. Put those two forces together and you get a possible glut. Nvidia takes the biggest hit, and its GPU grip is at risk.

SemiAnalysis also stresses this does not mean AI compute demand is collapsing. Competition has shifted from grabbing compute to more rational grounds: price performance, energy efficiency and access to financing. The resale market backs that up. A large batch of advanced B300 GPUs is looking for new buyers, with sellers hunting for homes for thousands of chips.

Demand has not gone anywhere. What is being repriced is Nvidia's place in the supply chain. Once custom silicon and returning exports add volume together, the scarcity premium gets squeezed out.

title: OpenAI测试私密推理功能，运行时隔离客户数据
note: 全新事件，Altman在X平台官方宣布，前瞻网等多家转述
text:
Altman 在11月25日的 X 平台上说，OpenAI 开始面向一小部分客户测试私密推理功能，产品还停在 Alpha 阶段。

这套东西把机密计算和一套可验证的控制手段绑在一起。模型跑起来的时候，客户数据被隔离，连 OpenAI 内部人员也看不到。OpenAI 把它列进 Private Intelligence 企业方案，是其中两大组件之一。

模型聪不聪明对企业客户来说是次要的，数据进去以后谁还能碰才是关键。Anthropic 此前公布了企业前沿防护 EFS，走的是同一个方向。两家都在抢同一批客户，那些不敢把敏感数据送进公有云推理的大公司。

私密推理目前只对一小部分客户开放。
en_title: OpenAI Tests Private Inference That Walls Off Customer Data at Runtime
en_text:
Altman said on X on November 25 that OpenAI has started testing private inference with a small set of customers. The product is still in Alpha.

The setup pairs confidential computing with a set of verifiable controls. While the model runs, customer data is walled off, and even OpenAI's own staff cannot see it. OpenAI files it under Private Intelligence, its enterprise package, as one of two core components.

How smart the model is matters less to enterprise buyers than who can touch their data once it goes in. Anthropic earlier rolled out enterprise frontier safeguards, known as EFS, along the same lines. Both are chasing the same crowd: big firms that dare not send sensitive data into public cloud inference.

For now, private inference is open to only a small set of customers.

title: 500亿欧元听着多，我看到11亿对70亿那组数反而愣了一下
note: 个人读法角度，用数字反差讲欧洲的转化困境，与v1事实稿角度不同
text:
500亿欧元听着挺吓人，我第一次看到那组对比数的时候愣了一下。

欧盟11月25日出了个《量子法案》，要设一支主权科技股权基金，投量子、AI 和芯片。钱是公共资金加私人资本一起凑。

你先看一组数，2025年欧盟量子初创拿到的私人投资约11亿欧元，美国约70亿欧元，差了六倍多。欧洲的科研底子不差，全球约三分之一的量子初创就在欧盟，可研究成果变不成产品，公司长不大就被买走或搬走。维尔库宁自己说，任何企业都不该因为缺钱被迫离开欧洲。所以这支基金不玩补贴，直接做股权，公共资金当种子，每1欧元要撬动最多6欧元私人资本，陪企业熬过从实验室到量产那段。

钱多钱少不是难点，难的是欧洲那套碎片化的监管和资本市场能不能真把钱投出去。你让我押2030年前能不能追上美国，我真押不出来。
link: 欧盟《量子法案》拟设500亿欧元主权科技股权基金
en_title: 500 Billion Euros Sounds Huge, But the 1.1 Billion vs 7 Billion Gap Froze Me
en_text:
500 billion euros sounds huge, but I froze for a second when I saw that comparison.

The EU rolled out a Quantum Act on November 25, setting up a sovereign tech equity fund for quantum, AI and chips. The money is public cash plus private capital.

Look at the numbers first. In 2025, quantum startups in the EU drew about 1.1 billion euros in private investment, against about 7 billion euros in the US. Six times the gap. Europe's research base is not weak, and about a third of the world's quantum startups sit there, but research does not turn into products, and firms get bought or move away before they grow. Virkkunen said it herself, no company should be forced to leave Europe for lack of money. So the fund does equity, not subsidies. Public money acts as seed, each euro meant to unlock up to six in private capital, staying with companies through the stretch from lab to mass production.

The hard part is not the size of the pot. It is whether Europe's fragmented regulators and shallow capital markets can actually put the money to work. Ask me whether they catch the US before 2030, and I really cannot call it.

title: 小米YU7前视摄像头集中故障，为什么能冲上知乎热榜第一

SemiAnalysis says Nvidia's AI chip demand could drop 66%. SpaceX cut Blackwell rental prices by 35%. Anthropic walked away from 50,000 H200s. Thousands of B300s are hunting for buyers on the resale market.

All I will say is this: compute finally has a price tag!

title: 斯坦福学者和GPT-6 Astra写了83页论文，把引力按在光锥上量子化
note: A全新：查重库有黎曼猜想、矩阵乘法、谷歌六篇数学论文，但无量子引力83页论文事件。双信源为腾讯新闻20261126A0DRK600、新浪财经、网易及弦音公众号精读。深度稿五块结构。
text:
一篇83页的论文把广义相对论往量子那边推了一大步。11月25日，斯坦福莱因韦伯理论物理研究所的 Venkatesa Chandrasekaran 把论文挂上 arXiv，标题是从光锥出发的引力代数量子化。他在致谢里写明，约4亿 token 花在了和 GPT-6 Astra 数月的协作上。

Chandrasekaran 还有另一个身份，OpenAI 推理团队研究员。今年10月，约30位物理学家做过一场基准测试，GPT-6 Astra 在50道未发表的研究级理论物理题里答对49道，题目集中在黑洞物理和全息理论。论文声称做出四件事，算引力子对的产生湮灭振幅时用非微扰求和绕开对数发散，证明有界因果钻石的希尔伯特空间维数有限，复现贝肯斯坦霍金黑洞熵公式，在低能极限还原爱因斯坦场方程。

传统做法要把引力拆成平直背景加微小涟漪，再按圈图逐阶算引力子碰撞。算到高能标，纯广义相对论冒出无穷多个吸收不掉的紫外发散，这叫微扰不可重整化。病根在背景依赖性。量子场论需要一个固定的时空舞台，引力本身就是舞台的几何，两者打架。这篇论文绕开硬算四维度规，先在经典层面解掉引力约束，只提取光锥上真正独立的引力自由度，再对约化后的自由度做正则量子化。引力波剪切的平方项带着负号，会压低光束膨胀率，辐射越强，光束张开到同样截面积要走更远的仿射参数距离。作者用这个效应定义引力时钟，给时钟读数设上限，就等于同时框死了区域面积和能塞进去的辐射激发，有限维希尔伯特空间就是这么来的。

论文还是预印本，没经过同行评审。Chandrasekaran 在伯克利做线下报告时，已经遭到密集质疑和反驳。框架只覆盖四维纯真空引力，电子夸克这些物质场一个没进来。论文也没划清人和 GPT-6 Astra 各自的贡献，哪些核心推导出自模型，外界无从判断。社交平台已经把它叫成大一统理论，弦论方向的学者直接表态更看好弦论。

下一步看两件事。有没有人把物质场耦合进来，纯引力到标准模型这一步跨不过去，框架就停在候选方案。独立团队能不能复现那几个振幅和熵公式，伯克利那场质疑之后，复现论文比围观热搜更有意义。
en_title: A Stanford researcher and GPT-6 Astra wrote 83 pages, putting gravity on the light cone
en_text:
An 83-page paper pushes general relativity a big step closer to quantum. On November 25, Venkatesa Chandrasekaran of Stanford's Leinweber Institute for Theoretical Physics posted it on arXiv, titled An algebraic quantization of gravity from the null cone. In the acknowledgments he wrote that about 400 million tokens went into months of collaboration with GPT-6 Astra.

Chandrasekaran has another job, researcher on OpenAI's reasoning team. In October, about 30 physicists ran a benchmark, and GPT-6 Astra got 49 of 50 unpublished research-level theory questions right, mostly in black hole physics and holography. The paper claims four results, a finite closed expression for graviton pair amplitudes via nonperturbative summation, a finite-dimensional Hilbert space for a bounded causal diamond, the Bekenstein-Hawking entropy formula, and classical Einstein equations recovered in the low-energy limit.

The usual approach splits gravity into a flat background plus small ripples, then sums graviton collision loops. At high energy, pure general relativity spits out infinitely many unabsorbable ultraviolet divergences. Perturbative nonrenormalizability. The root is background dependence. Quantum field theory needs a fixed stage, but gravity is the geometry of the stage itself. This paper skips quantizing the full four-dimensional metric, solves the gravitational constraints classically instead, keeps only the independent degrees of freedom on the light cone, and quantizes those. The square of shear carries a minus sign and lowers beam expansion, so stronger radiation means a longer affine distance to reach the same cross-section. The author turns that into a gravitational clock, and capping the clock reading caps both area and the excitations that fit inside. That is where the finite-dimensional Hilbert space comes from.

The paper is still a preprint and has not been peer reviewed. At a Berkeley seminar, Chandrasekaran already faced dense pushback. The framework covers only four-dimensional vacuum gravity, with no matter fields, no electrons or quarks. The paper does not split the credit between the human and GPT-6 Astra, so nobody can tell which core derivations came from the model. Social platforms already call it a unified theory of everything, while string theorists say they still bet on strings.

Two things to watch. Whether anyone couples matter fields in, because without that step past pure gravity the framework stays a candidate. And whether an independent team can reproduce the amplitudes and entropy formula, which after the Berkeley questions matters more than the trending topic.

title: 唱衰MCP的声音被一组用量数据顶回去，每周240万条工单是智能体建的
note: A全新：查重库MCP相关为Gmail Drive接口、Workspace MCP上线，无Schmid用量翻盘事件。双信源为AIHOT原文索引及11月27日多家公众号转述，Schmid的X原帖为一手。常规稿，反常识点为44%来自非技术团队。
text:
MCP 被唱衰了大半年。11月26日，谷歌 DeepMind 开发者体验负责人 Philipp Schmid 发文，没用观点反驳，甩的是用量。Linear 和 Notion 上约一半的工单和页面现在是智能体建的，每周约240万条。Notion 报出的 MCP 流量增长是60倍。Atlassian 那边每个工作日超过500万次工具调用，其中44%来自软件团队之外。

这个44%是反常识的地方。MCP 一直被当成程序员的工具，真正把它跑起来的却是运营、客服、法务这些人，他们不会为了接一个 API 去读文档。CLI 再顺手，也得先会开终端。给市场部发一个带 MCP 连接器的聊天窗口，比教他们敲命令现实得多。

唱衰的理由也不是空穴来风。有测试显示，同一个任务走 MCP 比走命令行多烧42倍 token，病灶是上下文膨胀。Schmid 押的翻盘点是 Code Mode，不再往提示词里塞50个工具定义、每轮只调一个，而是给模型一个沙箱，把工具暴露成可调用函数，在内存里完成过滤和关联，只把结果送回上下文。OpenCode 2.0、Claude Code、Codex、Pi 和 Factory Droid 已经把它设为默认。

协议本身也在变。2026年7月28日的规范移除了有状态会话，加入官方扩展。Schmid 看好的四个方向是 Code Mode 加类型化输出、带版本管理的原生 Skills、常驻事件 Events 和 MCP Apps。Anthropic 本月披露，MCP SDK 的月下载量已经破了7亿。
en_title: MCP bears a wave of hype backlash, then 2.4 million agent-written items a week answer back
en_text:
MCP has been counted out for months. On November 26, Google DeepMind developer experience lead Philipp Schmid published a post that answered with usage, not opinion. About half the issues and pages at Linear and Notion are now created by agents, roughly 2.4 million a week. Notion reports 60x MCP traffic growth. Atlassian handles over 5 million MCP tool calls every working day, and 44% of those users sit outside software teams.

That 44% is the counterintuitive part. MCP was treated as a programmer's tool, yet the people actually running it are in operations, support and legal, who will not read API docs just to plug in a tool. CLI is handy only if you can open a terminal. Handing marketing a chat window with an MCP connector beats teaching them to type commands.

The backlash had a point. One test found the same task burns 42x more tokens through MCP than the command line, with context bloat as the root. Schmid bets on Code Mode, which stops stuffing 50 tool schemas into the prompt and one call per turn, and instead gives the model a sandbox where tools are callable functions, filtering and joining in memory and returning only the result. OpenCode 2.0, Claude Code, Codex, Pi and Factory Droid already make it the default.

The protocol changed too. The July 28, 2026 spec removed stateful sessions and added official extensions. Schmid's four directions are Code Mode with typed output, native Skills with versioning, persistent Events and MCP Apps. Anthropic disclosed this month that MCP SDK downloads passed 700 million a month.

title: 南京一家医院把仿真机器人摆在扶梯口，有人投诉吓人，第二天撤了
note: A全新：查重库无省人民医院仿真机器人、恐怖谷相关记录。热点榜cross=2真热点，524.2万热度。双信源为上游新闻一手采访及腾讯新闻20261127A002J000、网易转载。常规稿。
text:
江苏省人民医院广州路院区门诊二楼，一台仿真机器人正对着扶梯出入口。11月25日，有南京市民发帖，说被它吓飞了。机器人是女性面容，深色长发，穿白色医护工作服，头低垂着。截至26日15时，帖子1.5万赞，2700条评论。

低头不是设定，是关机状态。26日下午，一站式服务中心的工作人员对上游新闻说，机器人开机时会眨眼、说话，看上去还行。工程师还没调试好，所以一直关着。25日有人投诉恐怖，26日医院就把它撤了。

更像人反而更吓人，这事有个名字，叫恐怖谷效应。机器人外观越接近真人，细微的不自然越容易引发不适。这台机器踩中的点很具体，摆放位置正对扶梯，人从下面上来，一抬头看见一个人立在那儿，第一反应不是咨询台。

26日撤下之后，这个点位暂时空着。工程师还在调试。
en_title: A Nanjing hospital put a lifelike robot by the escalator, complaints came, and it was gone next day
en_text:
On the second floor of Jiangsu Provincial People's Hospital's Guangzhou Road campus, a lifelike robot stood facing the escalator. On November 25 a Nanjing resident posted that it scared them stiff. Female face, dark hair, white medical coat, head bowed. By 3 p.m. on the 26th the post had 15,000 likes and 2,700 comments.

The bowed head was not a setting, it was the off state. On the afternoon of the 26th, a staffer at the one-stop service center told Upper News the robot blinks and speaks when on, but looked fine. Engineers had not finished tuning it, so it stayed off. Someone complained on the 25th that it was creepy, and the hospital removed it on the 26th.

The more human it looks, the more it unsettles, a phenomenon called the uncanny valley. As a robot gets closer to a real person, small imperfections get amplified. This one hit a very specific nerve, placed right at the escalator, so people coming up meet a bowed human shape with no warning. You expect a person, then realize you don't, and that half-second is the problem.

After the removal on the 26th, the spot stood empty for now. Engineers are still tuning.

title: 1.5万赞和2700条评论，我第一次看到这组数愣了一下
note: 讲解角度：观众视角看逼真反而吓人的因果，第二人称真实反应，数字取自v1双信源，不同于事实稿现象叙述。挂医院仿真机器人那条。
text:

那台机器摆在江苏省人民医院门诊二楼，正对扶梯口。你从下面上来，抬头就看见一个低头站着的人形，穿白大褂，长发。它不是来吓你的，本来是做咨询的。

为什么越像人越吓人。恐怖谷说的就是这个，外观接近真人之后，一点不自然会被放大。这里的不自然特别具体，头低着，不动，不眨眼。院方说那是关机状态，开机能眨眼说话，可工程师还没调好，一直没开。摆放位置又正对扶梯，人是没有心理准备地撞上它的。你以为是个人，定睛一看不是，那一下的不对劲就来了。

我看这事不觉得是机器人做错了，是摆放的人没算过你从扶梯上来的那一眼。
link: 南京一家医院把仿真机器人摆在扶梯口，有人投诉吓人，第二天撤了
en_title: 15,000 likes and 2,700 comments, I froze a little at the numbers
en_text:
15,000 likes and 2,700 comments. I froze a little the first time I saw those numbers. It was one switched-off robot.

The machine stood on the second floor of Jiangsu Provincial People's Hospital, facing the escalator. You ride up and meet a bowed human shape in a white coat and long hair. It was not there to scare you. It was meant to answer questions.

Why does closer to human mean scarier? The uncanny valley says so, and here the imperfection is very concrete, a bowed head, no movement, no blink. The hospital says that is the off state, and it blinks and speaks when on, but engineers had not finished tuning it. You come up the escalator with no warning. You think it's a person, then it isn't, and that jolt is the whole thing.

I don't think the robot did anything wrong. The person who placed it never counted that first glance you take coming up the escalator.

11月20日，《万妖图录传》的番外《云州异客》进了影院，全国200余座城市同步放映。红果把2分钟一集的AI漫剧，拉成了109分钟的长片，票价30到35元。

这事真正要看的，跟一部短剧上不上银幕关系不大。红果在测一件从没测过的事。手机上免费看的东西，有没有人愿意掏钱进影院再看一遍。

《万妖图录传》2026年3月上线，改编自网络小说《那妖魔是姜大人！》，更新到第十四季，1200多集，全系列播放破了百亿。第八季热度破亿，第十四季上线次日热度1.32亿。这次它不走猫眼淘票票，只在中影电影通的预约放映专区买票，部分场次1人就能成团。

它没有龙标，挂的是微短剧的苔花标。猫眼想看超过2万。有机构测算，2026年国内AI漫剧市场规模有望突破400亿。

红果为什么非要往线下跑，得看它靠什么挣钱。AI漫剧在App里是免费的，红果的收入来自广告。用户刷得越多，广告看得越多，可广告库存就那么多，单用户能贡献的钱有顶。这个模式已经摸到天花板。

把线上的免费IP搬进影院卖票，是在试另一条收入曲线。影院工作人员说，部分场次上座率不输同期新片。但片子不计入传统票房，用的是一套全新结算方式。一头是广告收入见顶，一头是要给IP找新的变现口，两头一挤，就有了这次试水。招聘信息里还写着，团队在布局电视大屏OTT端。

代价也很直接。屏幕放大不等于质量升级。手机上能倍速快进的短剧，坐进影院看109分钟，节奏快、冲突密的那一套就变成了拖沓。配角工具人、内核是爽文套路，这些在竖屏里是优点，放到银幕上全成了短板。有人反馈预约成团失败、收到退款，粉丝评价两极。买票的人冲的是IP和一次粉丝聚会。

接下来看三件事。看限时观影派对会不会变成常态排片，看预约成团的成功率能有多高，看第二部跟进的漫剧还敢不敢定在30元以上。这三件事里有任何一件落地，这条路才算走通。
en_title: A 10-billion-view AI drama hits cinemas, stretching 2-minute episodes into 109 minutes
en_text:
On November 20, the spin-off Yunzhou Yike of Wan Yao Tu Lu Ji landed in cinemas, with screenings in more than 200 cities across China. Hongguo stretched the 2-minute-per-episode AI drama into a 109-minute feature. Tickets run 30 to 35 yuan.

What matters here has little to do with a short drama landing on the big screen. Hongguo is testing something it has never tested before. Will anyone pay to see, in a theater, something they can watch free on their phone?

Wan Yao Tu Lu Ji launched in March 2026, adapted from the web novel Na Yao Mo Shi Jiang Daren, and has run to 14 seasons and more than 1,200 episodes, with total views past 10 billion. Season 8 drew over 100 million in heat, and Season 14 hit 132 million the day after it dropped. This time it skips Maoyan and Taopiaopiao; tickets are only sold through the China Film app reserved-screening section, and some showings need just one person to form a group.

It has no dragon seal. It carries the micro-drama Taihua mark instead. Over 20,000 people marked it as want to see on Maoyan. One research firm estimates China's AI drama market could top 40 billion yuan in 2026.

To see why Hongguo is pushing offline, look at how it makes money. The AI dramas are free in the app, and the revenue comes from ads. The more people watch, the more ads they see, but ad inventory is fixed, so there is a ceiling on what one user can bring in. That model has hit its ceiling.

Moving a free online IP into theaters and charging for tickets is a second revenue curve. Cinema staff say some showings drew crowds no worse than new releases in the same slot. But the film is not counted in traditional box office, and it uses a whole new settlement system. Ad revenue topping out on one side, the IP needing a new way to cash in on the other, and you get this experiment. Job postings also say the team is building out TV OTT.

The cost is obvious too. A bigger screen does not mean better quality. A short drama you can speed through on your phone turns sluggish when you sit through 109 minutes of it in a theater. Supporting characters as props, a plot built on wish fulfillment, things that work in vertical format become weak points on the big screen. Some people reported failed group bookings and refunds, and fan reactions are split. What people are buying is the IP and a fan meetup.

Three things to watch next. Whether the limited fan screenings become regular scheduling, how high the group-booking success rate can go, and whether the second AI drama to follow dares to price itself above 30 yuan. If any one of those lands, the path works.

title: 路透社说智谱GLM-5.5被算力和反蒸馏卡住，智谱说全是假的
note: 全新。路透社11月26日报道并附智谱否认，双信源。
text:
11月26日，路透社援引知情人士说，智谱原计划本月发布的GLM-5.5可能推迟。这款模型约3万亿参数，是它的下一代旗舰。报道给的理由有两个，OpenAI和Anthropic的反蒸馏措施，还有美国新的算力限制。原定年底前完成的训练和发布，可能推到2027年一季度及以后。

智谱的一名员工在朋友圈回了六个字，相关爆料全部为假消息。

两边说法对不上，但路透社点出的那条技术路径值得看。反蒸馏跟卖不卖芯片没关系，它是把门从另一头关上。大模型公司发现，利用API大量调用别人模型、把输出拿来训练自己模型这条路走得通，就加了限制。智谱这类靠蒸馏加速追赶的团队，训练数据的一端被掐住了。

外界习惯把中国模型的麻烦归结为买不到GPU。这件事反过来的地方在于，卡脖子的那一环变成了API权限。芯片还能找渠道，调用权限一旦被限制，绕开的成本高得多。

真假先放一边。3万亿参数这个量级的模型，训练窗口本来就以季度算。下面看两件事，智谱会不会在年底前拿出实测结果，以及下一版模型的参数规模还敢不敢往上堆。
en_title: Reuters says Zhipu GLM-5.5 is stuck on anti-distillation and compute limits; Zhipu calls it all fake
en_text:
On November 26, Reuters cited sources saying Zhipu's GLM-5.5, originally planned for release this month, may be delayed. The model has roughly 3 trillion parameters and is the company's next flagship. Reuters gave two reasons: anti-distillation measures from OpenAI and Anthropic, and new US compute restrictions. Training and release, once targeted for year-end, could slip to Q1 2027 or later.

A Zhipu employee replied in a WeChat post with six words: the whole report is fake news.

The two accounts do not match, but the technical path Reuters points to is worth a look. Anti-distillation has nothing to do with selling you chips; it closes the door from the other side. Model companies found that calling someone else's model through an API at scale and training your own on the outputs worked, so they added limits. For teams like Zhipu that use distillation to catch up, one end of the training data gets cut off.

People usually blame Chinese models' trouble on not being able to buy GPUs. What is flipped here is that the choke point has become API access. You can still find channels for chips, but once calling rights are restricted, working around them costs far more.

Set the true-or-fake question aside. A model at 3 trillion parameters takes quarters to train. Watch two things: whether Zhipu produces benchmark results before year-end, and whether the next version dares to push the parameter count higher.

title: 手机上免费刷的东西，凭什么要花30多块进影院看？
note: 讲解角度：普通人视角，从手机免费内容凭什么卖票切入，讲广告模式见顶到IP变现的因果。挂在「百亿播放的AI漫剧进影院，2分钟短剧拉成109分钟，红果在试一条新路」下。
text:
手机上免费刷的东西，凭什么要花30多块进影院看？

先补一个数。《万妖图录传》全系列1200多集，播放破了百亿，不是小打小闹，是红果平台上实打实的爆款。

红果靠什么挣钱，你可能没想过。它在App里把漫剧免费放给你看，收入来自贴片广告。你刷得越久，广告看得越多，钱就从广告主那头来。可这条路有顶，广告位就那么多，一个人一天能看的数量有限。

所以这次把IP搬进影院，卖的是另一笔账。109分钟的长片，票价30到35元，部分场次1人成团，还不进猫眼淘票票，只在中影电影通的预约专区买。我看下来，这跟把短剧变成电影没关系，是想试试粉丝肯不肯为手机上不花钱的内容单独掏一次钱。

我自己拿不准的是那个上座率。影院说部分场次不输同期新片，可这些场次靠预约成团撑着，有的还退了款。你真买了票坐两小时，看到的是竖屏短剧拉长的节奏，会不会觉得亏，这个我真押不出来。

我看这条路能不能走，不看第一部，看第二部还敢不敢定在30元以上。
link: 百亿播放的AI漫剧进影院，2分钟短剧拉成109分钟，红果在试一条新路
en_title: Why pay 30-plus yuan to see something you can watch free on your phone?
en_text:
Why would you pay 30-plus yuan to watch, in a theater, something you can scroll through free on your phone?

Here is one number first. Wan Yao Tu Lu Ji runs to more than 1,200 episodes across all seasons, with views past 10 billion. This is not small beer; it is a real hit on Hongguo's platform.

You may never have thought about how Hongguo makes money. It puts the AI dramas in the app for free, and the revenue comes from ads. The longer you watch, the more ads you see, and the money comes from advertisers. But there is a ceiling: ad slots are limited, and there is only so much one person can watch in a day.

So moving the IP into cinemas is a different ledger. A 109-minute feature, tickets at 30 to 35 yuan, some showings needing just one person to form a group, and no Maoyan or Taopiaopiao, only the China Film app reserved-screening section. From where I sit, this has nothing to do with turning short dramas into movies. It is testing whether fans will pay separately for content they get free on their phones.

What I am not sure about is that attendance figure. Cinemas say some showings were no worse than new releases, but those showings lean on group bookings and some got refunds. If you actually bought a ticket and sat through two hours of a vertical drama stretched out, would you feel shortchanged? I really cannot call it.

Whether this path works, I would look not at the first film but at whether the second one dares to price above 30 yuan.

title: 一个模型的发布，怎么就被几行API条款给拦住了？
note: 讲解角度：机制视角，从反蒸馏切入，讲卡点从硬件挪到API权限。挂在「路透社说智谱GLM-5.5被算力和反蒸馏卡住，智谱说全是假的」下。
text:
一个模型的发布，怎么就被几行API条款给拦住了？

11月26日路透社说，智谱那个约3万亿参数的GLM-5.5可能推到2027年一季度。理由里有个词你可能不熟，反蒸馏。智谱的员工当天就回了句，全是假的。

先说反蒸馏是什么。你调用一个大模型，把它的回答攒起来训练自己的模型，这条路以前走得通。OpenAI和Anthropic发现之后，开始在API上设限，不让你这么批量薅。这跟卖不卖芯片没关系，是把调用权限这一头关上了。

钱和算力的流向就跟着变了。外界一直盯着GPU，觉得卡住中国模型的是买不到卡。可如果训练数据的一端被掐掉，你手里就算有再多卡，也少了能喂进去的东西。蒸馏本来是追赶者省时间的办法，现在这条路窄了。

我看不准智谱到底推没推。3万亿参数的模型，训练本来就按季度算，年底和明年一季度，差得没那么绝对。但被卡的地方从硬件挪到了权限，这一点比推迟几个月更值得你留意。你如果也在用API做东西，就该想想自己的数据源稳不稳。

我押不出它到底几月发，但我更信接下来卡中国模型的会越来越多是这种看不见的门。
link: 路透社说智谱GLM-5.5被算力和反蒸馏卡住，智谱说全是假的
en_title: How did a model launch get blocked by a few lines of API terms?
en_text:
How did a model's release get stopped by a few lines of API terms?

On November 26, Reuters said Zhipu's GLM-5.5, around 3 trillion parameters, might slip to Q1 2027. There is a term in the report you may not know: anti-distillation. A Zhipu employee replied the same day: all fake.

Let me explain anti-distillation. You call a big model, collect its answers, and train your own model on them; that used to work. Once OpenAI and Anthropic caught on, they put limits on the API so you cannot bulk-scrape like that. This has nothing to do with selling chips; it closes off the calling rights end.

That changes where the money and compute flow. Everyone keeps staring at GPUs, assuming Chinese models are stuck because they cannot buy cards. But if one end of the training data gets cut, all the cards in your hands still leave you with less to feed them. Distillation was the shortcut catch-up players used to save time, and now that road is narrower.

I cannot tell whether Zhipu delayed it or not. A 3-trillion-parameter model takes quarters to train, and year-end versus Q1 next year is not a huge gap. But the choke point moving from hardware to permissions is the part I would watch more closely than a few months of delay. If you are building on APIs too, you should think about whether your own data source is stable.

I cannot call which month it ships, but I lean toward believing that what blocks Chinese models from here on will more often be doors you cannot see.

title: 袁记食品今起招股，4773家店里99.52%是加盟
note: 全新事件，11月27日招股公告，多信源；深度稿按五块结构写透加盟杠杆机制。
text:
中国最大的饺子店要上市了。11月27日早间，袁记食品在港交所公告启动全球发售，拟发行1631.23万股H股，最高发售价每股28.00港元，预计12月7日在主板挂牌。

募资上限4.567亿港元。引入Brightness Ocean和全顺香港等基石投资者，认购下限238.60万股。新京报的口径里还多了启承资本和顺德国资，累计认购852万美元。

公司代码3364，招股期11月27日到12月2日，每手100股，入场费约2828.24港元。

财务摆出来是这样。2023年到2025年营收20.26亿、25.61亿、27.95亿，经调整净利润1.79亿、1.80亿、2.62亿。2026年前五个月营收13.06亿，同比增长39.8%，经调整净利润1.85亿，同比增长164%。

真正撑起这门生意的是加盟。截至2026年5月31日，4750家加盟店，23家直营店，加盟占比99.52%。2304名加盟商里，751人开了两家以上。

公司靠六大工厂、24个仓库、10个前置仓供货，82%以上的门店在仓库200公里内，核心原料两天一配送到近70%的门店。钱从加盟商来，公司赚的是供应链和品牌。

招股书里52%的募资要拿去海外供应链和门店网络，计划2027年底前在新加坡、马来西亚、泰国新开超过100家门店。海外单店模型已经跑出差异，2026年前五个月海外客单价66.34元，国内单均GMV22.7元，前者接近后者三倍。

加盟占比高也意味着增长靠开店堆。门店数从2023年的1990家涨到4773家，2026年计划还在往外铺。一旦单店客流下滑，加盟商先扛不住。

工厂给第三方供馅料面皮的收入2025年才2429万元，供应链从成本中心变利润中心还早。

12月2日招股结束，看基石认购和最终定价落在23到28港元区间的哪一端。12月7日首日表现，比营收数字更能说明市场认不认这套加盟杠杆。
en_title: Yuen Kee Food opens its share offer, with 99.52% of 4,773 stores run by franchisees
en_text:
China's biggest dumpling chain is going public. On the morning of November 27, Yuen Kee Food filed with HKEX to launch a global offering of 16,312,300 H shares at a maximum price of HK$28.00 per share, with trading expected to start on the Main Board on December 7.

The raise tops out at HK$456.7 million. Cornerstone investors include Brightness Ocean and Chun Shun (Hong Kong) Development, subscribing for a minimum of about 2,386,000 shares. Beijing News also lists Qicheng Capital and Shunde state assets, together putting in US$8.52 million.

Stock code 3364. The offer runs from November 27 to December 2, in board lots of 100, with an entry fee of about HK$2,828.24.

The financials look like this. Revenue ran 2.026 billion, 2.561 billion and 2.795 billion yuan from 2023 to 2025, with adjusted net profit of 179 million, 180 million and 262 million yuan. The first five months of 2026 brought 1.306 billion yuan in revenue, up 39.8%, and adjusted net profit of 185 million yuan, up 164%.

What really carries this business is franchising. As of May 31, 2026, there were 4,750 franchised stores and 23 directly operated ones, franchises making up 99.52%. Of 2,304 franchisees, 751 ran two or more stores.

The company supplies through six factories, 24 warehouses and 10 forward depots, with over 82% of stores within 200 km of a warehouse and core ingredients delivered to nearly 70% of stores every two days. The cash comes from franchisees; the company earns from supply chain and brand.

About 52% of the proceeds is earmarked for overseas supply chain and store network, with plans to open more than 100 new stores in Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand by the end of 2027. The overseas model already looks different: in the first five months of 2026, average overseas spend per customer was 66.34 yuan against 22.7 yuan per order domestically, nearly three times as much.

A high franchise share also means growth comes from piling on new stores. The count went from 1,990 in 2023 to 4,773, and the 2026 plan keeps pushing outward. If foot traffic per store slips, the franchisees feel it first.

Revenue from selling factory-made fillings and dough to third parties was just 24.29 million yuan in 2025. Turning the supply chain from a cost center into a profit center is still early days.

Watch how cornerstone subscription and final pricing land in the HK$23 to HK$28 range when the offer closes on December 2. The first-day showing on December 7 will say more about whether the market buys this franchise leverage than any revenue figure.

title: 创业板半日涨3.79%，这次上涨的名单和上次不一样
note: 全新事件，11月27日A股午盘，央广网财联社中新经纬多信源；反常识点为红利股下跌。
text:
11月27日午间，创业板指涨3.79%，科创50涨4.43%，沪指只涨0.28%。全市场超4600只个股上涨，96只涨停，半日成交9205亿元，比上个交易日同期放量1242亿元。

涨的是半导体设备、先进封装、华为产业链。灿芯股份、京仪装备、华海诚科20%涨停，润和软件、拓维信息封板。中国神华、中国石化、中国移动、美的集团这些红利股在跌。

有个地方和上次不一样。11月19日那次也是科技板块动，账户多数是绿的。这次涨的名单换了，钱从高股息那头搬到科技这头。

推动搬家的有两件事。英伟达要求代工厂停发东南亚四国服务器，国产算力成了替代选项。工信部等三部门印发新一代通信网建设方案，广东算力十五五规划提出算力中心优先用国产芯片。

指数涨0.28%不代表普涨。看账户得看你手里是红利还是算力。
en_title: ChiNext up 3.79% at midday, but this time the winners list changed
en_text:
At the midday close on November 27, the ChiNext index was up 3.79%, the STAR 50 up 4.43%, while the Shanghai Composite managed only 0.28%. More than 4,600 stocks rose and 96 hit the daily limit. Half-day turnover reached 920.5 billion yuan, up 124.2 billion yuan from the same point in the previous session.

The gainers were semiconductor equipment, advanced packaging and Huawei supply-chain names. CanSemi, Jingyi Equipment and Huahai Chengke jumped 20%, while Runhe Software and Talkweb locked their limits. Dividend heavyweights like China Shenhua, Sinopec, China Mobile and Midea were down.

One thing feels different from last time. On November 19, tech also moved, but most accounts stayed green. This time the list of winners changed, and money shifted out of high-dividend stocks into tech.

Two things pushed that shift. Nvidia told contractors to stop shipping servers to four Southeast Asian countries, making domestic computing power a substitute. The MIIT and two other ministries issued a next-generation telecom network plan, and Guangdong's computing power plan for the 15th Five-Year Period said data centers should use domestic chips first.

An index up 0.28% is not a broad rally. What your account does depends on whether you are holding dividend stocks or computing power.

title: 乡镇外卖悄悄成网，小镇外卖已经铺了4000多个乡镇
note: 全新事件，时代财经11月27日报道，多信源；机制为一镇一站与配送费结构。
text:
巨头不送的乡镇，一群本地平台正在把网铺起来。11月27日的榜单上，外卖界拼多多这个说法挂了两个榜。主角不是美团，是星火外卖和小镇外卖。

星火外卖2021年在广东汕尾陆丰试点，现在汕尾有9个站点。小镇外卖2019年在郑州创办，截至2025年底合作乡镇超过4000个。全国乡级行政区划有38723个，覆盖率约10.33%。

这套打法和城市反过来。乡镇居住分散，一单配送超过3公里很常见，偏远村落能到20公里。小镇外卖搞一镇一站，本地代理商既当老板又当骑手，日单量超过50单才招人。

配送费全额给骑手。乡镇单程远，标准定得比城市高。结果是乡镇客单价反而比城市高。镇上到村里5公里、10公里，村民觉得同样的配送费不如多买点。

小镇外卖2025年快递代取订单超过100万件，餐饮占比超过80%。巨头往下沉，这些平台先一步在村口生了根。
en_title: The Pinduoduo of food delivery is quietly going rural, with 4,000-plus townships covered
en_text:
In the townships the giants do not deliver to, a batch of local platforms is quietly weaving a network. On November 27, the phrase the Pinduoduo of food delivery showed up on two trending lists. The main players are not Meituan, but Spark Delivery and Small Town Delivery.

Spark Delivery started a pilot in Lufeng, Shanwei, Guangdong in 2021 and now has 9 stations in Shanwei. Small Town Delivery was founded in Zhengzhou in 2019 and had partnered with over 4,000 townships by the end of 2025. There are 38,723 township-level divisions nationwide, so coverage is about 10.33%.

The playbook runs opposite to the cities. Homes are spread out, a single delivery over 3 km is common, and remote villages can be 20 km away. Small Town Delivery uses one station per township, with a local agent who is both boss and rider, hiring riders only when daily orders pass 50.

Delivery fees go entirely to riders. Rural runs are longer, so the standard is set higher than in cities. Average order value in townships ends up above city levels. From town to village is 5 km or 10 km, and villagers figure they may as well buy more for the same delivery fee.

Small Town Delivery handled over 1 million parcel pickups in 2025, with restaurant orders making up more than 80%. As the giants push downward, these platforms have already put down roots at the village gate.

title: 人民日报评随地大小直播，洗浴中心镜头对着顾客被点名
note: 全新事件，人民日报客户端评论，多信源；快讯。
text:
人民日报客户端发文评论随地大小直播。事情起于一家洗浴中心，直播间镜头对着休息区楼梯通道，顾客经过时面部进入画面。

有网友在直播间追问是否知情同意，被主播踢出并拉黑。门店后来张贴提示、设置物障、换了机位。

评论说得很直。公共场所可以直播，不等于可以随便拍人。民法典写明，未经肖像权人同意不得制作、使用、公开其肖像。

2024年10月南京建邺区法院判过同类案子，顾客就餐被商家直播，商家公开道歉并赔500元。近七成受访者拒绝在公共空间被随意拍摄。
en_title: People's Daily weighs in as a bathhouse livestream points its camera at customers
en_text:
The People's Daily app published a commentary on so-called livestreaming anywhere and everywhere. It started at a bathhouse, where a livestream camera pointed at the staircase in the rest area and caught customers' faces as they walked by.

When a viewer asked in the chat whether those customers had consented, the streamer kicked them out and blocked them. The store later posted notices, set up barriers and moved the camera.

The commentary did not mince words. A public place being livestreamable does not mean people there can be filmed at will. The Civil Code says no one may make, use or publish a person's portrait without consent.

In October 2024, the Jianye District court in Nanjing ruled on a similar case: a diner filmed by a restaurant's livestream, and the merchant had to apologize publicly and pay 500 yuan. Nearly 70% of respondents refuse to be casually filmed in public spaces.

title: 4773家饺子店，你啃的那口下去谁赚了钱
note: 讲解角度：加盟模式，从加盟商出钱与公司赚供货费的关系切入。挂袁记食品招股条。
text:
你有没有想过，楼下那家现包饺子店，可能压根不是老板自己的。

袁记食品11月27日开始招股，12月7日挂牌。全国4773家店，直营的只有23家。

我翻了一遍招股书，99.52%是加盟。这4773家店，大部分是加盟商自己掏钱开的。公司赚的不是卖饺子的钱，是向加盟商供货的钱。

六大工厂、24个仓库、10个前置仓，82%的门店离仓库200公里内，核心原料两天一配。你想想，加盟商付租金、付人工、付设备，公司卖馅料和面皮。门店越开越多，公司报表越好看，风险却大多压在加盟商那头。

海外更夸张，客单价66.34元，国内单均GMV22.7元，差了三倍。我不敢说这门生意不好，供应链确实是真本事。但我押不出来，一旦单店客流往下走，先扛不住的是那2304名加盟商，上市公司还能拿招股书接着讲。
link: 袁记食品今起招股，4773家店里99.52%是加盟
en_title: 4,773 dumpling shops, so who actually makes money on the ones you eat at
en_text:
Ever wonder about that fresh dumpling shop downstairs? Chances are it isn't owned by the person running it.

Yuen Kee Food started its share offer on November 27 and lists on December 7. Of 4,773 stores nationwide, only 23 are company-run.

I went through the prospectus. 99.52% are franchises. Most of those 4,773 shops were paid for by the franchisees themselves. The company does not earn from selling dumplings; it earns from supplying the franchisees.

Six factories, 24 warehouses and 10 forward depots, with 82% of stores within 200 km of a warehouse and core ingredients delivered every two days. Think about it: franchisees pay rent, wages and equipment, while the company sells filling and dough. More stores mean a better-looking report, but most of the risk sits with the franchisees.

Overseas is even wider: average spend per customer is 66.34 yuan against 22.7 yuan per order at home, about three times. I won't say this is a bad business; the supply chain is real skill. But I can't call it either, and if traffic per store drops, the first to buckle will be those 2,304 franchisees, while the listed company still has a prospectus to talk about.

title: 创业板涨了3.79%，你账户却没跟上，问题出在哪
note: 讲解角度：资金换仓，从红利股下跌与算力股上涨的对照切入。挂A股奇迹日条。
text:

11月27日午间，科创50涨4.43%，超4600只个股上涨，96只涨停。

原因不小，英伟达停发东南亚服务器，国产算力成了替代，广东又出了算力十五五规划，说算力中心优先用国产芯片。两件事撞一块，资金就换了方向。指数只涨0.28%，那是红利股拖住的。

我看下来，今天这波就是换仓，不是普涨。你手里的票没跟上，多半是站在了被抽走的那一头。
link: 创业板半日涨3.79%，这次上涨的名单和上次不一样
en_title: ChiNext rose 3.79% but your account lagged, so what happened
en_text:
The ChiNext index rose 3.79% today. Did someone in your feed post their gains yet?

At the midday close on November 27, the STAR 50 was up 4.43%, with over 4,600 stocks higher and 96 at the daily limit.

I went through the movers. Everything up was semiconductors, advanced packaging and Huawei supply-chain names; everything down was dividend stocks like China Shenhua, China Mobile and Midea. You used to hold high-dividend names because they felt safe. Today that money was pulled straight out and poured into computing power.

Two reasons. Nvidia stopped shipping servers to Southeast Asia, so domestic computing became the substitute, and Guangdong rolled out its computing power plan for the 15th Five-Year Period, saying data centers should use domestic chips first. The two landed together and the money changed direction. The index only rose 0.28% because dividend stocks dragged on it.

Today was a rotation, not a broad rally. If your stocks did not keep up, chances are you were standing on the side the money walked away from.

en_title: The day People's Daily spoke out, livestreaming anywhere blew up instead
en_text:
The day after People's Daily criticized livestreaming in public spaces, the topic climbed two trending lists instead of fading.

The facts are simple. A bathhouse stream pointed at the staircase in the rest area and caught customers' faces; when a viewer asked about consent, they were kicked out and blocked. The store posted notices and moved the camera. The commentary's point was blunt: being in a public place does not mean people can be filmed at will.

Nearly 70% of respondents refuse casual filming in public, and in October 2024 the Jianye District court in Nanjing ordered a merchant to apologize and pay 500 yuan for livestreaming a diner. The commentary was not aiming at this one store, but at the platform's long complaint process.

More cameras go up, while the line around them stays undrawn.

title: 袁记食品招股书里几个扎眼的数字
note: 照抄X20。用招股书真实数字替换原文，段落数8段保持一致。
text:
袁记食品招股书里几个扎眼的数字：

1、摊子大：截至2026年5月31日，全球4773家门店，覆盖33个省级行政区、超过250个城市，其中41家在海外。

2、加盟狠：4750家是加盟店，23家直营，加盟占比99.52%。2304名加盟商里，751人开了两家以上。

3、长得快：门店数从2023年的1990家涨到4773家，三年多翻了一倍多。营收从20.26亿涨到27.95亿。

4、利润薄：2025年营收27.95亿，经调整净利润2.62亿。2026年前五个月营收13.06亿，同比增长39.8%，经调整净利润1.85亿，同比增长164%。

5、定价狠：最高发售价每股28.00港元，下限预计23.00港元，拟募资最多4.567亿港元，每手100股，入场费约2828.24港元，12月7日挂牌。

6、海外贵：2026年前五个月海外客单价66.34元，国内单均GMV22.7元，前者接近后者三倍；新加坡超过50家，是当地门店数第一的连锁中餐品牌。

门店是真多，加盟也是真彻底，不过我觉得供应链那张网才是它最值钱的东西。
en_title: A few striking numbers from Yuen Kee Food's prospectus
en_text:
A few striking numbers from Yuen Kee Food's prospectus:

1. Big footprint: as of May 31, 2026, there are 4,773 stores worldwide across 33 provincial-level regions and over 250 cities, 41 of them overseas.

2. Heavy franchising: 4,750 are franchised and 23 company-run, franchises making up 99.52%. Of 2,304 franchisees, 751 run two or more stores.

3. Fast growth: store count went from 1,990 in 2023 to 4,773, more than doubling in a little over three years. Revenue rose from 2.026 billion to 2.795 billion yuan.

4. Thin profit: 2025 revenue was 2.795 billion yuan with adjusted net profit of 262 million yuan. The first five months of 2026 brought 1.306 billion yuan in revenue, up 39.8%, and adjusted net profit of 185 million yuan, up 164%.

5. Tight pricing: maximum HK$28.00 per share, expected floor HK$23.00, raising up to HK$456.7 million, board lots of 100 with an entry fee of about HK$2,828.24, listing on December 7.

6. Pricey overseas: in the first five months of 2026, overseas spend per customer was 66.34 yuan against 22.7 yuan per order at home, close to three times; Singapore has over 50 stores, the largest Chinese chain there by store count.

The store count is real and so is the franchising, but I think that supply-chain web is the most valuable thing it owns.

title: 2027款极氪7X广州车展上市，限时价21.68万起
note: A全新，查重库无极氪7X记录；11月27日广州车展上市，极目新闻与腾讯新闻太平洋汽车双信源

零售价22.98万、23.98万、26.98万，限时价压到21.68万起。这个价是权益叠出来的，零售价一分没动。5000元定金抵尾款，再加一万三的现金直减。
