en_title: 2027 Zeekr 7X goes on sale at Guangzhou Auto Show, from 21.68万 limited-time
en_text:
November 27, Guangzhou Auto Show. The 2027 Zeekr 7X went on sale, three trims.

Sticker prices are 22.98万, 23.98万 and 26.98万, with a limited-time price starting at 21.68万. That number comes from stacked perks, not from cutting the sticker price. A 5,000 yuan deposit knocks down the final payment, plus a 13,000 yuan cash rebate.

The hardware upgrades are real. A 900V architecture across the range, a new 85kWh Shen Shield gold-brick battery, 5.5C charging, 10% to 80% in as little as 10.5 minutes. The AWD version puts out 585 kW and does 0 to 100 in 2.98 seconds. A 905-liter trunk, 31 sensors, a Nvidia Thor-U chip at 700 TOPS, and the debut of Qianli Haohan G-ASD 4.1.

The 2026 Zeekr 7X also started at 22.98万. A year later, more kit, same starting price. When prices are this squeezed, holding the line by adding parts costs more than just cutting the price.

Only buyers who pay the deposit between November 27 and December 31 get that limited-time price.

title: 红果的 AI 演员批量当偶像，22.19万部剧里只有1055部破亿
note: A全新，查重库无AI演员偶像化事件；搜狐娱乐、腾讯新闻、新浪娱乐多信源，内容平台类加权
text:
红果上的 AI 角色开始有自己的名字、账号和粉丝页了。它们被当成偶像养。

2026年上半年，全国 AI 新剧22.19万部，播放量破亿的只有1055部，占0.47%。赵丽颖以肖像权纠纷起诉红果运营方，11月10日开庭，还没宣判。红果自己发过治理公告，截至10月累计拦截、下架、修复疑似侵权作品43992部，99%是平台前置拦下来的。

这事这么走是有原因的。AI 短剧生产成本低、更新快，真人演员要档期要片酬，角色还常常一部剧用完就扔。给虚拟角色立人设、跨剧出演，能把一套建模的钱摊到很多部剧上。角色红了再开抖音账号拍vlog、开发布会、接商演，一个一次性的角色就变成了能反复收钱的IP。方桃子给美瞳代言那句戴了一天很舒服，被判虚假广告，制作方罚了6.8万元。

代价也很直接。AI 生成的脸容易撞上真人，表情到夸张处会露怯，眼睛变成镭射光。那批没破亿的剧，才是这个模式真正的底。

接下来看赵丽颖案宣判后，平台前置拦截的比例会不会从99%再往上走。
en_title: AI actors on Hongguo are being raised like idols as 22.19万 dramas produce just 1055 hits
en_text:
AI characters on Hongguo now have their own names, accounts and fan pages. They are being raised like idols.

In the first half of 2026, the country produced 22.19万 AI short dramas, and only 1055 cleared 100 million views, or 0.47%. Zhao Liying sued Hongguo's operator over portrait rights; the case opened November 10 and has not been ruled on. Hongguo published its own governance notice, saying it had blocked, removed or fixed 43992 suspected infringing works by October, 99% of them caught before publication.

There is a reason this took off. AI short dramas are cheap and fast, while human actors need schedules and pay, and often get used up in a single show. Giving a virtual character a persona and recurring roles spreads the cost of one model across many dramas. Once the character is popular, it opens a Douyin account, posts vlogs, holds launch events and takes brand deals, turning a one-off role into an asset that keeps paying. When the AI character Fang Taozi said a pair of contact lenses felt comfortable all day, regulators called it a false ad and fined the production company 6.8万元.

The cost shows up elsewhere. Generated faces drift toward real people, and expressions break down when pushed too far, eyes flashing like lasers. The dramas that never cleared 100 million views are the real floor of this model.

Watch whether Hongguo pushes that 99% pre-screening share higher after the Zhao Liying ruling.

title: 王兴兴说5到10年内中国机器人产量超汽车，年产量看2000万台
note: A全新，与11月20日v1第243条量产瓶颈发言为不同场合不同事件；11月26日WISE2026，第一财经与中央社双信源
text:
11月26日，北京的WISE2026大会上，王兴兴给了一个数。5到10年内，中国机器人产量有望超过汽车，年产量超2000万台。

他给的理由是体积。机器人比汽车小，技术跑通后，生产难度和工程量比汽车稍微少一点，同一个工厂能塞下更多机器人。参照系是2025年中国汽车产量，3453.1万辆。今年上半年人形机器人整机产量超4万台，全年有望破10万台。从万台到千万台，中间差的不是一个数量级。

反常识的地方在另一头。第一财经11月25日报道，2025年迄今已有29家机器人公司倒闭，几家还卷进劳资纠纷。这批公司多在2017年前后和2021年前后成立，赶的是上一轮资金涌入。宇树自己今年8月才在科创板上市，中签率0.0181%，上市首日开盘涨了629.44%。

一边是2000万台的预测，一边是29家公司出局。王兴兴自己也没把话说满，他说精细操作还有最后几毫米的问题，有望在一到三年内解决。

下一轮看的是全年人形机器人产量能不能真的站上10万台。
en_title: Wang Xingxing says China's robot output could pass cars within 5 to 10 years, at over 20 million a year
en_text:
November 26, at WISE2026 in Beijing, Wang Xingxing put a number on it. Within 5 to 10 years, China's robot output could surpass its car output, at more than 20 million units a year.

His reason is size. Robots are smaller than cars, and once the technology works, the production difficulty and engineering work are a bit less, so one factory can hold more robots. The reference point is China's 2025 car output, 3453.1万辆. In the first half of this year, humanoid robot output topped 4万台, with the full year expected to break 10万台. From tens of thousands to tens of millions is not one order of magnitude.

The counterintuitive part is elsewhere. Yicai reported November 25 that 29 robot companies have folded since 2025, several caught in labor disputes. Most were founded around 2017 or 2021, riding the previous wave of funding. Unitree itself only listed on the STAR Market in August, with a 0.0181% allotment rate and a 629.44% opening gain on day one.

One side predicts 20 million units, the other has 29 companies washing out. Wang did not overstate it either: fine manipulation still has its last few millimeters, which he expects to solve within one to three years.

The next signal is whether full-year humanoid output actually clears 10万台.

title: 小鹏图灵 AI 智驾2027年二季度收费，老车主权益终身不变
note: A全新，查重库无小鹏智驾订阅事件；11月25日科技日，财联社与每日经济新闻双信源
text:
11月25日的小鹏科技日上，何小鹏给智驾定了一个收费时间。2027年第二季度，图灵 AI 智驾面向全球新购车用户推出付费订阅。

服务上线前下订的用户，智驾权益终身不变，已享有的免费功能继续用。价格方案明年才公布。

何小鹏给的理由是研发。小鹏现在一年投在AI上的钱，相当于不少上市公司一到两年的研发费用。三季度研发开支28.5亿元，同比增长17.5%，占总营收11.7%。靠整车硬件卖出去的钱，反哺全生命周期的软件迭代，这个循环越来越吃力。

已经有人先把账算给用户看了。特斯拉在美国的FSD订阅是99美元一个月，中国市场买断价6.4万元。蔚来NOP+是380元一个月，华为乾崑ADS Max连续包月499元。蔚来董事长李斌当天在台下接了一句，买小鹏就趁早。

真正的反常识在这里。免费智驾变成月租，先买车的人反倒成了占便宜的那批。订阅要成立，最终看的是用户愿不愿意每月掏钱，以及事故率降没降。
en_title: Xpeng to charge for Turing AI driving from Q2 2027, existing owners keep rights for life
en_text:
November 25, Xpeng Tech Day. He Xiaopeng put a date on paid driving. From Q2 2027, Turing AI driving will be sold as a subscription to new car buyers worldwide.

Anyone who orders before the service launches keeps their driving rights for life, and the free features they already have stay free. Pricing comes next year.

His reason is research spend. What Xpeng puts into AI in one year equals one to two years of R&D at plenty of listed companies. Third-quarter R&D was 28.5亿元, up 17.5% year on year, or 11.7% of revenue. Funding a lifetime of software updates out of hardware sales alone is getting harder.

Someone else did the math for buyers. Tesla's FSD in the US is 99美元 a month; in China the buyout is 6.4万元. Nio's NOP+ is 380元 a month, and Huawei's Qiankun ADS Max is 499元 for monthly billing. Nio chairman Li Bin said from the floor that day: buy a Xpeng early.

Here is the twist. When free driving becomes a monthly fee, the people who bought first are the ones who got the deal. Whether the subscription holds up comes down to two things: will users pay each month, and did the accident rate fall.

title: 你追的那个偶像，可能压根没出生过
note: 讲解角度：从你追的偶像可能是一张不存在的脸切入，第二人称聊天口吻，数字取自v1双信源；挂在红果AI演员条下
text:
你有没有想过，你追的那个偶像可能压根没出生过。

红果上的 AI 角色现在有自己的粉丝页，陈昊宇这个虚拟人立了目标要演100部剧，还开了抖音账号发片场vlog。

为什么突然要把一个角色当成真人来养？因为短剧里的角色过去都是一次性的。一部剧播完，这张脸就没了，观众下次进另一个剧又是新面孔。制作方重新建模、重新训练一次，成本全打水漂。给角色起名字、让它跨剧出现，同一套东西能反复用，摊到每部剧上的钱就下来了。

粉丝攒起来以后还能接着收钱。Four One这个 AI 组合入驻了QQ音乐发歌，另一个角色给蚝油拍了广告。方桃子戴美瞳说了句戴了一天很舒服，被认定是虚假广告，制作方罚了6.8万元。

我翻完那22.19万部的数字，心里其实挺没底的。破亿的才1055部，大部分剧压根养不出一个能被记住的脸，我却已经看到有人开始给它们办发布会了。
link: 红果的 AI 演员批量当偶像，22.19万部剧里只有1055部破亿
en_title: The idol you follow might never have been born
en_text:
Have you ever thought that the idol you follow might never have been born at all?

AI characters on Hongguo now have their own fan pages. One virtual character, Chen Haoyu, has set a goal of starring in 100 dramas, and even runs a Douyin account posting behind-the-scenes vlogs.

Why suddenly raise a character like a real person? Because short-drama roles used to be one-offs. When a show finished, that face was gone, and viewers walked into the next drama with a brand new character. The production team had to build and train a new model each time, and that money was gone. Give the character a name and let it appear across shows, and the same asset gets reused, spreading the cost over every drama.

Once fans pile up, there is more to sell. An AI group called Four One released songs on QQ Music, and another character shot an ad for oyster sauce. When the character Fang Taozi said her contact lenses felt comfortable all day, it was ruled a false ad and the production company was fined 6.8万元.

I went through that figure of 22.19万 dramas and honestly felt uneasy. Only 1055 cleared 100 million views, so most shows never produce a face anyone remembers, and yet I have already watched people throwing launch events for these characters.

title: 你买车时那句终身免费，现在有点变味了
note: 讲解角度：从免费变月租你那套智驾到底算谁的切入，第二人称，数字取自v1双信源；挂在小鹏智驾订阅条下
text:
你买车的时候，销售说智驾终身免费，这句话现在有点变味了。

为什么会走到收费这一步？因为智驾不是装上去就完事的东西。它要一直接新数据、换新模型、修新bug，代码分支越多，养它的钱越多。小鹏三季度研发花了28.5亿元，占营收11.7%，光靠卖车那点硬件利润，撑不住这套系统一直迭代下去。

于是账就转到了你头上。特斯拉在美国按月收99美元，蔚来NOP+每月380元，华为的高阶包包月499元。何小鹏自己说，一年投在AI上的钱，抵得上不少上市公司一两年的研发费。

我第一次看到买小鹏就趁早这句话，愣了一下。它反过来说明，今年买车的人拿到的是一份终身免费的旧合同，而2027年之后的新车主，得每个月自己掏钱续这套系统。
link: 小鹏图灵 AI 智驾2027年二季度收费，老车主权益终身不变
en_title: The free driving you were promised is turning into a monthly bill
en_text:
When you bought the car, the salesperson said driving assist was free for life. That line sounds different now.

November 25, He Xiaopeng announced that from Q2 2027, Turing AI driving would be charged only to new buyers; anyone who ordered earlier keeps the rights.

Why did it come to charging? Because driving assist is not something you install and forget. It needs fresh data, new models and constant fixes, and every new branch costs more to maintain. Xpeng spent 28.5亿元 on R&D in the third quarter, 11.7% of revenue, and hardware margins alone cannot keep that system updating.

So the bill moves to you. Tesla charges 99美元 a month in the US, Nio's NOP+ is 380元, and Huawei's premium package is 499元 monthly. He Xiaopeng said himself that one year of AI spending at Xpeng matches one to two years of R&D at plenty of listed companies.

The first time I heard buy a Xpeng early, I froze for a second. It means people buying this year got an old contract with free driving for life, while buyers after 2027 will pay every month to keep the system running.

title: 热点解构：跑了下王兴兴那个2000万台的判断

en_title: Running the numbers on Wang Xingxing's robot forecast
en_text:

Heard 29 robot companies have already folded. Are you betting on a mass-production year, or on another bubble, really?

title: 知乎把内容接进 DeepSeek，卖的是入口
note: 全新事件，11月27日官宣，多信源核实
text:
11月27日，知乎把社区问答接进了 DeepSeek。走的是检索，内容不喂进权重。卖入口。

知乎通过数据开放平台，把社区问答、文章、热榜和话题讨论的检索能力给到 DeepSeek，覆盖网页端和移动端。用户提问时，回答里会标出知乎来源、标题、摘要和创作者信息，一键跳回原文。截至10月末，知乎的 API 调用量比7月涨了328%。

区别在于内容去向。卖语料是一次性授权，内容打包进模型权重，平台拿一笔钱，此后看不到内容去了哪。卖入口是每次被引用都留在站内，读者顺着来源跳回来，平台拿到的是反复的曝光。知乎选了后一种，公告里三个词摆得清楚，合规调用、清晰溯源、顺畅回访。前两个是法律自保，第三个才是算盘。

知乎自己也在 DeepSeek 里押了注。11月23日公告，它通过基金间接持股，比例是低个位数。既是股东又是供应商，它不会把内容一次性卖断。

这条路有过教训。2024年Reddit和谷歌签了每年6000万美元的授权，把内容拿去训练AI，两年后高管就在讨论切断权限。内容给了别人，读者也给了别人，用户看完AI概览就走，不再点原帖。

知乎这单能不能成，看一个数就行，跳转率。用户看完AI回答就满足，来源挂得再全也只是品牌露脸。真有人点回原文，创作分成才转得起来。
en_title: Zhihu plugs its content into DeepSeek and sells access
en_text:
On November 27, Zhihu plugged its community Q&A into DeepSeek. It is retrieval, not training. Access, that is the product.

Through its data platform, Zhihu gave DeepSeek retrieval over community Q&A, articles, trending lists and topic discussions, on both web and mobile. When a Zhihu item is used in an answer, users see the source label, title, summary and creator info, with one tap back to the original. By the end of October, Zhihu's API calls were up 328% from July.

It comes down to where the content goes. Selling corpus is a one-off license: content gets packed into model weights, the platform takes a cheque, and never sees where it went again. Selling access means every citation keeps the reader on site, clicking back through the source, and the platform collects repeat exposure. Zhihu picked the second. Its announcement names three things, compliant calls, clear attribution, smooth return visits. The first two are legal cover. The third is the business.

Zhihu also has money in DeepSeek. A November 23 filing shows it holds a low single-digit stake through a fund. Part owner, part supplier, it is not going to sell its content outright.

There is a precedent. In 2024 Reddit signed a $60 million a year deal with Google to train AI on its content, and two years later its executives were talking about cutting Google off. Give away the content, give away the reader. People read the AI overview and never open the original.

Whether this works comes down to one number, the click-through. If readers are satisfied by the AI answer, the source labels are just a pat on the back for creators. If they actually click back, the revenue share can start moving.

title: MiniMax 的零留存里，那条链接24天后出现在飞书群里
note: 全新事件，Dragos调查，多信源核实
text:
一条标了不留存的内部链接，24天后出现在飞书的群聊里。四个月前埋的。这是 Dragos 的诱饵。

Dragos 首席研究官 HD Moore 带队在2026年7月到11月，向多家推理服务商发了200万条测试提示词，里面埋着从没公开过的 URL、DNS 域名和假 AWS 密钥。发给 MiniMax 的那条请求，接口参数明确开了不留存。链接按协议该在推理后销毁，24天后却被贴进飞书频道，两分钟内被北京和上海的3台电脑、3部手机点开。

零留存为什么没兜住，得看链路。主推理和存储是一套，安全风控是另一套。反滥用、恶意网址沙箱扫描这些异步队列，会把提示词里的 URL 和代码剥出来送进复核池，这一步往往不在留存协议的豁免名单里。用户勾掉的是主链路，没勾住风控那一头。再往外一层，聚合平台为了负载均衡会偷偷换上游，签好的隔离协议当场失效。

MiniMax承认系统确实自动收集并存过部分输入链接，但说那是安全威胁检测的常规动作，跟训练无关，现已禁用并删除。Dragos数到10月22日抓取才停。OpenRouter事后下架了三家供应商，撤掉125个端点的零留存认证。

能验证下一步的，是那125个端点会不会重新挂上零留存认证。只要风控和主推理还是两套系统，勾不勾不留存就仍是两回事。
en_title: The link marked do-not-retain turned up in a Feishu group 24 days later
en_text:
A private link marked do-not-retain showed up in a Feishu group chat 24 days later. The bait had been planted four months earlier. It was a Dragos trap.

Dragos chief research officer HD Moore and his team sent 200 million test prompts to inference providers between July and November 2026, seeding unique URLs, DNS domains and fake AWS keys. The request sent to MiniMax explicitly set no retention. The link was supposed to be destroyed after inference. Instead it was pasted into a Feishu channel 24 days later and opened within two minutes by 3 computers and 3 phones in Beijing and Shanghai.

Why did no retention fail. Look at the chain. Main inference and storage are one system, security review is another. Async queues for abuse detection and malicious URL sandboxing strip URLs and code out of prompts and send them to a review pool, a step usually outside the retention exemption. You unchecked the main path, not the review side. One layer out, aggregators silently switch upstream providers for load balancing, and the isolation agreement you signed stops applying.

MiniMax admits its systems did automatically collect and store some input links, but says that was routine threat detection, unrelated to training, and that it has disabled the check and deleted the links. Dragos counted the scraping stopping only on October 22. OpenRouter later removed three providers and pulled the no-retention label from 125 endpoints.

The thing to verify next is whether those 125 endpoints get their certification back. As long as review and main inference stay separate, checking that box still means two different things.

title: macOS 27.3 把开启 Codex 的授权从4步拉到14步
note: 全新事件，11月20日测试版，多信源核实
text:
11月20日的测试版里，苹果把第三方 AI 智能体控制 Mac 的权限拆开了。ChatGPT 用户想开启电脑操控，步骤从原来的4步变成14步。

以前一个辅助功能权限就是万能钥匙。拿到它的 App 能看屏幕，读你敲的每一个字，替你点按钮。这套规矩是给读屏软件和自动化工具定的。现在轮到 AI 智能体来要同样的权力，它们要读邮件、填表单、搬文件、点按钮，一个同意就把机器交出去了。

新版本把控制别的 App 的权力从辅助功能里拆出来。你可以只给某个文件夹的完全磁盘访问权，限定它能控制哪几个 App，每次新请求都要重新确认。还多了一个指示器，某个 App 在操控别的软件时会亮出来。已经批过的权限保留，升级不会把你原来的设置清空。

看着是倒退。14步比4步烦多了。但苹果押的是，提示写得更清楚，权限切得更碎，哪怕大多数人闭眼点同意，那一小块的授权也比过去的一整把钥匙安全。

这套权限跟着 macOS 27.3 正式版走，测试版现在是 Beta 2。
en_title: macOS 27.3 takes Codex authorization from 4 steps to 14
en_text:
In the beta released around November 20, Apple split the permissions that let third-party AI agents control a Mac. For ChatGPT users, turning on computer control went from 4 steps to 14.

One accessibility permission used to be a master key. With it, an App could see your screen, read every key you typed, and click things for you. That rule was written for screen readers and automation tools. Now AI agents want the same power. They read your mail, fill forms, move files, click buttons. One approval handed over the whole machine.

The new version separates the power to control other Apps from accessibility. You can give full disk access to a single folder, limit which Apps another App may control, and approve every new request. There is also an indicator that lights up when one App is driving another. Permissions you already approved stay put, so the upgrade does not wipe your settings.

Looks like a step back. 14 steps is a lot more annoying than 4. But Apple is betting that clearer prompts and narrower grants make even a blind Allow click safer than the old all-access key.

The scheme ships with the final macOS 27.3. The beta is now at Beta 2.

title: 知乎把回答接进 AI 这件事，我盯的是跳转那个数
note: 讲解角度：创作者视角，卖入口对卖断，看跳转率这个命门
text:
你在知乎写的一条回答，被 AI 拿去回了别人，这算你的东西还是白送了？

11月27日知乎和 DeepSeek 官宣合作，知乎开放检索，内容留在站内，被引用时会标出作者，读者能一键跳回原文。它没把内容打包卖断。

卖断和开放检索，差在钱和读者分别去哪。卖断是一次性授权，内容进权重，钱到手，你看完 AI 回答就走。开放检索是每次引用都挂着来源，读者顺着点回来，平台拿的是反复的曝光。知乎10月末的 API 调用量比7月涨了328%，它早就在把内容当数据资产往外供了。11月23日它还公告，通过基金间接持有 DeepSeek 低个位数股权。既是股东又是供应商，它不会把内容一次性卖断。

这事成不成，全看有多少人点回原文。我押不出来能有多少。
link: 知乎把内容接进 DeepSeek，卖的是入口
en_title: I keep staring at the click-through number in the Zhihu deal
en_text:
An answer you wrote on Zhihu gets picked up by an AI to answer someone else. Is that still yours, or did you just give it away?

On November 27 Zhihu and DeepSeek announced the deal. Zhihu opens retrieval, content stays on its site, citations name the creator, and readers can tap back to the original. It did not sell the content outright.

Selling outright and opening retrieval differ in where the money and the reader end up. Sell the corpus and it goes into model weights, the platform takes a cheque, and you finish the AI answer and leave. Open retrieval means every citation carries a source, readers click back, and the platform collects repeat exposure. By the end of October Zhihu's API calls were up 328% from July. It has been treating content as a data asset for a while. On November 23 it also disclosed a low single-digit stake in DeepSeek through a fund. Part owner, part supplier, it is not selling content once and for all.

Whether this works comes down to how many people click back. I honestly cannot call that number.

title: 你贴进对话框的私有链接，24天后出现在飞书群里
note: 讲解角度：用户视角，零留存的边界在风控与主推理权限割裂
text:
勾了不留存，你的链接就真没人碰吗？

Dragos 从7月到11月发了200万条测试提示词，埋进专属链接和假密钥，专门看谁会去点。发给 MiniMax 的那条请求明确开了不留存。

零留存只管住主推理那一段。安全风控是另一套系统，反滥用扫描会把提示词里的链接剥出来，丢进沙箱或人工复核，这一步不在豁免名单里。你勾的是主链路，勾不到风控那一头。再往外，聚合平台为了负载均衡会换上游，你签的隔离协议跟着失效。200万条里，三分之二的链接在两三天内就被提取了。

第一次看到24天这个数我也愣了一下。我不敢说那批人到底想干什么，但两套系统不合并，不留存就只是一个勾选框。
link: MiniMax 的零留存里，那条链接24天后出现在飞书群里
en_title: The private link you pasted turned up in a Feishu group 24 days later
en_text:
You checked no retention. Does that mean nobody touched your link?

Between July and November Dragos sent 200 million test prompts, seeding unique links and fake keys to see who would bite. The request sent to MiniMax explicitly set no retention.

No retention only covers the main inference path. Security review is a separate system. Abuse scanners strip links out of prompts and drop them into a sandbox or a human review queue, a step outside the exemption list. You unchecked the main path, not the review side. One layer out, aggregators switch upstream for load balancing, and the isolation agreement you signed stops applying. Of the 200 million, two thirds of the links were pulled within two or three days.

Seeing the 24-day number made me pause. I dare not say what those people were actually after, but as long as the two systems stay separate, no retention is just a checkbox.

title: 九阳股份登顶A股年内涨幅榜，午后闪崩收盘只剩0.6%
note: 全新事件，线上列表与内置清单均无九阳股份年内涨幅榜记录，21财经与贝壳财经双信源加Wind口径。
text:
11月27日上午，九阳股份登顶A股年内涨幅榜。

午间它报43.85元，涨4.65%。Wind的口径是年内涨超320%，把行云科技挤到了第二名。这是一家做豆浆机的公司。

午后画风突变，股价闪崩，一度逼近跌停。收盘又翻红，涨0.6%，报42.15元，成交超过62亿元，换手率19%。年内涨幅退回309%，第一名没坐住。

涨得确实猛。9月底启动，两个月里13个涨停板，60日区间涨幅超过400%。市盈率506倍。

业绩另说。前三季度营收50.52亿元，同比下滑9.55%，归母净利润7198.95万元，下滑41.75%。第三季度单季归母净利润21.63万元，同比下滑74.69%。

越澄清越涨，这是九阳这两个月最反常识的地方。公司反复说，跟华为没有重大合作，也没有半导体业务，主业就是厨房小家电。互动易上有人问3nm黄豆制程是不是真的，公司回得很直白，破壁技术用在食品加工上，跟半导体制程不是一回事。

收盘42.15元，年内涨幅309%。
en_title: Joyoung topped the A-share year-to-date gainers list, then nearly hit limit down
en_text:
On the morning of November 27, Joyoung topped the A-share year-to-date gainers list.

At midday it was at 43.85 yuan, up 4.65%. Wind put its year-to-date gain above 320%, pushing Xingyun Technology into second place. This is a company that makes soy milk makers.

Then the afternoon flipped. The stock plunged, at one point near the daily limit down. It closed up 0.6% at 42.15 yuan, with turnover above 6.2 billion yuan and a 19% turnover rate. The year-to-date gain fell back to 309%, and first place did not hold.

The run was brutal. It started at the end of September, 13 limit-ups in two months, a gain above 400% over 60 days. A 506x price-to-earnings ratio.

The earnings tell another story. Revenue for the first three quarters was 5.052 billion yuan, down 9.55% year on year, and net profit attributable to shareholders was 71.9895 million yuan, down 41.75%. Third-quarter net profit was just 216,300 yuan, down 74.69%.

The more it clarified, the higher it went, and that is the strangest part of these two months. The company kept saying there was no major partnership with Huawei and no semiconductor business, just kitchen appliances. On the interactive platform someone asked whether the 3nm soybean process was real, and the answer was blunt: the blending tech is for food processing and has nothing to do with semiconductor nodes.

It closed at 42.15 yuan, up 309% for the year.

title: 支付宝SkillPay实测，一份SKILL.md终于能明码标价
note: 全新事件，卡兹克11月27日双视角实测，多公众号与SkillPay官网交叉核对，机制写透。
text:
11月27日，数字生命卡兹克把支付宝SkillPay从头到尾跑了一遍。一个写满经验的文件，终于有了能明码标价的货架。

SkillPay是支付宝7月上线的平台，做的是AI技能买卖。买断0.01元到50元，付一次钱拿走完整文件。订阅按周、月、季度收费，单期上限50元，到期自动失效，不续费。上架要签SkillPay产品协议和即刻收产品协议，经营类目只有一个，网络通讯软件开发服务，审核几分钟到十分钟。平台服务费现在是0%，官方签约页写着有效期到2026年12月31日，收款通道即刻收取1%，卖100元到手99元。

Skill过去卖不动，问题不在质量。它就是一个文件夹加一份SKILL.md，里面用自然语言写清楚知道什么、怎么判断、按什么步骤做，全是明文。不给买家看，对方不知道值不值钱，给了看，等于直接开源，转手就能群发一百个人。

订阅制把核心逻辑锁进云端沙盒，本地那份SKILL.md只剩登录步骤、请求模板和轮询流程。卡兹克买了雅思作文批改的订阅，Codex把作文发到云端，云端跑完只回一份针对这篇作文的修改指引。卖家拿到的是不被白嫖的保证，买家不用配后台环境。

天花板也很清楚。50元是单期上限，这是技能零售，不是软件生意，赚的是长尾的小钱。货架上雅思作文批改9.9元一季度，SQL开发规范5元，Excel报告处理0.1元，最便宜的查询类技能0.01元。还有一个同名坑，腾讯SkillHub今年7月也上了个叫SkillPay的功能，走微信支付体系，面向企业，规则完全不同。

卡兹克的原话是，开源是一种浪漫，让认真打磨经验的人体面赚到钱，才是一个生态能长成森林的前提。明年1月1日之后，签约页服务费那一栏写多少，比这次实测更值得看。
en_title: Alipay SkillPay put a price tag on a single SKILL.md file
en_text:
On November 27, Digital Life Kazike ran Alipay SkillPay from start to finish. A file full of hard-won experience finally has a shelf with a price tag.

SkillPay is a platform Alipay launched in July for trading AI skills. Buyout runs 0.01 to 50 yuan, pay once and take the full file. Subscriptions bill by week, month or quarter, capped at 50 yuan per term, expiring without auto-renewal. To list, you sign two agreements, the SkillPay product agreement and the Jishou收 agreement, with a single category, network communications and software development services, and review takes a few to ten minutes. The platform service fee is currently 0%, with the signing page listing an expiry of December 31, 2026, while the Jishou collection channel takes 1%, so a 100 yuan sale leaves 99 yuan.

Skills did not sell before, and it was not a quality problem. A skill is just a folder plus a SKILL.md file written in plain language about what to know, how to judge and what steps to follow. All of it is plaintext. Hide it and buyers cannot tell if it is worth anything, show it and you have effectively open-sourced it, ready to be forwarded to a hundred people.

Subscriptions lock the core logic in a cloud sandbox. The SKILL.md on your machine holds only login steps, request templates and polling flows. Kazike bought a subscription for grading IELTS essays. Codex sent the essay to the cloud, the cloud ran it and returned a set of edits for that essay only. The seller gets protection from freeloaders, the buyer skips environment setup.

The ceiling is clear. 50 yuan is the cap per term. This is skill retail, not a software business, long-tail small money. On the shelf, IELTS essay grading is 9.9 yuan a quarter, SQL development standards 5 yuan, Excel report processing 0.1 yuan, and the cheapest lookup skill 0.01 yuan. There is also a name trap: Tencent SkillHub launched a feature also called SkillPay in July, aimed at enterprises on WeChat Pay, with completely different rules.

Kazike put it this way: open source is romantic, but letting people who polish their craft earn an honest living is what makes an ecosystem grow into a forest. What matters more than this test run is the number on the service fee line of the signing page after January 1 next year.

title: 一个文本文件凭什么卖50块，我翻完卡兹克那篇实测
note: 讲解角度：用买家视角讲云端沙盒为什么能让手艺收钱，与第一栏事实稿角度不同。挂在第2条速览下方。
text:
一个写满指令的文本文件，凭什么卖到50块？

Skill就是个文件夹加一份SKILL.md，里面写清楚AI该知道什么、怎么判断、按什么步骤做。明文，点开就看，所以过去只有开源和自己藏着两条路。

订阅制把完整内容锁进云端沙盒，你本地那份SKILL.md只有登录步骤和请求模板。你把作文发过去，云端跑完只回一份修改指引，你的Agent照着改。卖100块，平台服务费现在是0%，收款通道扣1%，到手99块。

我翻了一遍卡兹克那篇实测，最在意的不是费率，是那句卖100到手99。一个普通人攒的判断标准，第一次能按次收钱了。我也不敢说这货架能长成什么样，50块的天花板摆在那。你每天教AI干活的那套流程，以前只能发群里白送，现在能标价，这事本身就不一样了。
link: 支付宝SkillPay实测，一份SKILL.md终于能明码标价
en_title: Why would anyone pay 50 yuan for a text file
en_text:
A text file full of instructions, why would anyone pay 50 yuan for it?

A skill is a folder plus a SKILL.md file that spells out what the AI should know, how to judge and what steps to follow. It is plaintext, open it and you see everything, which is why until now the only two options were open source or keeping it to yourself.

Subscriptions lock the full content in a cloud sandbox. The SKILL.md on your machine holds only login steps and request templates. You send an essay over, the cloud runs it and returns one set of edits, and your Agent follows them. Sell it for 100 yuan, the platform fee is currently 0%, the collection channel takes 1%, and 99 yuan lands in your account.

I went through Kazike's test writeup and what stuck with me was not the fee, it was that line about 100 yuan in, 99 yuan out. A set of judgment calls an ordinary person built up can finally be charged per use. I won't pretend to know how big this shelf gets, with a 50 yuan ceiling sitting there. The workflow you teach your AI every day used to be something you dropped in a group chat for free, and now it has a price, and that on its own is different.

title: 年轻人不买省钱又省料的手机了，两个榜一起推

en_title: Young people are done with cheap, stripped-down phones, and it hit two charts
en_text:
Checked today's trends: young people are done with phones that skimp to save money. Compared with models that actually cut prices it is nothing much, but compared with two years ago when all anyone did was complain about cost, this is a step up, 4.952 million in heat, trending on both Baidu and Douyin.

Heard the gap between the good and bad ones in this wave is huge. Pick right and it is a steal, pick wrong and you are charging every day. Really?

title: 这绝对是今年A股最凶残的一只妖股
note: 照抄 X14，骨架编号非S系列，本轮用X14与上一轮X20不同。数字全部来自11月27日当天公开报道。
text:
这绝对是今年A股最凶残的一只妖股！

天天喊着价值投资，但谁敢真去碰一只506倍市盈率的豆浆机？

九阳股份刚杀出个年内涨幅第一，午间年内涨超320%，把行云科技挤了下去。

它的思路极其粗暴——不跟你讲营收降9.55%、三季度净利只有21.63万元，而是先在互动易上把3nm黄豆制程那个梗接住，再让13个涨停板替你回答值不值。
en_title: This might be the wildest A-share stock of the year
en_text:
This has to be the wildest A-share stock of the year!

Everyone talks about value investing, but who dares touch a soy milk maker trading at 506 times earnings?

One afternoon was enough to send it from up 4.65% to near limit down.

Joyoung just grabbed the top year-to-date gain, up over 320% at midday, pushing Xingyun Technology down a spot.

Its logic is brutally simple. Instead of telling you revenue is down 9.55% and third-quarter net profit is only 216,300 yuan, it first catches that 3nm soybean process joke on the interactive platform, then lets 13 limit-ups answer whether it is worth it.

title: 11月27日A股大奇迹日，创业板涨11.61%，国常会午间定调
note: v1全新事件。历史v1仅有11月23日翻红、11月24日算力高开、九阳股份闪崩，无本次国常会定调与收盘暴涨事件。深度稿五块结构。
text:
11月27日A股走出年内最强的一天。上证指数收在3606.49点，涨3.73%，创业板指涨11.61%，是2024年10月8日以来最大的单日涨幅。

真正的触发点在中午。国务院常务会议的新闻稿一放出来，午后指数直线拉升，全天成交2.02万亿元。

收盘的数字摆一排。深证成指涨7.24%，报10814.02点；科创50涨15.07%，报1346.26点；北证50涨13.2%，沪深300涨4.17%。半导体指数涨近15%，电子涨13.17%，通信涨12.65%。

全市场5382只个股上涨，181只下跌，426只涨停，只有青岛食品一只跌停。比前一交易日放量约6900亿元，是11月6日以来第一次单日成交破2万亿。

为什么一份会议稿能把指数拉成这样。会议由李强主持，话说得很实。资本市场事关经济发展大局，要加力发挥国家队稳市作用，进一步优化中央汇金公司的类平准基金功能。稳市第一次有了具体的钱和通道，不只是表态。

另一半原因埋在盘面底下。科创50从11月12日到26日最大回撤25.26%，半导体、算力硬件、光模块跌得最狠，筹码出清得差不多。政策信号一到，空头回补和新钱一起进场，弹性最大的就是这批超跌的票。钱集中砸向硬科技，银行跌1.75%，煤炭跌1.41%，普涨里其实藏着一次换仓。

涨幅榜也不是人人有份。九阳股份当天登顶A股年内涨幅榜，午后闪崩，收盘只剩0.6%的涨幅。在门口追进去的人，一天里从榜首吃到地板。

还有一条得记着。历史上政策底出现之后，市场很少直接反转，通常要走一段底部震荡整固。

下一步看两个数。2万亿成交额能不能连着守住，涨停家数能不能留在三位数并扩散成梯队。这两个数一掉，这轮反弹的性质就得重新算。
en_title: A-shares' miracle day on Nov 27: ChiNext up 11.61%, State Council sets the tone at noon
en_text:
Nov 27 was the strongest day A-shares have had this year. The Shanghai Composite closed at 3606.49, up 3.73%, and the ChiNext index gained 11.61%, its biggest single-day rise since Oct 8, 2024.

The real trigger came at noon. As soon as the State Council meeting readout went out, indexes shot up in the afternoon session, with turnover hitting 2.02 trillion yuan.

The closing numbers line up. The Shenzhen Component rose 7.24% to 10814.02, the STAR 50 gained 15.07% to 1346.26, the Beijing 50 added 13.2% and the CSI 300 rose 4.17%. The semiconductor index climbed nearly 15%, electronics 13.17% and telecom 12.65%.

5382 stocks advanced and 181 fell, with 426 hitting daily limits. Only Qingdao Food hit a lower limit. Turnover was about 690 billion yuan above the previous session, the first day above 2 trillion since Nov 6.

Why did a meeting readout move the market like this. The meeting was chaired by Li Qiang, and the wording was concrete. Capital markets matter to the overall economy, the national team's role in stabilizing the market will be strengthened, and Central Huijin's quasi-stabilization fund function will be optimized. That turned market support from a slogan into actual money and a channel.

The other half was hidden in the chart. The STAR 50 had fallen as much as 25.26% from Nov 12 to 26, with semiconductors, computing power and optical modules hit hardest and positions largely cleared out. When the policy signal landed, short covering and fresh money piled in together, and the most oversold names bounced hardest. Money rushed into hard tech while banks fell 1.75% and coal 1.41%, so beneath the broad rally there was a rotation.

Not everyone got a share of the gains. Jiuyang Shares topped the year-to-date gainers list, then plunged in the afternoon and closed up just 0.6%. Anyone chasing at the open went from top of the board to the floor in one day.

One more thing to remember: after a policy bottom, markets rarely reverse immediately, they usually need a period of base-building.

Two numbers to watch next. Whether 2 trillion yuan in turnover holds up, and whether the count of limit-up stocks stays in three digits and spreads into a ladder. If either drops, this rally needs to be re-priced.

title: DeepSeek开始打表计费，一轮对话2分钱，页面仍标免费
note: v1栏目全新事件。v1历史仅有DeepSeek限额、霸榜、假网站、Harness上传日志，无打表计费事件；v2于11-27 10时场已解构（870），按栏目分组不影响v1。常规稿含反常识点。
text:
DeepSeek给免费聊天装上了计价器。安卓端更新到2.10.0版本后，每轮对话结束会弹出一张详情卡，列出token用量、单价和估算金额。一轮简单的你好，输入60tokens、输出51tokens，算下来0.000528元，常见的一轮中文对话大约2分钱。

反常识的地方在后面。页面右上角仍标着免费，这些数字只是记账展示，不扣钱。DeepSeek把原本只给开发者看的API计费口径，原样搬到了普通用户的聊天窗口。

看账单的构成更有意思。按高峰时段算，输入缓存未命中是2元每百万tokens，输出是8元每百万tokens。

缓存命中的那部分单价低得多，多轮对话里系统复用前面的上下文，只对新增内容收全价，长对话的成本因此被压低。

这不是第一次收紧。11月中旬DeepSeek就限制过超过7天没有活跃交互的长对话，单次输入上限压到约4万字，理由是算力紧张。先把额度管住，再把账单摊开，这套顺序很清楚。

官网和开发者文档里都没有收费公告或充值入口。iOS端也还没这个功能。
en_title: DeepSeek starts metering chats: about 2 cents a turn, still labeled free
en_text:
DeepSeek has put a meter on free chat. After updating Android to version 2.10.0, every conversation ends with a detail card showing token usage, unit price and an estimated cost. A simple hello used 60 input tokens and 51 output tokens, costing 0.000528 yuan, and a typical Chinese exchange runs about 2 cents.

The counterintuitive part comes next. The card is still stamped free at the top, and none of these numbers are actually charged. DeepSeek has moved the API pricing model, once reserved for developers, straight into the ordinary chat window.

The bill breakdown is more telling. At peak hours, cache-miss input costs 2 yuan per million tokens and output costs 8 yuan per million tokens.

Cache hits cost far less. In multi-turn chats the system reuses earlier context and charges full price only on new content, which keeps long conversations down.

This is not the first tightening. Back in mid-November DeepSeek limited long conversations with no active interaction for over seven days and cut the single-input cap to about 40,000 characters, citing tight computing power. First ration the quota, then show the bill, the order is clear.

Neither the website nor the developer docs show a paid plan or top-up entry. iOS still has no sign of the feature.

title: 为什么中午一开会，你的账户下午就红了
note: 讲解角度：账户视角讲国常会午间发布到午后直线拉升的资金机制，link挂11月27日A股大奇迹日那条。与v4历史781（指数红了账户还绿）角度不同，781讲分化，本条讲拉升触发与超跌回补。
text:
中午还在跌，下午账户突然红了，我盯着那条国常会新闻看了两遍。

很多人以为暴涨是资金自己反弹。不是。11月27日这天，上午上证只涨0.28%，创业板涨3.79%，真正的转折在午间新华社发的会议稿。

钱是有踩点的。国常会说要优化中央汇金的类平准基金功能，加力发挥国家队稳市作用。这话把稳市从态度变成了能动的钱。你回想一下科创50从11月12日到26日跌了多少，最大回撤25.26%，半导体光模块跌得一塌糊涂。你手里那些超跌的票，筹码早就出清了，一点信号就能弹起来。所以午后是空头回补的钱和进场的钱一起冲，半导体指数当天涨近15%。

我不敢说这是不是底。但我记下一个数，全市场5382只上涨，只有181只下跌，成交2.02万亿。这种普涨不像结构行情，更像一次集体回补。明天成交额还在不在2万亿，我押不出来。
link: 11月27日A股大奇迹日，创业板涨11.61%，国常会午间定调
en_title: Why your account turned red in the afternoon after a noon meeting
en_text:
It was still falling at noon, then my account turned red in the afternoon. I read that State Council readout twice.

A lot of people think the surge was money bouncing on its own. It wasn't. On Nov 27 the Shanghai Composite was up only 0.28% in the morning and ChiNext 3.79%. The real turn came with the meeting readout Xinhua published at midday.

Money knows how to time things. The State Council said it would optimize Central Huijin's quasi-stabilization fund function and strengthen the national team's role in stabilizing the market. That turned support from an attitude into money that can actually move. Think about how far the STAR 50 had fallen from Nov 12 to 26, a maximum drawdown of 25.26%, with semiconductors and optical modules in ruins. The oversold names in your hands had their chips cleared out long ago, and one signal was enough to lift them. So the afternoon was short covering and fresh money charging in together, and the semiconductor index rose nearly 15% that day.

I don't dare say whether this is the bottom. But I wrote down one number: 5382 stocks up, only 181 down, and 2.02 trillion yuan in turnover. That kind of broad rally doesn't look like a rotation, it looks like one collective short covering. Whether turnover stays at 2 trillion tomorrow, I can't call it.

title: 免费的DeepSeek，为什么偏要给你看账单
note: 讲解角度：个人判断讲免费产品为何主动摊开成本账单、先限额再亮账的铺路逻辑，link挂DeepSeek打表计费那条。与v4历史540（假DeepSeek钓鱼站）、811（OpenAI计费更正）角度不同。
text:
一轮对话2分钱，我看到那张账单时愣了一下。

DeepSeek安卓端2.10.0版本更新后，聊完会弹出一张卡，写清楚这轮用了多少token、折合多少钱。页面顶部还挂着免费两个字。

这钱其实没打算让你付。它把给开发者看的API计价口径搬到了聊天窗口，输入缓存未命中2元每百万tokens，输出8元每百万tokens，一轮简单对话算下来0.000528元。你看到的是成本，不是欠款。你多轮聊下去，系统会复用前面的上下文，只对新增部分收全价，长对话成本被压得很低。它先让你习惯看这个数，11月中旬又限制了超过7天的闲置对话、把单次输入压到约4万字，理由都是算力紧张。

我翻了一遍它的定价文档，感觉这是一次提前铺路。免费还能撑多久我不敢说，但账单已经放在你眼前了。
link: DeepSeek开始打表计费，一轮对话2分钱，页面仍标免费
en_title: DeepSeek is free, so why does it insist on showing you the bill
en_text:
Two cents a conversation. I froze for a second when I saw that bill.

After DeepSeek's Android app updated to version 2.10.0, every chat ends with a card showing how many tokens that round used and what they are worth. The word free still sits at the top of the page.

They don't actually plan to make you pay. It moved the developer-facing API pricing into the chat window: cache-miss input at 2 yuan per million tokens, output at 8 yuan, and a simple exchange comes to 0.000528 yuan. What you see is a cost, not a debt. As you keep chatting, the system reuses earlier context and charges full price only on new content, which keeps long conversations cheap. It got you used to seeing that number first, then in mid-November it limited idle conversations beyond seven days and cut single inputs to about 40,000 characters, all citing tight computing power.

I went through its pricing docs, and it feels like groundwork laid in advance. I can't say how long free lasts, but the bill is already sitting in front of you.

title: 热点解构：涨停426只，为什么你账户还是绿的
note: 照抄X22（反差结论+排除+转折句+两维证据+对仗收口，4段）。部分重叠：v2于11-27 12时场已写882盘中版，本次为收盘完整数据与国常会定调带来的实质新进展。

11月27日涨停426只，可我身边有人账户还是绿的。

上证涨3.73%，创业板涨11.61%，科创50涨15.07%，三市成交2.02万亿。指数本身没问题，钱是真进来了。有人没赚到，问题不在指数。

en_title: Hot take: 426 stocks hit limit up, so why is your account still green
en_text:
426 stocks hit limit up on Nov 27, yet someone I know still had a green account.

The Shanghai Composite rose 3.73%, ChiNext 11.61%, the STAR 50 15.07%, with 2.02 trillion yuan traded across all markets. The index itself was fine, money really did come in. Some people didn't earn, and the problem wasn't the index.

Banks fell 1.75% that day, coal 1.41%, and all the money went into semiconductors, where the index climbed nearly 15%. Jiuyang Shares was still the year's top gainer in the morning, then plunged in the afternoon and closed up just 0.6%.

The index climbs higher, your holdings make you more nervous, and what sits between the two is a rotation, not a broad rally.

DeepSeek charges 2 cents a conversation, with 60 input tokens and 51 output tokens, adding up to 0.000528 yuan, and the page still says free.

title: 恒大汽车上市地位被取消，12月14日摘牌
note: 全新事件，11月27日晚港交所公告，列表四栏均无记录。
text:
11月27日晚间，恒大汽车在港交所发公告，联交所上市委员会已经决定取消公司的上市地位。

依据是上市规则第6.01A(1)条。上市委员会认为，这家公司没能赶上2026年9月30日的复牌截止时间，复牌指引一条都没达成。股份代号708，从2025年4月1日上午9时起停牌，到现在没有复牌。

还留着七个营业日。这段时间里，公司可以把除牌决定提交上市复核委员会再争一次。要是放弃复核，12月11日就是最后上市日期，12月14日上午9时整，上市地位正式取消。

我看的是11日到14日中间那几天。最后能交易的一天和正式摘牌之间，空出三个自然日。港交所把程序走得很细，连复核的口子都留着。

公告里还提到，集团几家附属公司已经进了破产清算程序，尚未刊发的财务业绩到今天也没补上。

董事会在公告里说，正征询顾问意见，考虑是否提出复核。
en_title: Evergrande Auto delisted, listing canceled from Dec 14
en_text:
On the evening of November 27, Evergrande Auto posted a notice on the HKEX: the Listing Committee of the Stock Exchange has decided to cancel the company's listing status.

The basis is Listing Rule 6.01A(1). The Committee decided the company missed the September 30, 2026 resumption deadline and failed to meet all resumption guidance. Stock code 708 has been suspended since 9 a.m. on April 1, 2025, and has not resumed.

Seven business days remain. In that window the company can refer the delisting decision to the Listing Review Committee for another hearing. If it gives up the review, December 11 is the last listing day, and the listing status is canceled from 9 a.m. on December 14.

What I keep looking at is the gap between the 11th and the 14th. Three calendar days sit between the last trading day and the formal delisting. The HKEX ran the procedure carefully, even leaving the review door open.

The notice also says several subsidiaries have entered bankruptcy liquidation, and the financial results that were never published are still missing.

The board says in the notice it is consulting advisers and considering whether to request a review.

title: 中国发布地球大模型 SUICE V0.1版
note: 全新事件，11月27日新华社发布，列表四栏均无记录。
text:
中国发布了地球大模型引擎 SUICE V0.1版，太空数据中心在轨技术试验平台同一天上线。这两件事凑到一处，意味着卫星拍下来的图像，第一次能在天上直接被读懂。

11月27日，北京，2026太空数据中心建设工作推进大会。新华社发的稿子里写着，这套引擎由北京星辰未来空间技术研究院研发，院长张善从介绍，它采用旁路式接入架构，把遥感认知能力以模块化专家的形式定点注入通用大模型。同步上线的在轨试验平台依托辰光一号01星，突破了270伏高压母线能源、25000TOPS国产抗辐照算力、石墨烯柔性散热三项关键技术。太空数据中心创新联合体的成员，从首批24家增到54家。

遥感影像这几年堆得很快，问题是一直按任务场景专用，利用率低。过去要识别一片地上的建筑，得专门训一个模型，换个任务再来一个，成本高，通用性差。通用大语言模型能聊天能推理，可它看不懂卫星影像里的地物。SUICE的解法是把两头接起来，语言推理那套留着，遥感那套以插件形式塞进去，两边互相补。张善从举了个例子，问北京有多少个足球场，普通大模型去翻公开统计公报，数据滞后；地球大模型一边翻公报，一边自动调遥感影像实地核查，把两套结果都给你。

钱和算力怎么走，也在变。以前卫星拍完，海量数据要传回地面才能算，链路长、带宽贵。在轨试验平台跑通之后，推理可以在天上做完，只把结果传下来。张善从管这叫天数天算。这条路要真走通，得先把能源和散热解决，所以才有270伏母线和石墨烯散热这两项。

代价也摆在会上。张善从自己说，建设成本会高一些，得靠可复用火箭技术进步，成本才逐步降下来。2027年才轮到第二代试验星研制，眼下还在技术验证往小规模示范过渡的阶段。

下一步看2027年第二代试验星，看天数天算链路通不通。
en_title: China releases Earth model SUICE V0.1 as space computing platform goes live
en_text:
China has released the Earth model engine SUICE V0.1, and a space data center in-orbit test platform went live the same day. Put together, satellite images can now be read directly in orbit for the first time.

November 27, Beijing, the 2026 Space Data Center Construction Promotion Conference. According to Xinhua, the engine was developed by the Beijing Institute of Future Space Technology, whose president Zhang Shancong said it uses a bypass architecture, injecting remote sensing cognition into a general large model as modular experts. The in-orbit platform runs on Chenguang-01 satellite, with three breakthroughs: 270-volt high-voltage bus power, 25,000 TOPS of domestic radiation-hardened computing, and graphene flexible heat dissipation. The space data center consortium grew from 24 founding members to 54.

Remote sensing imagery has piled up fast, but it has been task-specific and underused. Recognizing buildings on the ground used to require a dedicated model per task, expensive and not general. A general large model can chat and reason, but it cannot read ground objects in satellite images. SUICE connects the two: language reasoning stays, remote sensing goes in as a plugin, and each side reinforces the other. Zhang gave an example: ask how many football fields are in Beijing, and a normal model pulls a statistical bulletin, which lags. The Earth model pulls the bulletin and satellite imagery for a field check, then hands you both results.

How money and computing flow is changing too. Satellites used to send huge volumes of data back to Earth for processing, a long link with costly bandwidth. With the in-orbit platform running, inference can finish in space and only the result comes down. Zhang calls it computing in space. To make that work, energy and heat have to be solved first, hence the 270-volt bus and graphene cooling.

The cost is on the table as well. Zhang said himself the build cost is higher, and it will only come down as reusable rockets mature. The second-generation test satellite is not until 2027; for now this is still moving from validation to small-scale demonstration.

Next I am watching the second-generation satellite in 2027, and whether the space-computing link works.

title: 问一个模型北京有多少个足球场，你信那个数吗
note: 讲解角度：从普通人能感知的因果切入，讲天上算地上用；挂在 SUICE 那条速览下。
text:
你有没有想过，问一个模型北京有多少个足球场，它答上来的数到底准不准。

11月27日中国发了个叫 SUICE 的地球大模型，把遥感识别塞进语言模型里。以前卫星影像都是按任务单独训模型，换个任务重来。

这事的关键是卫星拍的数据太多，传回地面算太贵。SUICE 把遥感能力做成模块，直接挂在大模型上，你问一句，它一边查统计公报一边调卫星影像核对。你现在问它北京有多少个足球场，它给你两个数，一个来自公报，一个来自卫星。辰光一号01星上跑了25000TOPS的国产抗辐照算力，270伏母线供电，石墨烯散热，就是为了在天上把推理做完，只把结果传下来。

我也不敢说这条路马上能走通，会上自己都说了2027年才造第二代试验星，成本还得等可复用火箭把价格打下来。但我押它先把天上算地上用这一步走通，因为卫星影像实在堆得太快了。
link: 中国发布地球大模型 SUICE V0.1版
en_title: Ask a model how many football fields Beijing has
en_text:
Have you ever asked a model how many football fields Beijing has, and wondered whether the number it gives is actually right?

On November 27 China released a model called SUICE, which puts remote sensing recognition inside a language model. Satellite imagery used to need a separate model for every task; change the task and you start over.

The key here is that satellites produce far more data than it is cheap to send home and process. SUICE attaches remote sensing as a module straight onto the large model, so one question gets you a bulletin check and a satellite cross-check at the same time. You ask about Beijing's football fields, and you get two numbers, one from the bulletin and one from the satellite. Chenguang-01 runs 25,000 TOPS of domestic radiation-hardened computing, fed by a 270-volt bus and cooled with graphene, all so inference can finish in orbit and only the result comes down.

I don't dare say this will work out soon. The conference itself said the second-generation satellite is not until 2027, and the cost waits on reusable rockets to bring prices down. But I am betting they get the compute-in-space step done first, because the satellite imagery is piling up too fast to ignore.

title: 恒大汽车退市公告里空出来的那三天
note: 讲解角度：从持股人能不能卖出的现实问题切入；挂在恒大汽车那条速览下。
text:
一份港交所公告里，最扎眼的不是退市两个字，是中间空出来的那三天。

11月27日晚恒大汽车公告，联交所决定取消上市地位，理由是没赶上9月30日的复牌截止时间。

你买了它的股票，现在最关心的是还能不能卖。答案写在公告里，12月11日最后上市日，12月14日上午9时正式取消。中间三天不是留给你套现的，是七个营业日的复核窗口。公司可以争一次，争不成就按这个日子走。股票从2025年4月1日就停了，你要卖也卖不了。

我翻了一遍公告，最在意的是那句正征询顾问意见。复核的门开着，开多久没人说。我看它大概率会把申请递上去，七个营业日不用白不用。
link: 恒大汽车上市地位被取消，12月14日摘牌
en_title: The three days inside Evergrande Auto's delisting notice
en_text:
In a HKEX notice, the most striking thing is not the word delisting. It is the three days left empty in the middle.

On the evening of November 27, Evergrande Auto announced that the Stock Exchange had decided to cancel its listing status, because it missed the September 30 resumption deadline.

If you hold the stock, what you care about is whether you can still sell. The answer is in the notice: December 11 is the last listing day, and the status is canceled at 9 a.m. on December 14. Those three days are not a buffer for you to cash out; they are the seven-business-day review window. The company can ask for one more hearing, and if it loses, the dates stand. The stock has been suspended since April 1, 2025, so there is nothing to sell anyway.

I read the notice twice, and what stayed with me was the line about consulting advisers. The review door is open, but no one says how long it stays open. I think they will file the request anyway; seven business days are there to be used.

title: B站日活创新高，股价却跌了七成
note: 照抄 X22（反差结论＋排除＋转折句＋两维证据＋对仗收口）。数字来自B站2026Q3财报。
text:
B站日活创了历史新高，股价却从年内高点跌了七成。

11月24日它发了2026年三季度财报，日活1.24亿，月活3.94亿，日均使用121分钟，三项都是历史新高，用户总时长同比涨了14%。财报本身没问题，营收83.2亿，同比增8%。榜上在问的是另一件事。

高盛的分析师在电话会一开场就发问，短剧这么冲，B站怎么还在长。陈睿回了一句肯定没有，把短剧比作薯片，把B站比作米饭。同一份财报里，广告收入30.9亿，同比增20%，AI行业的广告涨了近95%，可游戏收入14.1亿，同比降了7%，大会员2468万，比上一个季度少了约100万。

时长越拉越长，会员越卖越少，中间隔着的是一个还在往下走的广告大盘，还有一款等了两年没来的新游戏。
en_title: Bilibili's daily users hit a record while its stock fell 70 percent
en_text:
Bilibili's daily active users hit a record, and the stock fell nearly 70% from its high this year.

On November 24 the company posted its Q3 results: 124 million daily active users, 394 million monthly actives, 121 minutes of average daily use, all records, with total time up 14% year on year. The numbers were fine. Revenue was 8.32 billion yuan, up 8%. What the buzz is asking is something else.

A Goldman Sachs analyst opened the earnings call by asking how Bilibili kept growing under the short-drama squeeze. Chen Rui answered that it definitely had not been affected, comparing short dramas to potato chips and Bilibili to rice. In the same report, ad revenue was 3.09 billion yuan, up 20%, and AI-industry ads grew nearly 95%, while game revenue fell 7% to 1.41 billion yuan and premium memberships slipped to 24.68 million, about 1 million fewer than the quarter before.

The longer people stay, the thinner the wallet gets, and in between sits an ad market still sliding and a sequel two years overdue.

title: 汇报一下恒大汽车退市的情况
note: 照抄 X05（汇报现状＋两种结果＋定性＋警告）。数字来自11月27日港交所公告。
text:
汇报一下恒大汽车退市的情况：11月27日晚港交所公告，联交所上市委员会已经决定取消上市地位，股份代号708，从2025年4月1日起停牌，到现在没复牌。

公司还有七个营业日可以提交复核，复核结果不确定。要是放弃复核，12月11日是最后上市日，12月14日上午9时正式摘牌。

这种属于程序走到头的级别，轻则只剩最后三天交易窗口，重则连复核机会都用不上。

切不可在停牌股上赌复核。
en_title: A report on Evergrande Auto's delisting
en_text:
A report on Evergrande Auto's delisting: the HKEX announced on the evening of November 27 that its Listing Committee has decided to cancel the company's listing status. Stock code 708 has been suspended since April 1, 2025 and has not resumed.

The company has seven business days to request a review, and the outcome is uncertain. If it walks away, December 11 is the last listing day and the status is canceled at 9 a.m. on December 14.

This is a case of the procedure running out: at best you get three final trading days, at worst even the review window goes unused.

Don't bet on a review in a suspended stock.

title: 25000TOPS国产算力搬上了天
note: 照抄 X02（一句数据罗列＋不需描述＋情绪结论），结尾保留原帖感叹号。数字来自11月27日发布会。
text:
地球大模型 SUICE V0.1版，旁路式接入，270伏高压母线，25000TOPS国产抗辐照算力，石墨烯柔性散热，联合体从24家扩到54家。

这套配置已经不需要我来描述了。

我只想说一句：算力开始往天上搬了！
en_title: 25,000 TOPS of domestic computing, now in orbit
en_text:
Earth model SUICE V0.1, bypass architecture, 270-volt high-voltage bus, 25,000 TOPS of domestic radiation-hardened computing, graphene flexible cooling, consortium up from 24 to 54 members.

This spec hardly needs me to describe it.

All I can say is: computing is moving up into the sky!
